article_records.anchor: Ordinary full BFGS often succeeds on nonsmooth objectives,
article_records.review: Abstract summarizes the actual independently proved article theorem set: compact-centered and coercive homogeneous global families, finite-cell and genuinely nonradial planar local classes, distinct finite-branch local failures, and the actual-matrix mechanism. No complete boundary, matrix asymptotics, generic failure or C2 uniformly strongly convex local negative is asserted. Exact contracts are in the positive and negative component records.

article_records.anchor: We give three answers:
article_records.review: Intro now states three coequal answers before the lineage. Later contribution paragraphs retain all structural/compactness/locality qualifications and canonical theorem cross-references; actual literal all-run benchmark has its own audited wrapper. Literature/novelty and Challenge7.1 paraphrases are assessed separately in literature_primary_review.json.

article_records.anchor: We prove an inequality linking
article_records.review: The arithmetic mean of reciprocals diverges under bounded gradients and vanishing predicted decreases. These follow on compact sublevels for article applications. This is not pointwise q convergence or a metric limit.

article_records.anchor: The mixed ridge $F(u,v)=u^2+|v|$
article_records.review: The inward range 0<=tau<=1 is now explicit; the supplemental identity is stronger (tau<=1 suffices). Actual derivatives at v!=0 are proved; limiting one-sided gradient values are the constant one-sided formulas. Equal descent is strictly negative only for u!=0.

article_records.anchor: The right panel of Figure~\ref{art:gradient-geometry} asks a different question:
article_records.review: The exact isolated algebraic root is used in every theorem. The figure alone uses the rational center. Affine independence is proved via the positive determinant (c-1)/8-2d and gives full affine span in R^2. Strict common descent does not entail realizability or algorithm success; the actual cycle is proved separately in the negative core.

article_records.anchor: This distinction between affine and convex balance
article_records.review: The prose now specifies a nonempty finite slope family. The arbitrary negative common rate is covered explicitly, not only the normalized -1 version. Generic strict convex separation is a fresh supplemental theorem using standard mathlib separation/duality, not an invented inherited export.

article_records.anchor: \label{art:positive-outcomes}
article_records.review: Scope table is a precise summary of the separately mapped family statements. Every row retains infinite actual-run quantifier, arbitrary SPD initialization, stated compactness/structural basin, and uniqueness where used. Global homogeneous row is coercive linear homogeneity, not a general affine maximum.

article_records.anchor: The first two rows make precise global assertions;
article_records.review: General affine offsets admit the separately proved global wrong-corner example; homogeneous coercive objectives have unique minimum0. Finite incident polyhedral cells give inward models, while actual curved planar example violates radial secants. Geometry is interpretation of those proofs, not classification by jumps.

article_records.anchor: The identity makes the intended contradiction visible.
article_records.review: Persistent gap eta>0 and uniformly bounded R yield eta² sum1/q≤E0+CN by the proved reference-energy identity. Matrix hierarchy contradicts this with bounded gradients and d→0. No uniform bound on B or limiting H is used.

article_records.anchor: Finite-horizon bounds
article_records.review: Finite-horizon and summable-budget superquadratic versions remain complete separate companion Chapter2 results; article qualitative assumption d→0 is retained rather than silently strengthened.

article_records.anchor: The companion's scalar convergence and certificate-nonexistence results
article_records.review: Companion scalar convergence and certificate-nonexistence show this sufficient comparison certificate is not necessary. The article planar example supplies a separate convergence mechanism where a radial secant certificate fails. Removed reminders concerning metric limits, finite search termination and cell identification are not represented as still present in this shortened paragraph.

article_records.anchor: The mixed benchmark $u^2+|v|$
article_records.review: Synthesis matches abstract and proved theorem set. It distinguishes compact-centered, coercive homogeneous, finite local cells and moving planar geometry, and the two incomparable local negative regularity regimes. No probability or complete spectral classification is claimed.

article_records.anchor: The homogeneous seed satisfies
article_records.review: The existing seed descent ray is G(t(-1,16))=-t for t>=0. The cap v-17 is affine with nonzero intercept; e.g at the cap-active ray (0,t), large t makes the t-17 value, violating degree-one homogeneity. The homogeneous/coercive theorem does not apply to either objective.

article_records.anchor: In the local embeddings, wrong vertices recur
article_records.review: The explicit positive-valued nonstationary centers and bad starts accumulate at the unique minimizer. Were a finite local polyhedral C11 partition available, its established local-basin theorem would contradict these actual admissible bad runs on sufficiently low sublevels. No assertion is made that accumulating singularities generally force failure.

article_records.anchor: There is also a direct test of the planar hypotheses.
article_records.review: All four values are zero at zero. Upper branch derivatives follow branch_old_hasGradient plus phiFirst_zero and branch_last_hasGradient. Lower first-three gradients follow branchGradient_zero; fourth equals mu*0+e2 by its definition and is explicitly used in objective_directional_derivative_zero. Whitening sends them by A transpose, with invertible A. Repeated indexed zeros violate affine independence by its injectivity consequence. A positive weighted combination reduces to lambda_3 e2, or lambda_3 A^T e2, and is nonzero. These are elementary consequences, not a newly compiled standalone endpoint.

def certificate (b c₁ c₂ η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    TransportedCertificate.BandCertificate objective {x | objective x ≤ b} 0 c₁ c₂ η :=
  TransportedCertificate.rankOneCertificate (fun x => x) (η ^ 2) (2 * b) 0 1
    (sq_pos_of_pos hη) le_rfl zero_lt_one
    (by
      intro x hx g hg
      rw [radial_pairing hg]
      have hηx := hx.2
      rw [objective_formula] at hηx
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 0), abs_nonneg (x 1)])
    (fun _ _ _ _ _ hz hp _ => secant_bound hz.1 hp.gradient_x hp.gradient_z)
    (by
      intro x z g h _ _ _ _
      refine ⟨1, 1, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [one_smul, TransportedCertificate.pairStep]
        abel
      · simp)

theorem certificate_parameters {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (c₁ c₂ η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    let B := certificate b c₁ c₂ η hη
    B.W = (fun x => outer x x) ∧ B.m = η ^ 2 ∧ B.C = 2 * b ∧
      B.L = 0 ∧ B.δ = 1 ∧ 0 ≤ B.C

theorem differentiable_coordinate_ne_zero {x : Vec 2}
    (hx : DifferentiableAt ℝ objective x) : x 1 ≠ 0

theorem gradient_eq_of_nonneg {x g : Vec 2} (hx : 0 ≤ x 1)
    (hg : HasFDerivAt objective (gradientFunctional g) x) : g = ![2 * x 0, 1]

theorem gradient_eq_of_nonpos {x g : Vec 2} (hx : x 1 ≤ 0)
    (hg : HasFDerivAt objective (gradientFunctional g) x) : g = ![2 * x 0, -1]

theorem joint_witness {b : ℝ} (hb : (2 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ b) :
    ConvexOn ℝ univ objective ∧ IsLeast (Set.range objective) 0 ∧
      (∀ x, objective x = 0 ↔ x = 0) ∧ 0 < b ∧
      IsCompact {x : Vec 2 | objective x ≤ b} ∧
      ∃ R : AdmissibleBFGSRun 2 objective,
        R.x 0 = ![0, 2 / 3] ∧ R.H 0 = 1 ∧ R.c₁ = 1 / 4 ∧ R.c₂ = 1 / 2 ∧
        (∀ k, R.x k = ![0, (2 / 3) * (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k] ∧
          R.g k = ![0, (-1 : ℝ) ^ k] ∧
          R.H k = Matrix.diagonal ![1, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k] ∧ R.α k = 1) ∧
        (∀ k, objective (R.x k) ≤ b) ∧
        (∀ k, R.d k = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k ∧
          objective (R.x k) - objective (R.x (k + 1)) = (1 / 3) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k ∧
          R.curvature k = 2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) ∧
        (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η →
          ∃ B : TransportedCertificate.BandCertificate objective {x | objective x ≤ b}
              0 R.c₁ R.c₂ η,
            B.W = (fun x => outer x x) ∧ B.m = η ^ 2 ∧ B.C = 2 * b ∧
              B.L = 0 ∧ B.δ = 1 ∧ 0 ≤ B.C) ∧
        Tendsto (fun k => objective (R.x k)) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ Tendsto R.x atTop (𝓝 0)

theorem projected_transport (x z : Vec 2) :
    TransportedCertificate.stepProjector (z - x) * outer z z *
        TransportedCertificate.stepProjector (z - x) =
      TransportedCertificate.stepProjector (z - x) * outer x x *
        TransportedCertificate.stepProjector (z - x)

def run : AdmissibleBFGSRun 2 objective :=

    (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

    Tendsto run.x atTop (𝓝 0) ∧

    (hg : HasFDerivAt objective (gradientFunctional g) x)

theorem quadratic_certificates {n : ℕ} (_hn : 1 ≤ n) (b : ℝ) (_hb : 0 < b)
    (c₁ c₂ : ℝ) (_hc₁ : 0 < c₁) (_hc₁₂ : c₁ < c₂) (_hc₂ : c₂ < 1) :
    (∀ x : Vec n, Quadratic.objective x = ‖euclideanVector x‖ ^ 2 / 2) ∧
      ConvexOn ℝ univ (@Quadratic.objective n) ∧
      IsLeast (range (@Quadratic.objective n)) 0 ∧
      (∀ x : Vec n, Quadratic.objective x = 0 ↔ x = 0) ∧
      IsCompact {x : Vec n | Quadratic.objective x ≤ b} ∧
      ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → η ≤ b →
        ∃ B : TransportedCertificate.BandCertificate (@Quadratic.objective n)
            {x | Quadratic.objective x ≤ b} 0 c₁ c₂ η,
          B.W = (fun _ => 1) ∧ B.m = 2 * η ∧ B.C = 1 ∧ B.L = 0 ∧ B.δ = 1 ∧
            0 ≤ B.C ∧ ∀ x, (B.W x).PosDef ∧ (B.W x).rank = n

theorem quadratic_history {n : ℕ} (_hn : 1 ≤ n) (x₀ : Vec n) (hx₀ : x₀ ≠ 0) :
    ConvexOn ℝ univ (@Quadratic.objective n) ∧
      (∀ x : Vec n, Quadratic.objective x = 0 ↔ x = 0) ∧
      ∃ (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n Quadratic.objective) (b : ℝ),
        R.x 0 = x₀ ∧ R.H = (fun _ => 1) ∧ R.c₁ = 1 / 4 ∧ R.c₂ = 1 / 2 ∧
        (∀ k, R.x k = ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) • x₀ ∧ R.g k = R.x k ∧ R.α k = 1 / 2) ∧
        b = Quadratic.objective x₀ ∧ 0 < b ∧
        IsCompact {x : Vec n | Quadratic.objective x ≤ b} ∧
        IsLeast (range (@Quadratic.objective n)) 0 ∧ Quadratic.objective (R.x 0) ≤ b ∧
        (∀ k, Quadratic.objective (R.x k) ≤ b) ∧
        (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η →
          ∃ B : TransportedCertificate.BandCertificate (@Quadratic.objective n)
              {x | Quadratic.objective x ≤ b} 0 R.c₁ R.c₂ η,
            B.W = (fun _ => 1) ∧ B.m = 2 * η ∧ B.C = 1 ∧ B.L = 0 ∧ B.δ = 1 ∧
              0 ≤ B.C ∧ ∀ x, (B.W x).PosDef ∧ (B.W x).rank = n) ∧
        Tendsto (fun k => Quadratic.objective (R.x k)) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
        Tendsto R.x atTop (𝓝 0)

theorem quadratic_history_decrease {n : ℕ} (x₀ : Vec n) (hx₀ : x₀ ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    let R := Quadratic.run x₀ hx₀
    Quadratic.objective (R.x k) - Quadratic.objective (R.x (k + 1)) =
        (3 / 4) * R.d k ∧
      dot (R.g (k + 1)) (R.displacement k) = R.c₂ * dot (R.g k) (R.displacement k)

def certificate (K : Set (Vec n)) (c₁ c₂ η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    TransportedCertificate.BandCertificate objective K 0 c₁ c₂ η where
  W := fun _ => 1
  m := 2 * η
  C := 1
  L := 0
  δ := 1
  m_pos := by positivity
  L_nonneg := le_rfl
  delta_pos := one_pos
  positive_semidefinite := fun _ _ _ => Matrix.PosSemidef.one
  visibility := fun x hx g hg => by
    rw [gradient_eq hg, identity_energy]
    have hb := hx.2
    change 0 + η ≤ sqNorm x / 2 at hb
    linarith
  secant := fun x z g h _ _ hp _ => by
    rw [gradient_eq hp.gradient_x, gradient_eq hp.gradient_z, identity_energy]
    simp only [TransportedCertificate.pairCurvature, TransportedCertificate.pairStep,
      one_mul, dot_self, le_refl]
  transport := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => by
    simpa using (Matrix.PosSemidef.zero : (0 : Mat n).PosSemidef)

theorem certificate_parameters (K : Set (Vec n)) (c₁ c₂ η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    let B := certificate K c₁ c₂ η hη
    B.W = (fun _ => 1) ∧ B.m = 2 * η ∧ B.C = 1 ∧ B.L = 0 ∧ B.δ = 1 ∧
      0 ≤ B.C ∧ ∀ x, (B.W x).PosDef ∧ (B.W x).rank = n

theorem exact_field_equalities (x z : Vec n) :
    metricEnergy (1 : Mat n) (z - x) =
        TransportedCertificate.pairCurvature x z x z ∧
      TransportedCertificate.stepProjector (z - x) * (1 : Mat n) *
          TransportedCertificate.stepProjector (z - x) =
        (1 + 0 * TransportedCertificate.pairDecrease x z x) •
          (TransportedCertificate.stepProjector (z - x) * (1 : Mat n) *
            TransportedCertificate.stepProjector (z - x))
theorem identity_energy (x : Vec n) : metricEnergy (1 : Mat n) x = sqNorm x
theorem inverseBFGS_identity (s : Vec n) : inverseBFGS (1 : Mat n) s s = 1

theorem joint_witness (x₀ : Vec n) (hx₀ : x₀ ≠ 0) :
    ConvexOn ℝ univ (@objective n) ∧
      (∀ x : Vec n, objective x = 0 ↔ x = 0) ∧
      ∃ (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n objective) (b : ℝ),
        R.x 0 = x₀ ∧ R.H = (fun _ => 1) ∧ R.c₁ = 1 / 4 ∧ R.c₂ = 1 / 2 ∧
        (∀ k, R.x k = ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) • x₀ ∧ R.g k = R.x k ∧ R.α k = 1 / 2) ∧
        b = objective x₀ ∧ 0 < b ∧ IsCompact {x : Vec n | objective x ≤ b} ∧
        IsLeast (Set.range (@objective n)) 0 ∧ objective (R.x 0) ≤ b ∧
        (∀ k, objective (R.x k) ≤ b) ∧
        (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η →
          ∃ B : TransportedCertificate.BandCertificate (@objective n) {x | objective x ≤ b}
              0 R.c₁ R.c₂ η,
            B.W = (fun _ => 1) ∧ B.m = 2 * η ∧ B.C = 1 ∧ B.L = 0 ∧ B.δ = 1 ∧
              0 ≤ B.C ∧ ∀ x, (B.W x).PosDef ∧ (B.W x).rank = n) ∧
        Tendsto (fun k => objective (R.x k)) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
        Tendsto R.x atTop (𝓝 0)
def objective (x : Vec n) : ℝ := sqNorm x / 2

theorem objective_euclidean (x : Vec n) :
    objective x = ‖euclideanVector x‖ ^ 2 / 2

theorem objective_hasGradient (x : Vec n) :
    HasFDerivAt objective (gradientFunctional x) x

def run (x₀ : Vec n) (hx₀ : x₀ ≠ 0) : AdmissibleBFGSRun n objective where
  convex := objective_convex
  x := point x₀
  H := fun _ => 1
  g := point x₀
  α := fun _ => 1 / 2
  c₁ := 1 / 4
  c₂ := 1 / 2
  c₁_pos := by norm_num
  c₁_lt_c₂ := by norm_num
  c₂_lt_one := by norm_num
  initial_posDef := Matrix.PosDef.one
  alpha_pos := fun _ => by norm_num
  gradient_nonzero := point_ne_zero hx₀
  hasGradient := fun k => objective_hasGradient (point x₀ k)
  step := fun k => by rw [step_eq]; abel
  update := fun k => by rw [step_eq, inverseBFGS_identity]
  armijo := fun k => by
    rw [point_succ, objective_half, old_pairing]
    unfold objective
    nlinarith [sqNorm_nonneg (point x₀ k)]
  weak_wolfe := fun k => by rw [point_succ, dot_smul_first]

theorem run_limits (x₀ : Vec n) (hx₀ : x₀ ≠ 0) :
    Tendsto (fun k => objective ((run x₀ hx₀).x k)) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      Tendsto (run x₀ hx₀).x atTop (𝓝 0)

theorem run_scalars (x₀ : Vec n) (hx₀ : x₀ ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    let R := run x₀ hx₀
    R.q k = sqNorm (R.x k) ∧ R.d k = (1 / 2) * R.q k ∧
      objective (R.x k) - objective (R.x (k + 1)) = (3 / 8) * R.q k ∧
      R.curvature k = (1 / 4) * R.q k

theorem run_weak_wolfe_eq (x₀ : Vec n) (hx₀ : x₀ ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    let R := run x₀ hx₀
    dot (R.g (k + 1)) (R.displacement k) =
      R.c₂ * dot (R.g k) (R.displacement k)

theorem admissible_run_exists {n : ℕ} (_hn : 1 ≤ n) {F : Vec n → ℝ}
    (hconv : ConvexOn ℝ univ F) (hbdd : BddBelow (range F))
    (hline : ∀ x p : Vec n, DifferentiableAt ℝ F x → p ≠ 0 →
      {t : ℝ | ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ F (x + t • p)}.Countable)
    (hstat : ∀ x g, HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional g) x → g ≠ 0)
    {x₀ : Vec n} (hx₀ : DifferentiableAt ℝ F x₀) {H₀ : Mat n} (hH₀ : H₀.PosDef)
    {c₁ c₂ : ℝ} (hc₁ : 0 < c₁) (hc₁₂ : c₁ < c₂) (hc₂ : c₂ < 1) :
    ∃ R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F,
      R.x 0 = x₀ ∧ R.g 0 = coordinateGradient F x₀ ∧ R.H 0 = H₀ ∧
        R.c₁ = c₁ ∧ R.c₂ = c₂

theorem strict_wolfe_step {n : ℕ} (_hn : 1 ≤ n) {F : Vec n → ℝ}
    (hconv : ConvexOn ℝ univ F) (hbdd : BddBelow (range F))
    (hline : ∀ x p : Vec n, DifferentiableAt ℝ F x → p ≠ 0 →
      {t : ℝ | ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ F (x + t • p)}.Countable)
    {x g : Vec n} (hg : HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional g) x) (hg0 : g ≠ 0)
    {H : Mat n} (hH : H.PosDef) {c₁ c₂ : ℝ}
    (hc₁ : 0 < c₁) (hc₁₂ : c₁ < c₂) (hc₂ : c₂ < 1)
    (p : Vec n) (hp : p = -(H *ᵥ g)) :
    ∃ α : ℝ, 0 < α ∧ ∃ h : Vec n,
      HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional h) (x + α • p) ∧
      F (x + α • p) < F x + c₁ * α * dot g p ∧ c₂ * dot g p < dot h p

theorem exists_wolfe_step {F : Vec n → ℝ} (hconv : ConvexOn ℝ univ F)
    (hbdd : BddBelow (range F))
    (hline : ∀ x p : Vec n, DifferentiableAt ℝ F x → p ≠ 0 →
      {t : ℝ | ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ F (x + t • p)}.Countable)
    {x g : Vec n} (hg : HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional g) x) (hg0 : g ≠ 0)
    {H : Mat n} (hH : H.PosDef) {c₁ c₂ : ℝ} (hc₁ : 0 < c₁) (hc₁₂ : c₁ < c₂) (hc₂ : c₂ < 1) :
    ∃ α : ℝ, 0 < α ∧ ∃ g' : Vec n,
      HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional g') (x + bfgsStep H g α) ∧
      F (x + bfgsStep H g α) < F x + c₁ * dot g (bfgsStep H g α) ∧
      c₂ * dot g (bfgsStep H g α) < dot g' (bfgsStep H g α)

theorem finiteMaxHypotheses_iff {m : ℕ} (F : Vec 2 → ℝ) (f : Fin m → Vec 2 → ℝ)
    (w : ConvexSubdifferential.activeIndices F f 0 → ℝ) :
    TwoQuadraticExample.FiniteMaxHypotheses F f w ↔
      ConvexOn ℝ univ F ∧ (∀ x, F 0 ≤ F x) ∧ (∀ x, F x = F 0 → x = 0) ∧
      (∀ i, ConvexOn ℝ univ (f i) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (f i) univ) ∧
      (∀ x, IsGreatest (range fun i => f i x) (F x)) ∧
      (∃ B, F 0 < B ∧ ∀ t, F 0 < t → t ≤ B → ∀ x y : Vec 2,
        segment ℝ x y ⊆ frontier {z | F z ≤ t} → x = y) ∧
      AffineIndependent ℝ
        (fun i : ConvexSubdifferential.activeIndices F f 0 => coordinateGradient (f i) 0) ∧
      (∀ i, 0 < w i) ∧ (∑ i, w i) = 1 ∧
      (∑ i, w i • coordinateGradient (f i) 0) = 0

theorem paperRegularAt_iff (F : Vec 2 → ℝ) (p : Vec 2) :
    TwoQuadraticExample.PaperRegularAt F p ↔
      (∃ V : Set (Vec 2), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 F V) ∨
      (∃ V : Set (Vec 2), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧ ∃ f₀ f₁ : Vec 2 → ℝ,
        ConvexOn ℝ V f₀ ∧ ConvexOn ℝ V f₁ ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f₀ V ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f₁ V ∧
        (∀ z ∈ V, F z = max (f₀ z) (f₁ z)) ∧ f₀ p = F p ∧ f₁ p = F p ∧
        LinearIndependent ℝ ![coordinateGradient f₀ p, coordinateGradient f₁ p])

theorem planarHypotheses_iff (F : Vec 2 → ℝ) (B : ℝ) :
    TwoQuadraticExample.PlanarHypotheses F B ↔
      ConvexOn ℝ univ F ∧ IsLeast (range F) 0 ∧ 0 < B ∧ IsCompact {x | F x ≤ B} ∧
      (∀ t, 0 < t → t ≤ B → ∀ x y : Vec 2,
        segment ℝ x y ⊆ frontier {z | F z ≤ t} → x = y) ∧
      (∀ p, F p ≤ B → ¬ AffineCriticalObjective.IsAffineCritical F p →
        ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F p ∨ PlanarCornerCharts.ConvexTwoBranchRegularAt F p) ∧
      (∀ p, F p ≤ B → AffineCriticalObjective.IsAffineCritical F p →
        (0 : Vec 2) ∈ ConvexSubdifferential.subdifferential F p)

theorem two_quadratic_finite_max_hypotheses (a b c : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ConvexSubdifferential.activeIndices (TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c)
        (TwoQuadraticExample.branch a b c) 0 = Finset.univ ∧
      coordinateGradient (TwoQuadraticExample.branch a b c 0) 0 = ![0, 1] ∧
      coordinateGradient (TwoQuadraticExample.branch a b c 1) 0 = ![0, -1] ∧
      TwoQuadraticExample.FiniteMaxHypotheses (TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c)
        (TwoQuadraticExample.branch a b c) (fun _ => 1 / 2)

theorem two_quadratic_joint (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∀ B : ℝ, 0 < B → TwoQuadraticExample.PlanarHypotheses
      (TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c) B) ∧
      TwoQuadraticExample.FiniteMaxHypotheses (TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c)
        (TwoQuadraticExample.branch a b c) (fun _ => 1 / 2) ∧
      (∀ R : AdmissibleBFGSRun 2 (TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c),
        Tendsto (fun k => TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c (R.x k)) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
        Tendsto (fun k => euclideanSolutionDistance (TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c)
          (R.x k)) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ Tendsto R.x atTop (𝓝 0)) ∧
      ∀ x₀ : Vec 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c) x₀ →
        ∀ H₀ : Mat 2, H₀.PosDef → ∀ c₁ c₂ : ℝ, 0 < c₁ → c₁ < c₂ → c₂ < 1 →
        ∃ R : AdmissibleBFGSRun 2 (TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c),
          R.x 0 = x₀ ∧ R.g 0 = coordinateGradient (TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c) x₀ ∧
          R.H 0 = H₀ ∧ R.c₁ = c₁ ∧ R.c₂ = c₂ ∧
          Tendsto (fun k => TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c (R.x k)) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
          Tendsto R.x atTop (𝓝 0)

theorem two_quadratic_objective_geometry (a b c : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) :
    IsLeast (range (TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c)) 0 ∧
      (∀ x, TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c x = 0 ↔ x = 0) ∧
      (∀ B : ℝ, IsCompact {x | TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c x ≤ B}) ∧
      (∀ x : Vec 2,
        TwoQuadraticExample.branch a b c 0 x = TwoQuadraticExample.branch a b c 1 x ↔
          x 1 = (c - a) * (x 0) ^ 2 / 2) ∧
      (∀ x : Vec 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c) x ↔
        x 1 ≠ (c - a) * (x 0) ^ 2 / 2) ∧
      (a = c → ∀ x : Vec 2,
        TwoQuadraticExample.branch a b c 0 x = TwoQuadraticExample.branch a b c 1 x ↔
          x 1 = 0)

theorem two_quadratic_planar_hypotheses (a b c : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B) :
    ConvexOn ℝ univ (TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c) ∧
      IsLeast (range (TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c)) 0 ∧ 0 < B ∧
      IsCompact {x | TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c x ≤ B} ∧
      (∀ t, 0 < t → t ≤ B → ∀ x y : Vec 2,
        segment ℝ x y ⊆ frontier {z | TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c z ≤ t} → x = y) ∧
      (∀ p, TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c p ≤ B →
        ¬ AffineCriticalObjective.IsAffineCritical (TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c) p →
        (∃ V : Set (Vec 2), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
          ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c) V) ∨
        (∃ V : Set (Vec 2), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧ ∃ f₀ f₁ : Vec 2 → ℝ,
          ConvexOn ℝ V f₀ ∧ ConvexOn ℝ V f₁ ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f₀ V ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f₁ V ∧
          (∀ z ∈ V, TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c z = max (f₀ z) (f₁ z)) ∧
          f₀ p = TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c p ∧
          f₁ p = TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c p ∧
          LinearIndependent ℝ ![coordinateGradient f₀ p, coordinateGradient f₁ p])) ∧
      {p | AffineCriticalObjective.IsAffineCritical (TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c) p} ∩
        {x | TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c x ≤ B} ⊆
          argmin (TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c)

theorem gauge_covered_convergence (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun 2 Gauge.objective) :
    Tendsto (fun k => Gauge.objective (R.x k)) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ Tendsto R.x atTop (𝓝 0)

theorem gauge_formula (x : Vec 2) :
    Gauge.objective x = max (x 0) (max (-x 0 + x 1) (-x 0 - x 1))

theorem gauge_no_step {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ConvexOn ℝ univ Gauge.objective ∧ Continuous Gauge.objective ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x : Vec 2, Gauge.objective (t • x) = t * Gauge.objective x) ∧
      IsLeast (range Gauge.objective) 0 ∧ (∀ x, Gauge.objective x = 0 ↔ x = 0) ∧
      (∀ b : ℝ, IsCompact {x : Vec 2 | Gauge.objective x ≤ b}) ∧
      Tendsto Gauge.objective (cocompact (Vec 2)) atTop ∧
      Gauge.objective ![ε, 0] = ε ∧
      HasFDerivAt Gauge.objective (gradientFunctional ![1, 0]) ![ε, 0] ∧
      (![1, 0] : Vec 2) ≠ 0 ∧ (1 : Mat 2).PosDef ∧
      (∀ α : ℝ, (![ε - α, 0] : Vec 2) = ![ε, 0] + bfgsStep (1 : Mat 2) ![1, 0] α) ∧
      (∀ α : ℝ, α < ε →
        HasFDerivAt Gauge.objective (gradientFunctional ![1, 0]) ![ε - α, 0]) ∧
      (∀ α : ℝ, ε ≤ α → ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ Gauge.objective ![ε - α, 0]) ∧
      (∀ c₂ : ℝ, c₂ < 1 → ∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → ∀ g : Vec 2,
        HasFDerivAt Gauge.objective (gradientFunctional g) ![ε - α, 0] →
        ¬ (c₂ * dot (![1, 0] : Vec 2) (bfgsStep (1 : Mat 2) ![1, 0] α) ≤
          dot g (bfgsStep (1 : Mat 2) ![1, 0] α))) ∧
      ¬ ∃ R : AdmissibleBFGSRun 2 Gauge.objective, R.x 0 = ![ε, 0] ∧ R.H 0 = 1

BfgsVerification.HypothesisExamples.Gaug.statement: theorem coordinate_bounds (x : Vec 2) : |x 0| ≤ objective x ∧ |x 1| / 2 ≤ objective x

theorem initial_state {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    objective (initialPoint ε) = ε ∧
      HasFDerivAt objective (gradientFunctional initialGradient) (initialPoint ε) ∧
      initialGradient ≠ 0 ∧ (1 : Mat 2).PosDef

theorem joint_obstruction {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ConvexOn ℝ univ objective ∧ Continuous objective ∧
      Homogeneous.PositiveDegreeOne objective ∧
      IsLeast (Set.range objective) 0 ∧ (∀ x, objective x = 0 ↔ x = 0) ∧
      (∀ b : ℝ, IsCompact {x : Vec 2 | objective x ≤ b}) ∧
      Tendsto objective (cocompact (Vec 2)) atTop ∧
      objective (initialPoint ε) = ε ∧
      HasFDerivAt objective (gradientFunctional initialGradient) (initialPoint ε) ∧
      initialGradient ≠ 0 ∧ (1 : Mat 2).PosDef ∧
      (∀ α : ℝ, ray ε α = initialPoint ε + bfgsStep (1 : Mat 2) initialGradient α) ∧
      (∀ α : ℝ, α < ε →
        HasFDerivAt objective (gradientFunctional initialGradient) (ray ε α)) ∧
      (∀ α : ℝ, ε ≤ α → ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ objective (ray ε α)) ∧
      (∀ c₂ : ℝ, c₂ < 1 → ∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → ∀ g : Vec 2,
        HasFDerivAt objective (gradientFunctional g) (ray ε α) →
        ¬ (c₂ * dot initialGradient (bfgsStep (1 : Mat 2) initialGradient α) ≤
          dot g (bfgsStep (1 : Mat 2) initialGradient α))) ∧
      ¬ ∃ R : AdmissibleBFGSRun 2 objective, R.x 0 = initialPoint ε ∧ R.H 0 = 1

theorem no_admissible_run {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun 2 objective) (hx : R.x 0 = initialPoint ε)
    (hH : R.H 0 = 1) : False

theorem no_differentiable_weak_wolfe {ε c₂ α : ℝ} (hc₂ : c₂ < 1) (hα : 0 < α)
    (g : Vec 2) (hg : HasFDerivAt objective (gradientFunctional g) (ray ε α)) :
    ¬ (c₂ * dot initialGradient (bfgsStep (1 : Mat 2) initialGradient α) ≤
      dot g (bfgsStep (1 : Mat 2) initialGradient α))

theorem ray_gradient_before {ε α : ℝ} (hα : α < ε) :
    HasFDerivAt objective (gradientFunctional initialGradient) (ray ε α)

theorem ray_not_differentiable_after {ε α : ℝ} (hα : ε ≤ α) :
    ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ objective (ray ε α)

theorem ray_step (ε α : ℝ) :
    ray ε α = initialPoint ε + bfgsStep (1 : Mat 2) initialGradient α

companion_shared_appendix.review: Same finite certificate proof is included in each document with local cross-references.

companion_frontmatter_deductions.anchor: The centered smooth--sublinear result here proves
companion_frontmatter_deductions.review: Frontmatter summarizes strongest retained classes with compactness, centered representation and whole-iterate uniqueness conditions. Homogeneous noncompact value results remain separate from compact iterate conclusions and XW finite escape.

companion_frontmatter_deductions.anchor: The negative results establish a complementary limitation.
companion_frontmatter_deductions.review: Both fixed-objective local counterexamples retain identity initialization, arbitrarily close starts, nonstationary limits and all-query family locality. No merged C2/lower-curvature claim.

companion_frontmatter_deductions.anchor: The common analytical tool is an adjacent-degree hierarchy
companion_frontmatter_deductions.review: Actual BFGS/minors, bounded-gradient vanishing-decrease reciprocal growth, and sufficient visibility/secant/transport mechanism. Scalar nonnecessity prevents reading this as complete characterization.

companion_frontmatter_deductions.anchor: The first three branches of the local finite-branch construction fail to be twice differentiable
companion_frontmatter_deductions.review: Actual first three scalar-ridge branches and their one fixed whitening fail differentiability of the Frechet derivative at zero. The new combined endpoint includes the original identity-initialized local-failure contract without extra hypotheses. This also supports the chapter opening regularity contrast. Complete restriction proof is printed in the article lower-curvature appendix and formalized in the separate supplement.

lean_coverage_records.reason: container; its claims are the prose items A/master/prose/001-013 (the keyword and subject-class lines assert nothing)
lean_coverage_records.note: Corrected on 15 October 2026 (M30, M41): the wording of prose/004 and prose/009 changed.

lean_coverage_records.anchor: Ordinary full BFGS often succeeds on nonsmooth objectives
lean_coverage_records.reason: motivation: empirical observation reported in the literature (Lewis--Overton [LO]); not a mathematical claim of the article and not used in any proof

lean_coverage_records.anchor: We give complementary positive and negative results
lean_coverage_records.note: Scope of both families: finite convex objectives, Armijo--weak-Wolfe accepted steps, actual gradients at differentiable accepted iterates (Definition art:admissible for the positive theorems; the failing runs of the negative theorems come from the unit-first search with every query differentiable).

lean_coverage_records.anchor: A centered smooth--sublinear theorem proves global whole-sequence convergence
lean_coverage_records.note: Corrected on 15 October 2026 (M7): the abstract now states that the compact initial sublevels lie in the region of the centered representation, as Theorem art:centered assumes. The first half (global whole-sequence convergence for u^2+|v|) is Corollary art:mixed-benchmark. centered_representation_needs_containment shows that the containment cannot be dropped.

lean_coverage_records.anchor: Coercive degree-one homogeneous objectives, including coercive max-linear functions, norms and gauges, admit global convergence.
lean_coverage_records.note: Corrected on 15 October 2026 (M41): the families are named, "coercive max-linear functions, norms and gauges" (before: "the stated max-linear and gauge families"). True as phrased: finiteness and convexity, the hypotheses of Theorem art:homogeneous not repeated here, are the standing scope of the abstract ("for finite convex objectives", lines 40-41); "coercive max-linear functions, norms and gauges" are the three families of Corollary art:homogeneous-examples.

lean_coverage_records.anchor: Local results cover finite polyhedral smooth-piece partitions
lean_coverage_records.note: Summary; true as phrased (coordinator decision, 14 October, overruling the first classification as a discrepancy). It leaves implicit the hypotheses of the summarized results: a unique minimizer and locally C^{1,1} pieces (Theorem art:polyhedral, Corollary art:plq); a unique minimizer, convex C^2 branches, strictly convex low positive sublevels and active-gradient nondegeneracy (Corollary art:planar-max). "Smooth" is informal here; the theorems specify the regularity. The supporting example local_results_need_unique_minimizer (F(u,v)=|v|) only shows that the conclusion x_k -> x_* needs the unique minimizer: its runs converge to another minimizer, so it does not refute the summary.

lean_coverage_records.anchor: moving comparison geometry proves convergence although the radial
lean_coverage_records.note: Convergence is proved through Corollary art:planar-convergence (moving contour field); the radial criterion is art:radial-condition. The sentence continues "Local results cover ...", so the convergence is local: every infinite admissible run with F(x_0)<1/100.

lean_coverage_records.anchor: a fixed unit-first implementation can converge to nonstationary points
construction is a maximum of four globally convex
retains uniform strong convexity with $C^{1,1}$ branches, three of which lose
lean_coverage_records.note: Corrected on 15 October 2026 (M30): "at the minimizer" for "at the accumulation point". Corrected on 15 October 2026 (M8): "three of which" added. Uniform strong convexity, C^(1, 1) branches and the loss of second differentiability of the first three branches at zero are Theorem art:local-failure-lower; lower_branch_second_differentiability also proves that the fourth branch is twice differentiable.

lean_coverage_records.anchor: adjacent-degree hierarchy for actual principal minors of full-BFGS matrices
lean_coverage_records.note: Theorem art:planar-cluster is the moving-field energy argument used for the planar results.

lean_coverage_records.note: Stated as a Prop without proof: some finite convex objective with attained minimum and some pair 0 < c₁ < c₂ < 1 have a large set S of failing starts (failingStarts: the starts x_0 from which the specified unit-first search, NonStrictLineSearch.fromMetric, with H_0 = I produces an admissible run whose values do not tend to the minimum value), in one of the two senses of the gap. Generic, read topologically: S is comeagre in some nonempty open set U of starting points (U \ S meagre). This is the weakest of the usual readings: it follows from failure on a comeagre set of all starts and from failure at every point of a nonempty open set, and for sets with the Baire property it is the same as being nonmeagre, the topological counterpart of positive measure. Positive-measure: S has positive Lebesgue (outer) measure. The failing starts of the constructions are countable, hence null and meagre (Ch12D.starts_null).

lean_coverage_records.title: A low sublevel is an invariant local basin
lean_coverage_records.note: Hypotheses as in the text: F finite convex (ConvexOn ℝ univ F) with unique minimizer x_* (hmin, huniq), positive dimension (1 ≤ n), a specified neighborhood U ∈ 𝓝 x_* and r > 0 with the closed Euclidean ball B̄_r(x_*) ⊆ U; ω_r is the variable ω with ω = sInf of F(x_*+z) - F(x_*) over the Euclidean sphere ‖z‖ = r. Conclusions: the sphere is nonempty; ω_r is attained (IsLeast, the "min" of the display); ω_r > 0; for every x_0 with F(x_0) - F(x_*) < ω_r the sublevel {F ≤ F(x_0)} lies in the open Euclidean ball B_r(x_*); and, for the title's "invariant basin", every admissible run with F(x_0) - F(x_*) < ω_r stays in B_r(x_*) ⊆ U (no assumption on H_0). The library's Localization lemmas are for a general normed space (on Vec n the sup norm); the Euclidean statements are proved here along the text's radial argument. Non-vacuity (example in the module): x²/2 on ℝ¹, x_* = 0, U = ℝ, r = 2 (ω₂ = 2, computed from sphere_min), and the article's quadratic run, which starts with F(x_0) - F(x_*) = 1/2 < ω₂, so the condition of the run-invariance conjunct holds for an actual run.

Undisplayed steps: continuity, compactness of the sphere and uniqueness give ω_r > 0 (sphere_min); Armijo keeps every accepted iterate in the initial sublevel (objective_le_initial, used in localization); no bound on H_0 is assumed and rejected trials are not part of a run; "This argument also proves boundedness of every sublevel ..." and the dimension-zero remark are localization_remarks (every sublevel bounded and compact; for n = 0 all points coincide).
Under the lemma's assumptions (ω_r as in the lemma), for ‖x - x_*‖ ≥ r (Euclidean): F(x) - F(x_*) ≥ (‖x - x_*‖/r)ω_r and (‖x - x_*‖/r)ω_r ≥ ω_r.

lean_coverage_records.title: Strict contours give vanishing steps on a positive limiting level
lean_coverage_records.note: "The run is contained in a compact sublevel": b with {F ≤ b} compact and F(x_k) ≤ b for all k; "F(x_k) ↓ ℓ": the values are antitone (automatic for admissible runs, hypothesis _hmono unused) and tend to ℓ; F_* = min F is IsLeast (Set.range F) Fstar; ℓ > F_*; "the boundary of {F ≤ ℓ} contains no nontrivial line segment": every segment [x,z] ⊆ frontier {F ≤ ℓ} has x = z. Conclusion s_k → 0 (Tendsto R.displacement atTop (𝓝 0); every norm gives the same topology). Non-vacuity, with a positive limiting level, by an actual failing run of the article's Theorem art:local-failure-lower on its strongly convex objective (example in the module).

The library proof follows this route: d_k → 0 from Armijo; compact consecutive-pair limits x ≠ z; convexity bounds values on the accepted segment above by F(x_k) and the supporting inequality below by F(x_k) - d_k (segment_value_lower), so F = ℓ on [x,z] (cluster_pair_segment_constant); a point with value below ℓ puts the segment in the frontier (level_mem_frontier). The last sentence describes the proof route.

lean_coverage_records.note: Bounded gradients (∃ Λ, ∀ k, ‖g_k‖ ≤ Λ), fixed weak Wolfe (the run), ∑d_k < ∞ (Summable R.d); a fixed subspace S of Euclidean ℝⁿ (Submodule of EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) with P_S its orthogonal projection (S.orthogonalProjection); ‖P_Sy_k‖² ≤ L_St_k for all k (the library needs it only on the tail). Conclusion: no J, width p, frames V_k ∈ ℝ^{n×p}, T_k, b_k, residuals R_k (Rres) and constants m, C₀, C_T, C_R (arbitrary reals) with m > 0 and, for all k ≥ J, ‖V_kᵀg_k‖² ≥ m, ‖V_{k+1}ᵀy_k‖² ≤ C₀t_k, V_{k+1} = V_kT_k + s_kb_kᵀ + R_k, ‖T_k‖²_op ≤ 1 + C_Td_k (Euclidean operator norm, FrameNorms.euclideanOpNorm), range R_k ⊆ S (every R_k v ∈ S), ‖R_k‖_F² ≤ C_Rd_k (SmoothSubspace.frobSq, the sum of squared entries). "No full-rank frame or invertible transport is required": the statement has no such hypothesis. The library represents S by an orthonormal basis matrix U with P_S = UUᵀ (orthogonalProjection_eq, projection_basis, range_projection connect the two forms).

The library proof follows this route (residual_frame_step, residual_frames_incompatible). Undisplayed steps: "Consequently tr(P_SB_k) ≤ C_S + L_Sk", derived not imposed (smooth_subspace_projection_trace_bound; C_S = tr(P_SB_0)); the real factor C_k with M_k = C_kᵀC_k and the entrywise Young inequality (gram_trace_square, scalar_young, gram_trace_add_le); "The parenthesized energy is nonnegative" (second conclusion of Ch02M.frame_young_step; frame_descent_nonneg); "Finite ∑d_k gives 1 ≤ P_k ≤ P̄ < ∞" (Energy.normalization_bounds, with P̄ = exp(C₁∑_{j≥J}d_j)); "contrary to Theorem M:superquadratic" (residual_recurrence_incompatible). Standing assumptions: the theorem's hypotheses and the frames on the tail J that the proof assumes (unused here), and P_S as a matrix PS of the orthogonal projection (hPS). Adds E_k = tr(V_kᵀB_kV_k) and M_k of (M:annihilation) (variables). For every k ≥ J: E_{k+1} = tr[(V_kT_k + R_k)ᵀM_k(V_kT_k + R_k)] + ‖V_{k+1}ᵀy_k‖²/t_k. General form frame_energy_step (one k, only the frame relation at k).

For every k ≥ J: E_{k+1} ≤ (1+d_k)‖T_k‖²(E_k - ‖V_kᵀg_k‖²/q_k) + (1+d_k⁻¹)tr(R_kᵀM_kR_k) + C₀, ‖T_k‖ the Euclidean operator norm. General form frame_young_step (one k: frame relation and ‖V_{k+1}ᵀy_k‖² ≤ C₀t_k), which also states that the parenthesized energy is nonnegative.

Adds C_S = tr(P_SB_0) (the constant of the derived bound tr(P_SB_k) ≤ C_S + L_Sk). For every k ≥ J: tr(R_kᵀM_kR_k) ≤ ‖R_k‖_F² tr(P_SB_k) ≤ C_Rd_k(C_S + L_Sk). General form residual_energy_step (one k: range R_k ⊆ S, ‖R_k‖_F² ≤ C_Rd_k, the smoothness bound for all k).

"On a tail with d_k ≤ 1" (the text keeps the name J; hypothesis d_k ≤ 1 for k ≥ J): there are C₁, C₂ ≥ 0 with E_{k+1} ≤ (1 + C₁d_k)(E_k - m/q_k) + C₂(k+1) for every k ≥ J. Adds the conclusion of disp/039 (C₁, C₂ ≥ 0 and the recurrence on the tail), P_{k+1} = P_k(1 + C₁d_k) with P_J = 1, and P̄ with P_k ≤ P̄ for k ≥ J (such P̄ exists by finite ∑d_k: Energy.normalization_bounds). For every N ≥ J: (m/P̄)∑_{k=J}^{N-1} q_k⁻¹ ≤ E_J + C₂∑_{k=J}^{N-1}(k+1), and the right side is O(N²) (Asymptotics.IsBigO). The scalar step is normalized_budget.

lean_coverage_records.anchor: Both branch Hessians have eigenvalues $1$ and $3$, so $F$ is strongly convex, with unique minimizer $(-1/2,0)$ and value $-1/4$.

lean_coverage_records.anchor: At zero the gradient is $(1,0)$, so $\gamma(0,0)=1$.
lean_coverage_records.note: F is differentiable at 0 with gradient (1,0) (F(x) - F(0) - x₀ = x₀² + x₁² + |x₀x₁| = O(‖x‖²)), and γ(0) = 1.

lean_coverage_records.anchor: On the other switching axis $\gamma(u,0)=|1+2u|$, vanishing only at the optimizer.

def absCert (K : Set (Vec 1)) (c₁ c₂ η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (hc₂ : c₂ < 1) :
    TransportedCertificate.BandCertificate absF K 0 c₁ c₂ η where
  W := fun _ => 1
  m := 1
  C := 1 / η
  L := 0
  δ := 1
  m_pos := one_pos
  L_nonneg := le_rfl
  delta_pos := one_pos
  positive_semidefinite := fun _ _ _ => Matrix.PosSemidef.one
  visibility := fun x hx g hg => by
    have hxb : η ≤ |x 0| := by have := hx.2; simp only [absF] at this; linarith
    have hx0 : x 0 ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, abs_zero] at hxb; linarith
    have := absF_grad hx0 hg
    simp only [metricEnergy, dot, Fin.sum_univ_one, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    split_ifs at this <;> rw [this] <;> norm_num
  secant := fun x z g h hx hz hp _ => by
    have hxb : η ≤ |x 0| := by have := hx.2; simp only [absF] at this; linarith
    have hzb : η ≤ |z 0| := by have := hz.2; simp only [absF] at this; linarith
    have hx0 : x 0 ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, abs_zero] at hxb; linarith
    have hz0 : z 0 ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, abs_zero] at hzb; linarith
    have hg := absF_grad hx0 hp.gradient_x
    have hh := absF_grad hz0 hp.gradient_z
    have hcurv := hp.curvature
    have hdec := hp.decrease_pos
    simp only [TransportedCertificate.pairCurvature, TransportedCertificate.pairDecrease,
      TransportedCertificate.pairStep, dot, Fin.sum_univ_one, Pi.sub_apply] at hcurv hdec ⊢
    simp only [metricEnergy, dot, Fin.sum_univ_one, Matrix.one_mulVec, Pi.sub_apply]
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hη]
    have hc : 0 < 1 - c₂ := by linarith
    split_ifs at hg hh with h1 h2 h2
    · rw [hg] at hdec; rw [hg, hh] at hcurv; nlinarith
    · rw [hg] at hdec; rw [hg, hh] at hcurv ⊢
      rw [abs_of_pos h1] at hxb
      rw [abs_of_neg (lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp h2) hz0)] at hzb
      nlinarith
    · rw [hg] at hdec; rw [hg, hh] at hcurv ⊢
      rw [abs_of_neg (lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp h1) hx0)] at hxb
      rw [abs_of_pos h2] at hzb
      nlinarith
    · rw [hg] at hdec; rw [hg, hh] at hcurv; nlinarith
  transport := fun x z g h _ _ hp _ => by
    have hs : TransportedCertificate.pairStep x z ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have := hp.decrease_pos
      simp [TransportedCertificate.pairDecrease, h0, dot] at this
    rw [stepProjector_one_dim hs]
    simpa using Matrix.PosSemidef.zero

theorem admissible_iff {n : ℕ} (F : Vec n → ℝ) (x : ℕ → Vec n) (H : ℕ → Mat n)

    (hs : ∀ k, s k = -α k • (H k *ᵥ g k)) (hy : ∀ k, y k = g (k + 1) - g k)
    (ht : ∀ k, t k = dot (y k) (s k)) :
    (∃ R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F,
        R.x = x ∧ R.H = H ∧ R.g = g ∧ R.α = α ∧ R.c₁ = c₁ ∧ R.c₂ = c₂) ↔
      (ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F ∧ 1 ≤ n) ∧
      (∀ k, DifferentiableAt ℝ F (x k) ∧ g k ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ v, fderiv ℝ F (x k) v = dot (g k) v) ∧
      (∀ k, x (k + 1) = x k + s k ∧
        H (k + 1) = (1 - (t k)⁻¹ • outer (s k) (y k)) * H k * (1 - (t k)⁻¹ • outer (y k) (s k)) +
          (t k)⁻¹ • outer (s k) (s k)) ∧
      ((H 0).PosDef ∧ (∀ k, 0 < α k) ∧ 0 < c₁ ∧ c₁ < c₂ ∧ c₂ < 1) ∧
      (∀ k, F (x (k + 1)) ≤ F (x k) + c₁ * dot (g k) (s k) ∧
        dot (g (k + 1)) (s k) ≥ c₂ * dot (g k) (s k))

theorem bandCertificate_iff {n : ℕ} (F : Vec n → ℝ) (b : ℝ) (K : Set (Vec n))
    (_hK_def : K = {x | F x ≤ b}) (_hK : IsCompact K) (Fstar : ℝ)
    (_hFstar : IsLeast (Set.range F) Fstar) (_hb : b > Fstar) (c₁ c₂ : ℝ)
    (_hc : 0 < c₁ ∧ c₁ < c₂ ∧ c₂ < 1) (η : ℝ) (_hη : 0 < η)
    (Kη : Set (Vec n)) (hKη : Kη = {x | x ∈ K ∧ F x ≥ Fstar + η}) :
    (∃ Cert : TransportedCertificate.BandCertificate F K Fstar c₁ c₂ η, 0 ≤ Cert.C) ↔
      ∃ (W : Vec n → Mat n) (m C L δ : ℝ), 0 < m ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ 0 ≤ L ∧ 0 < δ ∧
        (∀ x ∈ Kη, DifferentiableAt ℝ F x → (W x).PosSemidef) ∧
        (∀ x ∈ Kη, ∀ g : Vec n, HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional g) x →
          dot g (W x *ᵥ g) ≥ m) ∧
        (∀ x ∈ Kη, ∀ z ∈ Kη, ∀ g h : Vec n,
          TransportedCertificate.EligiblePair F c₁ c₂ x z g h → -dot g (z - x) ≤ δ →
            dot (h - g) (W z *ᵥ (h - g)) ≤ C * dot (h - g) (z - x)) ∧
        (∀ x ∈ Kη, ∀ z ∈ Kη, ∀ g h : Vec n,
          TransportedCertificate.EligiblePair F c₁ c₂ x z g h → -dot g (z - x) ≤ δ →
            ((1 + L * -dot g (z - x)) • (TransportedCertificate.stepProjector (z - x) * W x *
                TransportedCertificate.stepProjector (z - x)) -
              TransportedCertificate.stepProjector (z - x) * W z *
                TransportedCertificate.stepProjector (z - x)).PosSemidef)

theorem certificate {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (b : ℝ) (K : Set (Vec n))

    Tendsto (fun k => F (R.x k)) atTop (𝓝 Fstar) ∧

theorem certificate_budget_general {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F)
    (K : Set (Vec n)) (Fstar η : ℝ)
    (Cert : TransportedCertificate.BandCertificate F K Fstar R.c₁ R.c₂ η) (hC : 0 ≤ Cert.C)
    (hsum : Summable R.d) (E : ℕ → ℝ) (hE : ∀ k, E k = (R.hessian k * Cert.W (R.x k)).trace)
    (J N : ℕ) (hJN : J ≤ N)
    (hband : ∀ k, J ≤ k → k ≤ N → R.x k ∈ {x | x ∈ K ∧ F x ≥ Fstar + η})
    (hsmall : ∀ k, J ≤ k → k < N → R.d k ≤ Cert.δ)
    (Pbar : ℝ) (hPbar : Pbar = Real.exp (Cert.L * ∑' j, R.d (J + j))) :
    Cert.m / Pbar * ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico J N, (R.q k)⁻¹ ≤ E J + Cert.C * ((N : ℝ) - J)

theorem certificate_energy_step {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (b : ℝ) (K : Set (Vec n))
    (hK_def : K = {x | F x ≤ b}) (_hK : IsCompact K) (Fstar : ℝ)
    (_hFstar : IsLeast (Set.range F) Fstar) (_hb : b > Fstar) (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F)
    (_hcert : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → {x | x ∈ K ∧ F x ≥ Fstar + η}.Nonempty →
      ∃ Cert : TransportedCertificate.BandCertificate F K Fstar R.c₁ R.c₂ η, 0 ≤ Cert.C)
    (hx0 : R.x 0 ∈ K) (ℓ : ℝ) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ)
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun k => F (R.x k) - Fstar) atTop (𝓝 ℓ))
    (Cert : TransportedCertificate.BandCertificate F K Fstar R.c₁ R.c₂ (ℓ / 2))
    (_hC : 0 ≤ Cert.C) (J : ℕ) (hJ : ∀ k, J ≤ k → R.d k ≤ Cert.δ)
    (E : ℕ → ℝ) (hE : ∀ k, E k = (R.hessian k * Cert.W (R.x k)).trace)
    (Bhat : ℕ → Mat n)
    (hBhat : ∀ k, Bhat k = R.hessian k - (R.q k)⁻¹ • outer (R.g k) (R.g k)) :
    ∀ k, J ≤ k →
      E (k + 1) = (Bhat k * Cert.W (R.x (k + 1))).trace +
          dot (R.gradientChange k) (Cert.W (R.x (k + 1)) *ᵥ R.gradientChange k) /
            R.curvature k ∧
        (Bhat k * Cert.W (R.x (k + 1))).trace +
            dot (R.gradientChange k) (Cert.W (R.x (k + 1)) *ᵥ R.gradientChange k) /
              R.curvature k ≤
          (1 + Cert.L * R.d k) * (Bhat k * Cert.W (R.x k)).trace + Cert.C ∧
        (1 + Cert.L * R.d k) * (Bhat k * Cert.W (R.x k)).trace + Cert.C ≤
          (1 + Cert.L * R.d k) * (E k - Cert.m / R.q k) + Cert.C

          ∃ Cert : TransportedCertificate.BandCertificate F {x | F x ≤ b} 0 (1 / 4) (1 / 2) η,

theorem certificate_step_general {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F)
    (K : Set (Vec n)) (Fstar η : ℝ)

theorem compression_bound {n : ℕ} (H Hplus : Mat n) (g y s : Vec n) (α q β : ℝ)

    (Zᵀ * Hplus * Z).det ≤
      (metricGram H (fromCols (replicateCol Unit y) Z)).det / (β ^ 2 * q) +

BfgsCoverage.Article.Energy.eigenbasis_g.statement:
theorem eigenbasis_gram_sum {n : ℕ} (H Hplus : Mat n) (g y s : Vec n) (α q β : ℝ)
    (_hH : H.PosDef) (_hs : s = -α • (H *ᵥ g)) (_hα : 0 < α)
    (_hq_def : q = dot g (H *ᵥ g)) (_hq : 0 < q)
    (_hβ_def : β = -dot y (H *ᵥ g) / q) (_hβ : 0 < β)
    (_hHplus : Hplus = inverseBFGS H s y) (j : ℕ) (_hj : 1 ≤ j) (_hjn : j ≤ n)
    (U : Mat n) (hU : Uᵀ * U = 1) (lam : Fin n → ℝ) (hHU : H * U = U * Matrix.diagonal lam)
    (hlam : ∀ i, 0 < lam i) (yc : Vec n) (hyc : yc = Uᵀ *ᵥ y) :
    ∑ I ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard j,
        (metricGram H (fromCols (replicateCol Unit y)
          (U.submatrix id (fun i : I => (i : Fin n))))).det =
      ∑ I ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard j,
        (∏ i ∈ I, lam i) * ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.univ \ I, lam ℓ * yc ℓ ^ 2 ∧
    ∑ I ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard j,
        (∏ i ∈ I, lam i) * ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.univ \ I, lam ℓ * yc ℓ ^ 2 =
      ∑ J ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard (j + 1),
        (∏ i ∈ J, lam i) * ∑ ℓ ∈ J, yc ℓ ^ 2 ∧
    ∑ J ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard (j + 1),
        (∏ i ∈ J, lam i) * ∑ ℓ ∈ J, yc ℓ ^ 2 ≤ sqNorm y * principalSum H (j + 1)

        (η + DJ / ((1 - R.c₂) * ((m : ℝ) - 1))) ^ (-((m : ℝ) - 1) / (m : ℝ)) ≤

theorem library_formulas {n : ℕ} (H : Mat n) (g s y a b : Vec n) (α : ℝ) :

BfgsCoverage.Article.Energy.nonsmooth_op.statement:
theorem nonsmooth_optimizer_certificates :
    ∃ F : Vec 1 → ℝ, (∀ x, F x = |x 0|) ∧ ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F ∧ IsLeast (Set.range F) 0 ∧
      F 0 = 0 ∧ (∀ x, F x = 0 → x = 0) ∧ ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ F 0 ∧
      (∀ b : ℝ, IsCompact {x | F x ≤ b}) ∧
      ∀ b c₁ c₂ : ℝ, b > 0 → 0 < c₁ → c₁ < c₂ → c₂ < 1 →
        ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → {x | x ∈ {x | F x ≤ b} ∧ F x ≥ 0 + η}.Nonempty →
          ∃ Cert : TransportedCertificate.BandCertificate F {x | F x ≤ b} 0 c₁ c₂ η,
            0 ≤ Cert.C

    (hP : ∀ k, J ≤ k → P (k + 1) = P k * (1 + L * R.d k)) :
    ∀ k, J ≤ k → 1 ≤ P k ∧ P k ≤ Real.exp (L * ∑' j, R.d (J + j))

BfgsCoverage.Article.Energy.normalized_h.statement:
theorem normalized_hierarchy {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F)
    (_hbdd : ∃ Λ : ℝ, ∀ k, ‖euclideanVector (R.g k)‖ ≤ Λ) (_hd : Tendsto R.d atTop (𝓝 0))
    (Λ : ℝ) (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (hgΛ : ∀ k, ‖euclideanVector (R.g k)‖ ≤ Λ)
    (K0 : ℝ) (hK0 : K0 = 4 * Λ ^ 2 / (1 - R.c₂) ^ 2) (k j : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hjn : j ≤ n) :
    R.q k * principalSum (R.H (k + 1)) j ≤
      K0 * principalSum (R.H k) (j + 1) + R.d k / (1 - R.c₂) * principalSum (R.H k) j

BfgsCoverage.Article.Energy.notation_dis.statement:
theorem notation_display {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) (k : ℕ) :
    R.hessian k = (R.H k)⁻¹ ∧ R.q k = dot (R.g k) (R.H k *ᵥ R.g k) ∧
      R.d k = -dot (R.g k) (R.displacement k) ∧
      -dot (R.g k) (R.displacement k) = R.α k * R.q k

BfgsCoverage.Article.Energy.persistent_g.statement:
theorem persistent_gap_budget {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F)
    (xstar : Vec n) (hmin : ∀ z, F xstar ≤ F z) (Fstar : ℝ) (hFstar : Fstar = F xstar)
    (r : ℕ → Vec n) (hr : ∀ k, r k = R.x k - xstar)
    (E : ℕ → ℝ) (hE : ∀ k, E k = dot (r k) (R.hessian k *ᵥ r k))
    (Rk : ℕ → ℝ) (hRk : ∀ k, Rk k = dot (R.gradientChange k) (r (k + 1)) ^ 2 / R.curvature k)
    (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (hgap : ∀ k, F (R.x k) - Fstar ≥ η)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : ∀ k, Rk k ≤ C) (N : ℕ) :
    η ^ 2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, (R.q k)⁻¹ ≤ E 0 + C * N

theorem persistent_gap_budget_general {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F)
    (xstar : Vec n) (hmin : ∀ z, F xstar ≤ F z) (Fstar : ℝ) (hFstar : Fstar = F xstar)

    (C : ℝ) (hC : ∀ k, k < N → Rk k ≤ C) :

theorem persistent_gap_contradiction {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F)

BfgsCoverage.Article.Energy.potential_co.statement:
theorem potential_contraction {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F)
    (_hbdd : ∃ Λ : ℝ, ∀ k, ‖euclideanVector (R.g k)‖ ≤ Λ) (_hd : Tendsto R.d atTop (𝓝 0))
    (Λ : ℝ) (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (hgΛ : ∀ k, ‖euclideanVector (R.g k)‖ ≤ Λ)
    (K0 : ℝ) (hK0 : K0 = 4 * Λ ^ 2 / (1 - R.c₂) ^ 2)
    (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (J : ℕ) (hJ : ∀ k, J ≤ k → R.d k / (1 - R.c₂) ≤ η)
    (V : Mat n → ℝ)
    (hV : ∀ H : Mat n, H.PosDef →
      V H = ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (K0 / η) ^ (j - 1) * principalSum H j) :
    (∀ k, J ≤ k → V (R.H (k + 1)) ≤ 2 * η / R.q k * V (R.H k)) ∧
      ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m →
        ∏ k ∈ Finset.Ico J (J + m), (R.q k)⁻¹ ≥ 1 / (Λ ^ 2 * V (R.H J) * (2 * η) ^ (m - 1))

BfgsCoverage.Article.Energy.principalSum.statement:
theorem principalSum_def {n : ℕ} (H : Mat n) (j : ℕ) :
    principalSum H j = ∑ I ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard j,
        (H.submatrix (fun i : I => (i : Fin n)) (fun i : I => (i : Fin n))).det ∧
      principalSum H (n + 1) = 0

BfgsCoverage.Article.Energy.principal_su.statement:
theorem principal_sums_coefficients {n : ℕ} (H : Mat n) (hH : H.IsHermitian) :
    (∀ j : ℕ, (Matrix.det (1 + (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℝ) • H.map Polynomial.C)).coeff j =
      principalSum H j) ∧
    (∀ z : ℝ, (1 + z • H).det = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), principalSum H j * z ^ j) ∧
    (∀ Q : Mat n, Qᵀ * Q = 1 → ∀ j : ℕ, principalSum (Qᵀ * H * Q) j = principalSum H j) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, principalSum H j = (Multiset.map hH.eigenvalues Finset.univ.val).esymm j)

BfgsCoverage.Article.Energy.principal_tr.statement:
theorem principal_trace_det {n : ℕ} (H : Mat n) (_hH : H.IsSymm) :
    principalSum H 1 = H.trace ∧ principalSum H n = H.det

BfgsCoverage.Article.Energy.projection_n.statement:
theorem projection_no_cost {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F)
    (Bhat : ℕ → Mat n)
    (hBhat : ∀ k, Bhat k = R.hessian k - (R.q k)⁻¹ • outer (R.g k) (R.g k)) (k : ℕ) :
    (∀ (v : Vec n) (c : ℝ), dot (v + c • R.displacement k)
        (Bhat k *ᵥ (v + c • R.displacement k)) = dot v (Bhat k *ᵥ v)) ∧
      TransportedCertificate.stepProjector (R.displacement k) * Bhat k *
          TransportedCertificate.stepProjector (R.displacement k) = Bhat k ∧
      ∀ W : Mat n, (Bhat k * W).trace =
        (Bhat k * (TransportedCertificate.stepProjector (R.displacement k) * W *
          TransportedCertificate.stepProjector (R.displacement k))).trace

      V H = ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (K0 / η) ^ (j - 1) * principalSum H j) (k : ℕ) :

BfgsCoverage.Article.Energy.reference_en.statement:
theorem reference_energy {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) (xstar : Vec n)
    (r : ℕ → Vec n) (hr : ∀ k, r k = R.x k - xstar)
    (E : ℕ → ℝ) (hE : ∀ k, E k = dot (r k) (R.hessian k *ᵥ r k))
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ k, a k = dot (R.g k) (r k))
    (Rk : ℕ → ℝ) (hRk : ∀ k, Rk k = dot (R.gradientChange k) (r (k + 1)) ^ 2 / R.curvature k)
    (Fstar : ℝ) (hFstar : Fstar = F xstar) :
    (∀ k, E (k + 1) = E k - a k ^ 2 / R.q k + Rk k) ∧
      ((∀ z, F xstar ≤ F z) → ∀ N : ℕ,
        (F (R.x N) - Fstar) ^ 2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, (R.q k)⁻¹ ≤
          E 0 + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, Rk k)

theorem reference_notation {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) (xstar : Vec n)

BfgsCoverage.Article.Energy.run_bounds.statement:
theorem run_bounds {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F)
    (_hbdd : ∃ Λ : ℝ, ∀ k, ‖euclideanVector (R.g k)‖ ≤ Λ) (_hd : Tendsto R.d atTop (𝓝 0))
    (Λ : ℝ) (_hΛ : 0 < Λ) (hgΛ : ∀ k, ‖euclideanVector (R.g k)‖ ≤ Λ)
    (K0 : ℝ) (_hK0 : K0 = 4 * Λ ^ 2 / (1 - R.c₂) ^ 2) (k : ℕ) :
    R.beta k = R.curvature k / R.d k ∧ R.curvature k / R.d k ≥ 1 - R.c₂ ∧
      ‖euclideanVector (R.gradientChange k)‖ ≤ 2 * Λ ∧ R.α k = R.d k / R.q k

BfgsCoverage.Article.Energy.run_invarian.statement:
theorem run_invariants {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F)
    (Bhat : ℕ → Mat n)
    (hBhat : ∀ k, Bhat k = R.hessian k - (R.q k)⁻¹ • outer (R.g k) (R.g k)) :
    (∀ k, (R.H k).PosDef ∧ 0 < R.q k ∧ 0 < R.d k ∧ 0 < R.curvature k) ∧
      (∀ k, R.c₁ * R.d k ≤ F (R.x k) - F (R.x (k + 1)) ∧
        F (R.x k) - F (R.x (k + 1)) ≤ R.d k ∧ R.curvature k ≥ (1 - R.c₂) * R.d k) ∧
      (∀ k, R.hessian (k + 1) = R.hessian k - (R.q k)⁻¹ • outer (R.g k) (R.g k) +
          (R.curvature k)⁻¹ • outer (R.gradientChange k) (R.gradientChange k) ∧
        (Bhat k).PosSemidef ∧ Bhat k *ᵥ R.displacement k = 0) ∧
      ((∃ ℓ : ℝ, Tendsto (fun k => F (R.x k)) atTop (𝓝 ℓ)) → Summable R.d)

BfgsCoverage.Article.Energy.run_notation.statement:
theorem run_notation {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) (k : ℕ) :
    R.displacement k = -R.α k • (R.H k *ᵥ R.g k) ∧ R.gradientChange k = R.g (k + 1) - R.g k ∧
      R.curvature k = dot (R.gradientChange k) (R.displacement k) ∧
      R.hessian k = (R.H k)⁻¹ ∧ R.q k = dot (R.g k) (R.H k *ᵥ R.g k) ∧
      R.d k = R.α k * R.q k ∧
      R.beta k = -dot (R.gradientChange k) (R.H k *ᵥ R.g k) / R.q k

      ∃ x z g h : Vec 1, HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional g) x ∧
        HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional h) z ∧ sqNorm (z - x) = 4 * ε ^ 2 ∧
        sqNorm (h - g) = 4

BfgsCoverage.Article.Energy.update_formu.statement:
theorem update_formula {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) (k : ℕ) :
    R.displacement k = -R.α k • (R.H k *ᵥ R.g k) ∧ R.x (k + 1) = R.x k + R.displacement k ∧
      R.gradientChange k = R.g (k + 1) - R.g k ∧
      R.H (k + 1) = (1 - (R.curvature k)⁻¹ • outer (R.displacement k) (R.gradientChange k)) *
          R.H k * (1 - (R.curvature k)⁻¹ • outer (R.gradientChange k) (R.displacement k)) +
        (R.curvature k)⁻¹ • outer (R.displacement k) (R.displacement k) ∧
      R.curvature k = dot (R.gradientChange k) (R.displacement k)

theorem accepted_pass_tests (q : Fin 9) (hq : trialAccept q = true) :

def InwardModelCondition {n : ℕ} (F : Vec n → ℝ) (xstar : Vec n) (K : Set (Vec n)) : Prop :=
  ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ M θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ 0 < θ ∧ θ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
    ∀ x g : Vec n, x ∈ K → HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional g) x → F xstar + η ≤ F x →
      ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ θ →
        0 ≤ F (x - τ • (x - xstar)) - F x + τ * dot g (x - xstar) ∧
          F (x - τ • (x - xstar)) - F x + τ * dot g (x - xstar) ≤ M / 2 * τ ^ 2

def RadialSecantCondition {n : ℕ} (F : Vec n → ℝ) (xstar : Vec n) (K : Set (Vec n)) : Prop :=
  ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
    ∀ x z g h : Vec n, x ∈ K → z ∈ K →
      HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional g) x → HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional h) z →
      F xstar + η ≤ F z → F z ≤ F x → 0 < dot (h - g) (z - x) →
      (dot (h - g) (z - xstar)) ^ 2 ≤ C * dot (h - g) (z - x)

    (fun k => by
      rcases neg_one_pow_cases k with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩ <;> simp only [h1, h2, pow_succ] <;>

    (fun k => by

          R.g k = ![0, (-1 : ℝ) ^ k] ∧
          R.H k = Matrix.diagonal ![1, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k] ∧ R.α k = 1) ∧
        (∀ k, Mixed.objective (R.x k) ≤ 2 / 3) ∧
        (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → η ≤ 2 / 3 →
          ∃ B : TransportedCertificate.BandCertificate Mixed.objective
              {x | Mixed.objective x ≤ 2 / 3} 0 R.c₁ R.c₂ η,
            B.W = (fun x => outer x x) ∧ B.m = η ^ 2 ∧ B.C = 2 * (2 / 3) ∧
              B.L = 0 ∧ B.δ = 1 ∧ 0 ≤ B.C) ∧
        (∀ k, IsLeast ((fun v : Vec 2 => metricEnergy (R.H k) v) ''
          {v : Vec 2 | sqNorm v = 1}) ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k)) ∧
        Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
        Tendsto (fun k => Mixed.objective (R.x k)) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
        Tendsto R.x atTop (𝓝 0)

theorem mixed_history_scalars (k : ℕ) :
    Mixed.run.d k = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k ∧
      Mixed.objective (Mixed.run.x k) - Mixed.objective (Mixed.run.x (k + 1)) =
        (1 / 3) * Mixed.run.d k ∧
      Mixed.run.curvature k = 2 * Mixed.run.d k

theorem mixed_least_spectrum (k : ℕ) :
    IsLeast (spectrum ℝ (Mixed.run.H k)) ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k)

theorem mixed_opposite_sign_secants (b : ℝ) (_hb : 0 < b) (x z g h : Vec 2)
    (_hxK : Mixed.objective x ≤ b) (_hzK : Mixed.objective z ≤ b)
    (hg : HasFDerivAt Mixed.objective (gradientFunctional g) x)
    (hh : HasFDerivAt Mixed.objective (gradientFunctional h) z)
    (y : Vec 2) (hy : y = h - g) (t : ℝ) (ht : t = dot y (z - x))
    (S : ℝ) (hS : S = |x 1| + |z 1|)
    (hsign : (0 < x 1 ∧ z 1 < 0) ∨ (x 1 < 0 ∧ 0 < z 1)) :
    0 < S ∧ t = 2 * (z 0 - x 0) ^ 2 + 2 * S ∧
      dot y z = 2 * (z 0 - x 0) * z 0 + 2 * |z 1|

theorem mixed_same_sign_secants (b : ℝ) (_hb : 0 < b) (x z g h : Vec 2)
    (_hxK : Mixed.objective x ≤ b) (_hzK : Mixed.objective z ≤ b)
    (hg : HasFDerivAt Mixed.objective (gradientFunctional g) x)
    (hh : HasFDerivAt Mixed.objective (gradientFunctional h) z)
    (y : Vec 2) (hy : y = h - g) (t : ℝ) (ht : t = dot y (z - x))
    (hsign : (0 < x 1 ∧ 0 < z 1) ∨ (x 1 < 0 ∧ z 1 < 0)) :
    t = 2 * (z 0 - x 0) ^ 2 ∧ dot y z = 2 * (z 0 - x 0) * z 0 ∧
      (dot y z) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Mixed.objective z * t

theorem mixed_smallest_eigenvalue :
    (∀ k : ℕ,
      IsLeast ((fun v : Vec 2 => metricEnergy (Mixed.run.H k) v) ''
        {v : Vec 2 | sqNorm v = 1}) ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) ∧
      sqNorm (![0, 1] : Vec 2) = 1 ∧

        ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) • (![0, 1] : Vec 2)) ∧

theorem paperRegularAt_iff (F : Vec 2 → ℝ) (p : Vec 2) :

      (∃ V : Set (Vec 2), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 F V) ∨
      (∃ V : Set (Vec 2), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧ ∃ f₀ f₁ : Vec 2 → ℝ,
        ConvexOn ℝ V f₀ ∧ ConvexOn ℝ V f₁ ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f₀ V ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f₁ V ∧
        (∀ z ∈ V, F z = max (f₀ z) (f₁ z)) ∧ f₀ p = F p ∧ f₁ p = F p ∧
        LinearIndependent ℝ ![coordinateGradient f₀ p, coordinateGradient f₁ p])

theorem planarHypotheses_iff (F : Vec 2 → ℝ) (B : ℝ) :

      (∀ t, 0 < t → t ≤ B → ∀ x y : Vec 2,
        segment ℝ x y ⊆ frontier {z | F z ≤ t} → x = y) ∧
      (∀ p, F p ≤ B → ¬ AffineCriticalObjective.IsAffineCritical F p →
        ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F p ∨ PlanarCornerCharts.ConvexTwoBranchRegularAt F p) ∧
      (∀ p, F p ≤ B → AffineCriticalObjective.IsAffineCritical F p →

theorem quadratic_certificates {n : ℕ} (_hn : 1 ≤ n) (b : ℝ) (_hb : 0 < b)
    (c₁ c₂ : ℝ) (_hc₁ : 0 < c₁) (_hc₁₂ : c₁ < c₂) (_hc₂ : c₂ < 1) :
    (∀ x : Vec n, Quadratic.objective x = ‖euclideanVector x‖ ^ 2 / 2) ∧
      ConvexOn ℝ univ (@Quadratic.objective n) ∧
      IsLeast (range (@Quadratic.objective n)) 0 ∧
      (∀ x : Vec n, Quadratic.objective x = 0 ↔ x = 0) ∧
      IsCompact {x : Vec n | Quadratic.objective x ≤ b} ∧
      ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → η ≤ b →
        ∃ B : TransportedCertificate.BandCertificate (@Quadratic.objective n)
            {x | Quadratic.objective x ≤ b} 0 c₁ c₂ η,
          B.W = (fun _ => 1) ∧ B.m = 2 * η ∧ B.C = 1 ∧ B.L = 0 ∧ B.δ = 1 ∧
            0 ≤ B.C ∧ ∀ x, (B.W x).PosDef ∧ (B.W x).rank = n

theorem quadratic_history {n : ℕ} (_hn : 1 ≤ n) (x₀ : Vec n) (hx₀ : x₀ ≠ 0) :
    ConvexOn ℝ univ (@Quadratic.objective n) ∧
      (∀ x : Vec n, Quadratic.objective x = 0 ↔ x = 0) ∧
      ∃ (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n Quadratic.objective) (b : ℝ),
        R.x 0 = x₀ ∧ R.H = (fun _ => 1) ∧ R.c₁ = 1 / 4 ∧ R.c₂ = 1 / 2 ∧
        (∀ k, R.x k = ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) • x₀ ∧ R.g k = R.x k ∧ R.α k = 1 / 2) ∧
        b = Quadratic.objective x₀ ∧ 0 < b ∧
        IsCompact {x : Vec n | Quadratic.objective x ≤ b} ∧
        IsLeast (range (@Quadratic.objective n)) 0 ∧ Quadratic.objective (R.x 0) ≤ b ∧
        (∀ k, Quadratic.objective (R.x k) ≤ b) ∧
        (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η →
          ∃ B : TransportedCertificate.BandCertificate (@Quadratic.objective n)
              {x | Quadratic.objective x ≤ b} 0 R.c₁ R.c₂ η,
            B.W = (fun _ => 1) ∧ B.m = 2 * η ∧ B.C = 1 ∧ B.L = 0 ∧ B.δ = 1 ∧
              0 ≤ B.C ∧ ∀ x, (B.W x).PosDef ∧ (B.W x).rank = n) ∧
        Tendsto (fun k => Quadratic.objective (R.x k)) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
        Tendsto R.x atTop (𝓝 0)

theorem quadratic_history_decrease {n : ℕ} (x₀ : Vec n) (hx₀ : x₀ ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    let R := Quadratic.run x₀ hx₀
    Quadratic.objective (R.x k) - Quadratic.objective (R.x (k + 1)) =
        (3 / 4) * R.d k ∧
      dot (R.g (k + 1)) (R.displacement k) = R.c₂ * dot (R.g k) (R.displacement k)

theorem strict_wolfe_step {n : ℕ} (_hn : 1 ≤ n) {F : Vec n → ℝ}
    (hconv : ConvexOn ℝ univ F) (hbdd : BddBelow (range F))

      {t : ℝ | ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ F (x + t • p)}.Countable)
    {x g : Vec n} (hg : HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional g) x) (hg0 : g ≠ 0)
    {H : Mat n} (hH : H.PosDef) {c₁ c₂ : ℝ}
    (hc₁ : 0 < c₁) (hc₁₂ : c₁ < c₂) (hc₂ : c₂ < 1)

    ∃ α : ℝ, 0 < α ∧ ∃ h : Vec n,
      HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional h) (x + α • p) ∧
      F (x + α • p) < F x + c₁ * α * dot g p ∧ c₂ * dot g p < dot h p

theorem two_quadratic_objective_geometry (a b c : ℝ)

      (∀ x, TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c x = 0 ↔ x = 0) ∧
      (∀ B : ℝ, IsCompact {x | TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c x ≤ B}) ∧
      (∀ x : Vec 2,
        TwoQuadraticExample.branch a b c 0 x = TwoQuadraticExample.branch a b c 1 x ↔
          x 1 = (c - a) * (x 0) ^ 2 / 2) ∧
      (∀ x : Vec 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c) x ↔
        x 1 ≠ (c - a) * (x 0) ^ 2 / 2) ∧

theorem two_quadratic_planar_hypotheses (a b c : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B) :
    ConvexOn ℝ univ (TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c) ∧
      IsLeast (range (TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c)) 0 ∧ 0 < B ∧
      IsCompact {x | TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c x ≤ B} ∧
      (∀ t, 0 < t → t ≤ B → ∀ x y : Vec 2,
        segment ℝ x y ⊆ frontier {z | TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c z ≤ t} → x = y) ∧
      (∀ p, TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c p ≤ B →
        ¬ AffineCriticalObjective.IsAffineCritical (TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c) p →
        (∃ V : Set (Vec 2), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
          ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c) V) ∨
        (∃ V : Set (Vec 2), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧ ∃ f₀ f₁ : Vec 2 → ℝ,
          ConvexOn ℝ V f₀ ∧ ConvexOn ℝ V f₁ ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f₀ V ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f₁ V ∧
          (∀ z ∈ V, TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c z = max (f₀ z) (f₁ z)) ∧
          f₀ p = TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c p ∧
          f₁ p = TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c p ∧
          LinearIndependent ℝ ![coordinateGradient f₀ p, coordinateGradient f₁ p])) ∧
      {p | AffineCriticalObjective.IsAffineCritical (TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c) p} ∩
        {x | TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c x ≤ B} ⊆
          argmin (TwoQuadraticExample.objective a b c)

theorem two_quadratic_tie_determinant (a b c : ℝ)

    (Q : ι → Mat n) (c : ι → Vec n) (d : ι → ℝ)
    (hrep : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ P i, reg x = dot x (Q i *ᵥ x) + dot (c i) x + d i)
    (hFdef : ∀ x, F x = loss x + reg x) (xstar : Vec n) (hmin : ∀ x, F xstar ≤ F x)

theorem polyhedral_inward_taylor {n : ℕ} (_hn : 1 ≤ n) (F : Vec n → ℝ)
    (hF : ConvexOn ℝ univ F) (xstar : Vec n) (_hmin : ∀ x, F xstar ≤ F x)
    (_huniq : ∀ x, F x = F xstar → x = xstar) (U : Set (Vec n)) (_hU : IsOpen U)
    (_hxU : xstar ∈ U) {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (m : ι → ℕ) (a : ∀ i, Fin (m i) → Vec n)
    (b : ∀ i, Fin (m i) → ℝ) (P : ι → Set (Vec n))
    (hP : ∀ i, P i = {x | ∀ j, dot (a i j) x ≤ b i j})
    (_hfull : ∀ i, (interior (P i)).Nonempty) (_hcover : U ⊆ ⋃ i, P i)
    (V : ι → Set (Vec n)) (hV : ∀ i, IsOpen (V i)) (_hUV : ∀ i, U ∩ P i ⊆ V i)
    (f : ι → Vec n → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, CenteredSmoothSublinear.LocallyC11On (V i) (f i))
    (hrep : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ U ∩ P i, F x = f i x)
    (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (B : Set (Vec n)) (hB : B = {x | ‖euclideanVector (x - xstar)‖ < r})
    (hBU : B ⊆ U) (hBV : ∀ i, xstar ∈ P i → B ⊆ V i)
    (hdisc : ∀ i, (B ∩ P i).Nonempty → xstar ∈ P i) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hLip : ∀ i, xstar ∈ P i → ∀ y ∈ B, ∀ y' ∈ B,
      ‖euclideanVector (coordinateGradient (f i) y - coordinateGradient (f i) y')‖ ≤
        L * ‖euclideanVector (y - y')‖)
    (x g : Vec n) (hxB : x ∈ B) (hg : HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional g) x) (i : ι)
    (hxi : x ∈ P i) (τ : ℝ) (hτ0 : 0 ≤ τ) (hτ1 : τ ≤ 1) :
    0 ≤ F (x - τ • (x - xstar)) - F x + τ * dot g (x - xstar) ∧
      F (x - τ • (x - xstar)) - F x + τ * dot g (x - xstar) ≤
        1 / 2 * L * τ ^ 2 * sqNorm (x - xstar) ∧
      1 / 2 * L * τ ^ 2 * sqNorm (x - xstar) ≤ 1 / 2 * L * r ^ 2 * τ ^ 2

        LEmbedding.copyCenter ℓ + LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ • (LUniform.source.x k +
          a • bfgsStep (LUniform.source.H k)
            (coordinateGradient (LQuadraticSeed.objective LEmbedding.mu) (LUniform.source.x k)) 1) ∧
      LUniform.source.x k + a • bfgsStep (LUniform.source.H k)
          (coordinateGradient (LQuadraticSeed.objective LEmbedding.mu) (LUniform.source.x k)) 1 ∈
        LEmbedding.localDomain ∧
      LEmbedding.objective (LEmbedding.copyCenter ℓ + LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ • (LUniform.source.x k +
          a • bfgsStep (LUniform.source.H k)
            (coordinateGradient (LQuadraticSeed.objective LEmbedding.mu) (LUniform.source.x k)) 1)) -
        LEmbedding.objective (LEmbedding.copyCenter ℓ + LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ • LUniform.source.x k) =
        LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ ^ 2 * (LQuadraticSeed.objective LEmbedding.mu (LUniform.source.x k +
          a • bfgsStep (LUniform.source.H k)
            (coordinateGradient (LQuadraticSeed.objective LEmbedding.mu) (LUniform.source.x k)) 1) -

          (LUniform.source.x k + a • bfgsStep (LUniform.source.H k)
            (coordinateGradient (LQuadraticSeed.objective LEmbedding.mu) (LUniform.source.x k)) 1)))
          (LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ • bfgsStep (LUniform.source.H k)
            (coordinateGradient (LQuadraticSeed.objective LEmbedding.mu) (LUniform.source.x k)) 1) =
        LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ ^ 2 * dot (coordinateGradient (LQuadraticSeed.objective LEmbedding.mu)
            (LUniform.source.x k + a • bfgsStep (LUniform.source.H k)
              (coordinateGradient (LQuadraticSeed.objective LEmbedding.mu) (LUniform.source.x k)) 1))
          (bfgsStep (LUniform.source.H k)
            (coordinateGradient (LQuadraticSeed.objective LEmbedding.mu) (LUniform.source.x k)) 1)

theorem embedding_constants_def :

      (∀ i, LEmbedding.parameter i = dot (LEmbedding.slope i) LEmbedding.center) ∧

theorem finite_max_local_taylor {n m : ℕ} (F : Vec n → ℝ) (f : Fin m → Vec n → ℝ)
    (g : Fin m → Vec n → Vec n) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hne : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).Nonempty)
    (hF : ∀ z, F z = Finset.univ.sup' hne (fun i => f i z))
    (hg : ∀ i z, HasFDerivAt (f i) (gradientFunctional (g i z)) z)
    (hlip : ∀ i z w, sqNorm (g i z - g i w) ≤ L ^ 2 * sqNorm (z - w))
    (x a : Vec n) (hx : HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional a) x) :
    (∀ i, f i x = F x → g i x = a) ∧ (∀ i, f i x < F x → ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, f i z < F z) ∧
      ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, F z ≤ F x + dot a (z - x) + L / 2 * sqNorm (z - x)

theorem gbar_def :

theorem gbar_least_norm :
    LQuadraticSeed.gbar ∈ convexHull ℝ {g0, g1, g2 seedC seedD} ∧
      (∀ g ∈ convexHull ℝ {g0, g1, g2 seedC seedD},
        ‖euclideanVector LQuadraticSeed.gbar‖ ≤ ‖euclideanVector g‖) ∧
      (∀ g ∈ convexHull ℝ {g0, g1, g2 seedC seedD},
        ‖euclideanVector g‖ = ‖euclideanVector LQuadraticSeed.gbar‖ → g = LQuadraticSeed.gbar) ∧
      dot g0 LQuadraticSeed.gbar = 1 / 257 ∧ dot g1 LQuadraticSeed.gbar = 1 / 257 ∧
      sqNorm LQuadraticSeed.gbar = 1 / 257 ∧ 1 / 257 < dot (g2 seedC seedD) LQuadraticSeed.gbar

theorem local_model_reasons (ℓ : ℕ) (y : Vec 2) (hy : y ∈ LEmbedding.localDomain) :

      LScalar.phi (LEmbedding.parameter i)

        LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ ^ 2 +
          LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ * (LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ * dot (LEmbedding.slope i) y)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 3, LEmbedding.slope i + LEmbedding.mu • LEmbedding.center = SeedOrbit.gradient seedC seedD i) ∧
      (LEmbedding.copyCenter ℓ + LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ • y) 1 = LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ * (-32 + y 1) ∧
      (LEmbedding.copyCenter ℓ + LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ • y) 1 < 0 ∧

        (dot (LEmbedding.slope i) (LEmbedding.copyCenter ℓ + LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ • y))

theorem lower_hyperbolic (μ : ℝ) (_hμ : 0 < μ) :
    (∃ N ∈ 𝓝 LNormalizedReturn.seed, ∀ w ∈ N, 0 < LNormalizedReturn.scale w →
      ∀ c₁ c₂ : ℝ, 0 < c₁ → c₁ ≤ 1/3 → c₁ < c₂ → c₂ < 1 →
        ∃ (x : Fin 4 → Vec 2) (H : Fin 4 → Mat 2),
          x 0 = LNormalizedReturn.scale w • LNormalizedReturn.point w ∧
          H 0 = LNormalizedReturn.scale w • LNormalizedReturn.shape w ∧
          (∀ j : Fin 3, (H j.castSucc).PosDef ∧
            DifferentiableAt ℝ (LQuadraticSeed.objective μ) (x j.castSucc) ∧
            (∀ k, k ≠ j → LQuadraticSeed.branch μ k (x j.castSucc) <
              LQuadraticSeed.branch μ j (x j.castSucc)) ∧
            (∀ q : Fin 9, trialPhase q = j → ∀ k, k ≠ trialActive q →
              LQuadraticSeed.branch μ k (x j.castSucc + trialLength q • bfgsStep (H j.castSucc)
                (coordinateGradient (LQuadraticSeed.objective μ) (x j.castSucc)) 1) <
              LQuadraticSeed.branch μ (trialActive q) (x j.castSucc + trialLength q • bfgsStep (H j.castSucc)
                (coordinateGradient (LQuadraticSeed.objective μ) (x j.castSucc)) 1)) ∧
            (∀ N, 5 ≤ N → NonStrictLineSearch.fromMetric (LQuadraticSeed.objective μ) (x j.castSucc)
              (H j.castSucc) c₁ c₂ N = (some (SeedOrbit.length j), trialHistory j)) ∧
            (∀ a ∈ trialHistory j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (LQuadraticSeed.objective μ)
              (x j.castSucc + a • bfgsStep (H j.castSucc)
                (coordinateGradient (LQuadraticSeed.objective μ) (x j.castSucc)) 1)) ∧
            x j.succ = x j.castSucc + bfgsStep (H j.castSucc)
              (coordinateGradient (LQuadraticSeed.objective μ) (x j.castSucc)) (SeedOrbit.length j) ∧
            H j.succ = inverseBFGS (H j.castSucc) (x j.succ - x j.castSucc)
              (coordinateGradient (LQuadraticSeed.objective μ) (x j.succ) -
                coordinateGradient (LQuadraticSeed.objective μ) (x j.castSucc))) ∧
          x 3 = LNormalizedReturn.scale (LNormalizedReturn.returnMap μ w) •
            LNormalizedReturn.point (LNormalizedReturn.returnMap μ w) ∧
          H 3 = LNormalizedReturn.scale (LNormalizedReturn.returnMap μ w) •
            LNormalizedReturn.shape (LNormalizedReturn.returnMap μ w)) ∧
      (∃ ls lu : ℝ, ((0.038 : ℝ) < ls ∧ ls < 0.039) ∧ ((1.564 : ℝ) < lu ∧ lu < 1.565) ∧
        (fderiv ℝ (LNormalizedReturn.returnMap μ) LNormalizedReturn.seed).toLinearMap.charpoly =
          (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C seedRatio⁻¹) ^ 2 * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ls) *
            (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C lu) * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C seedRatio)) ∧
      ∃ v ∈ stableSubspace (fderiv ℝ (LNormalizedReturn.returnMap μ) LNormalizedReturn.seed).toLinearMap,
        v 4 = 1

theorem lower_local_model :
    ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 (0 : Vec 2), ∀ ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ ℓ → ∀ y ∈ N,
      LEmbedding.objective (LEmbedding.copyCenter ℓ + LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ • y) =
        LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ ^ 2 * (LEmbedding.offset + LQuadraticSeed.objective LEmbedding.mu y)

theorem lower_objective_def (x : Vec 2) :
    (∀ i : Fin 3, LEmbedding.branch i.castSucc x =
      LEmbedding.mu / 2 * sqNorm x + LScalar.phi (LEmbedding.parameter i) (dot (LEmbedding.slope i) x)) ∧
      LEmbedding.branch 3 x = LEmbedding.mu / 2 * sqNorm x + x 1 ∧
      LEmbedding.objective x = Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i => LEmbedding.branch i x)

theorem lower_objective_hessian (x : Vec 2)
    (hfirst : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, DifferentiableAt ℝ LEmbedding.objective z)
    (hsecond : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ LEmbedding.objective) x) :
    (RadialHessian.matrix LEmbedding.objective x).IsSymm ∧ ∀ v,
      LEmbedding.mu * sqNorm v ≤ dot v ((RadialHessian.matrix LEmbedding.objective x).mulVec v) ∧
      dot v ((RadialHessian.matrix LEmbedding.objective x).mulVec v) ≤ 512 * sqNorm v

theorem lower_objective_minimizer :
    (∀ x, LEmbedding.mu / 2 * sqNorm x ≤ LEmbedding.objective x) ∧ LEmbedding.objective 0 = 0 ∧
      (∀ a, IsCompact {x | LEmbedding.objective x ≤ a}) ∧
      (∀ x, LEmbedding.objective 0 ≤ LEmbedding.objective x) ∧
      (∀ x, LEmbedding.objective x = LEmbedding.objective 0 → x = 0) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 3, coordinateGradient (LEmbedding.branch i.castSucc) 0 = 0) ∧
      coordinateGradient (LEmbedding.branch 3) 0 = ![0, 1] ∧
      ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ LEmbedding.objective (0 : Vec 2)

theorem lower_plateau {b : ℝ} (hl : 17/10 ≤ b) (hr : b ≤ 34) (ℓ : ℕ) (h : ℝ)
    (hh : |h| ≤ LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ / 2) :
    LScalar.phi b (b * LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ + h) = LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ ^ 2 + LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ * h

theorem lower_plateau_bi (i : Fin 3) {b : ℝ} (hb : b = LEmbedding.parameter i) (ℓ : ℕ) (h : ℝ)
    (hh : |h| ≤ LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ / 2) :

theorem lower_plateau_lengths {b : ℝ} (hl : 17/10 ≤ b) (hr : b ≤ 34) (L₁ L₂ : ℝ)
    (hL₁ : L₁ = b * (1 - LScalarGeometric.theta) * (1 - LScalarRamp.center b - LScalarRamp.epsilon))
    (hL₂ : L₂ = b * (1 - LScalarGeometric.theta) * (LScalarRamp.center b - LScalarRamp.epsilon) /
      LScalarGeometric.theta) :
    (∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x : ℝ), b * LScalarGeometric.scale (ℓ + 1) ≤ x → x ≤ b * LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ →
      (deriv (LScalar.phi b) x = LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ ↔
        b * LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ - LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ * L₁ ≤ x)) ∧
      (∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x : ℝ), b * LScalarGeometric.scale (ℓ + 1) ≤ x → x ≤ b * LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ →
        (deriv (LScalar.phi b) x = LScalarGeometric.scale (ℓ + 1) ↔
          x ≤ b * LScalarGeometric.scale (ℓ + 1) + LScalarGeometric.scale (ℓ + 1) * L₂)) ∧
      1 / 2 < L₁ ∧ 1 / 2 < L₂

theorem lower_plateau_lengths_bi (i : Fin 3) {b : ℝ} (hb : b = LEmbedding.parameter i) (L₁ L₂ : ℝ)
    (hL₁ : L₁ = b * (1 - LScalarGeometric.theta) * (1 - LScalarRamp.center b - LScalarRamp.epsilon))
    (hL₂ : L₂ = b * (1 - LScalarGeometric.theta) * (LScalarRamp.center b - LScalarRamp.epsilon) /
      LScalarGeometric.theta) :
    (∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x : ℝ), b * LScalarGeometric.scale (ℓ + 1) ≤ x → x ≤ b * LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ →
      (deriv (LScalar.phi b) x = LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ ↔
        b * LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ - LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ * L₁ ≤ x)) ∧
      (∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x : ℝ), b * LScalarGeometric.scale (ℓ + 1) ≤ x → x ≤ b * LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ →
        (deriv (LScalar.phi b) x = LScalarGeometric.scale (ℓ + 1) ↔
          x ≤ b * LScalarGeometric.scale (ℓ + 1) + LScalarGeometric.scale (ℓ + 1) * L₂)) ∧
      1 / 2 < L₁ ∧ 1 / 2 < L₂

theorem lower_scalar_def {b : ℝ} (hl : 17/10 ≤ b) (hr : b ≤ 34) (r : ℝ) (hrdef : r = 1 / 128)
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ ℓ, a ℓ = r ^ ℓ) (t ε : ℝ) (ht : t = (1 - (1 + r) / b) / (1 - r))
    (hε : ε = 1 / 1024) :
    (∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x ξ : ℝ), b * a (ℓ + 1) ≤ x → x ≤ b * a ℓ → ξ = (x / (b * a ℓ) - r) / (1 - r) →
      LScalar.phi b x = (r * a ℓ) ^ 2 + b * a ℓ ^ 2 * (1 - r) * (r * ξ + (1 - r) * cubicPrimitive t ε ξ)) ∧
      LScalar.phi b 0 = 0 ∧ (∀ x, x < 0 → LScalar.phi b x = x ^ 2 / 2) ∧
      ∀ x, b ≤ x → LScalar.phi b x = 1 + x - b

theorem lower_scalar_def_bi (i : Fin 3) {b : ℝ} (hb : b = LEmbedding.parameter i) (r : ℝ)
    (hrdef : r = 1 / 128) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ ℓ, a ℓ = r ^ ℓ) (t ε : ℝ)
    (ht : t = (1 - (1 + r) / b) / (1 - r)) (hε : ε = 1 / 1024) :
    (∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x ξ : ℝ), b * a (ℓ + 1) ≤ x → x ≤ b * a ℓ → ξ = (x / (b * a ℓ) - r) / (1 - r) →
      LScalar.phi b x = (r * a ℓ) ^ 2 + b * a ℓ ^ 2 * (1 - r) * (r * ξ + (1 - r) * cubicPrimitive t ε ξ)) ∧
      LScalar.phi b 0 = 0 ∧ (∀ x, x < 0 → LScalar.phi b x = x ^ 2 / 2) ∧
      ∀ x, b ≤ x → LScalar.phi b x = 1 + x - b

theorem lower_scalar_derivatives {b : ℝ} (hl : 17/10 ≤ b) (hr : b ≤ 34) (ℓ : ℕ) (x ξ : ℝ)
    (hlo : b * LScalarGeometric.scale (ℓ + 1) ≤ x) (hhi : x ≤ b * LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ)
    (hξ : ξ = (x / (b * LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ) - LScalarGeometric.theta) / (1 - LScalarGeometric.theta)) :
    HasDerivAt (LScalar.phi b) (LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ * (LScalarGeometric.theta +
        (1 - LScalarGeometric.theta) * cubicRamp (LScalarRamp.center b) LScalarRamp.epsilon ξ)) x ∧
      HasDerivAt (deriv (LScalar.phi b))
        (deriv (cubicRamp (LScalarRamp.center b) LScalarRamp.epsilon) ξ / b) x ∧
      ∀ η, 0 ≤ deriv (cubicRamp (LScalarRamp.center b) LScalarRamp.epsilon) η ∧
        deriv (cubicRamp (LScalarRamp.center b) LScalarRamp.epsilon) η ≤ 768

theorem lower_scalar_derivatives_bi (i : Fin 3) {b : ℝ} (hb : b = LEmbedding.parameter i) (ℓ : ℕ)
    (x ξ : ℝ) (hlo : b * LScalarGeometric.scale (ℓ + 1) ≤ x) (hhi : x ≤ b * LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ)
    (hξ : ξ = (x / (b * LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ) - LScalarGeometric.theta) / (1 - LScalarGeometric.theta)) :
    HasDerivAt (LScalar.phi b) (LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ * (LScalarGeometric.theta +
        (1 - LScalarGeometric.theta) * cubicRamp (LScalarRamp.center b) LScalarRamp.epsilon ξ)) x ∧
      HasDerivAt (deriv (LScalar.phi b))
        (deriv (cubicRamp (LScalarRamp.center b) LScalarRamp.epsilon) ξ / b) x ∧
      ∀ η, 0 ≤ deriv (cubicRamp (LScalarRamp.center b) LScalarRamp.epsilon) η ∧
        deriv (cubicRamp (LScalarRamp.center b) LScalarRamp.epsilon) η ≤ 768

theorem lower_scalar_monotone_flat {b : ℝ} (hl : 17/10 ≤ b) (hr : b ≤ 34) :
    MonotoneOn (deriv (LScalar.phi b)) (Set.Ioi 0) ∧
      ∀ ℓ, ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (b * LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ), deriv (LScalar.phi b) x = LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ

theorem lower_scalar_monotone_flat_bi (i : Fin 3) {b : ℝ} (hb : b = LEmbedding.parameter i) :
    MonotoneOn (deriv (LScalar.phi b)) (Set.Ioi 0) ∧

theorem lower_scalar_nodes {b : ℝ} (hl : 17/10 ≤ b) (hr : b ≤ 34) :
    LScalarGeometric.theta + (1 - LScalarGeometric.theta) * (1 - LScalarRamp.center b) =
        (1 + LScalarGeometric.theta) / b ∧
      ∀ ℓ, LScalar.phi b (b * LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ) = LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ ^ 2 ∧
