theorem lower_scalar_nodes_bi (i : Fin 3) {b : ℝ} (hb : b = LEmbedding.parameter i) :

        HasDerivAt (LScalar.phi b) (LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ) (b * LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ)

theorem lower_scalar_not_twice {b : ℝ} (hl : 17/10 ≤ b) (hr : b ≤ 34) :
    deriv (LScalar.phi b) 0 = 0 ∧
      (∀ ℓ, (deriv (LScalar.phi b) (b * LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ) - deriv (LScalar.phi b) 0) /
          (b * LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ - 0) = 1 / b ∧
        (deriv (LScalar.phi b) ((b + 1/4) * LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ) - deriv (LScalar.phi b) 0) /
          ((b + 1/4) * LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ - 0) = 1 / (b + 1/4)) ∧
      ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv (LScalar.phi b)) 0

theorem lower_scalar_not_twice_bi (i : Fin 3) {b : ℝ} (hb : b = LEmbedding.parameter i) :
    deriv (LScalar.phi b) 0 = 0 ∧
      (∀ ℓ, (deriv (LScalar.phi b) (b * LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ) - deriv (LScalar.phi b) 0) /
          (b * LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ - 0) = 1 / b ∧

          ((b + 1/4) * LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ - 0) = 1 / (b + 1/4)) ∧

theorem lower_scalar_regularity {b : ℝ} (hl : 17/10 ≤ b) (hr : b ≤ 34) :
    (∀ x s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (deriv (LScalar.phi b)) s x → 0 ≤ s ∧ s ≤ max 1 (768 / b)) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ 1 (LScalar.phi b) ∧ (∃ K, LipschitzWith K (deriv (LScalar.phi b))) ∧
      ConvexOn ℝ univ (LScalar.phi b) ∧ Tendsto (LScalar.phi b) (cocompact ℝ) atTop ∧
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ LScalar.phi b x) ∧ ∀ x, LScalar.phi b x = 0 ↔ x = 0

theorem lower_scalar_regularity_bi (i : Fin 3) {b : ℝ} (hb : b = LEmbedding.parameter i) :
    (∀ x s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (deriv (LScalar.phi b)) s x → 0 ≤ s ∧ s ≤ max 1 (768 / b)) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ 1 (LScalar.phi b) ∧ (∃ K, LipschitzWith K (deriv (LScalar.phi b))) ∧
      ConvexOn ℝ univ (LScalar.phi b) ∧ Tendsto (LScalar.phi b) (cocompact ℝ) atTop ∧
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ LScalar.phi b x) ∧ ∀ x, LScalar.phi b x = 0 ↔ x = 0

theorem lower_scalar_unique {b : ℝ} (hl : 17/10 ≤ b) (hr : b ≤ 34) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hint : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x : ℝ), b * LScalarGeometric.scale (ℓ + 1) ≤ x → x ≤ b * LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ →
      f x = (LScalarGeometric.theta * LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ) ^ 2 +
        b * LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ ^ 2 * (1 - LScalarGeometric.theta) *
          (LScalarGeometric.theta * LScalarGeometric.coordinate b (LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ) x +
            (1 - LScalarGeometric.theta) *
              LScalarRamp.primitive b (LScalarGeometric.coordinate b (LScalarGeometric.scale ℓ) x)))
    (h0 : f 0 = 0) (hneg : ∀ x, x < 0 → f x = x ^ 2 / 2) (hout : ∀ x, b ≤ x → f x = 1 + x - b) :
    f = LScalar.phi b

theorem minimizer_nonsmooth (μ : ℝ) (hμ : 0 < μ) (xs : Vec 2) (hxs : xs = -(μ⁻¹ • LQuadraticSeed.gbar)) :
    (∀ i, LQuadraticSeed.branch μ i xs = LQuadraticSeed.objective μ xs ↔ i = 0 ∨ i = 1) ∧
      LQuadraticSeed.branchGradient μ xs 0 ≠ LQuadraticSeed.branchGradient μ xs 1 ∧
      ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (LQuadraticSeed.objective μ) xs ∧

def absVRun (u₀ v₀ : ℝ) (hv : 0 < v₀) : AdmissibleBFGSRun 2 absV where
  convex := absV_convex
  x k := (axisRun v₀ hv).x k + ![u₀, 0]
  H := (axisRun v₀ hv).H
  g := (axisRun v₀ hv).g
  α := (axisRun v₀ hv).α
  c₁ := (axisRun v₀ hv).c₁
  c₂ := (axisRun v₀ hv).c₂
  c₁_pos := (axisRun v₀ hv).c₁_pos
  c₁_lt_c₂ := (axisRun v₀ hv).c₁_lt_c₂
  c₂_lt_one := (axisRun v₀ hv).c₂_lt_one
  initial_posDef := (axisRun v₀ hv).initial_posDef
  alpha_pos := (axisRun v₀ hv).alpha_pos
  gradient_nonzero := (axisRun v₀ hv).gradient_nonzero
  hasGradient k := by
    have hr : 0 < UnexcitedMetric.radius (1 / 2) v₀ k :=
      UnexcitedMetric.radius_pos (by norm_num) hv k
    have hs : UnexcitedMetric.sign k = 1 ∨ UnexcitedMetric.sign k = -1 :=
      (sq_eq_one_iff).mp (UnexcitedMetric.sign_sq k)
    have hcoord : ((axisRun v₀ hv).x k + ![u₀, 0]) 1 =
        UnexcitedMetric.sign k * UnexcitedMetric.radius (1 / 2) v₀ k := by
      simp [axisRun_x]
    have hne : ((axisRun v₀ hv).x k + ![u₀, 0]) 1 ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hcoord]
      rcases hs with hs | hs <;> rw [hs]
      · rw [one_mul]
        exact hr.ne'
      · rw [neg_one_mul]
        exact neg_ne_zero.mpr hr.ne'
    have h := absV_hasGradient hne
    rw [hcoord] at h
    rw [axisRun_g]
    rcases hs with hs | hs
    · rw [hs, one_mul, Real.sign_of_pos hr] at h
      rw [hs]
      exact h
    · rw [hs, neg_one_mul, Real.sign_of_neg (neg_neg_of_pos hr)] at h
      rw [hs]
      exact h
  step k := by
    rw [(axisRun v₀ hv).step k]
    abel
  update := (axisRun v₀ hv).update
  armijo k := by
    have e : ∀ j, absV ((axisRun v₀ hv).x j + ![u₀, 0]) =
        UnexcitedMetric.objective ((axisRun v₀ hv).x j) := by
      intro j
      simp [absV, axisRun_x, UnexcitedMetric.objective]
    rw [e, e]
    exact (axisRun v₀ hv).armijo k
  weak_wolfe := (axisRun v₀ hv).weak_wolfe

    (v : Vec n) (hv : v = H *ᵥ g) (κ : ℝ) (_hκ : κ = dot g (H *ᵥ y))
    (P : Mat n) (hP : P = 1 - κ⁻¹ • outer v y) (F : Mat n) (hF : F = P * H * Pᵀ)
    (A : Mat j) (hA : A = Zᵀ * H * Z) (a b : Vec j) (ha : a = Zᵀ *ᵥ (H *ᵥ g))
    (hb : b = Zᵀ *ᵥ (H *ᵥ y)) (r : ℝ) (hr : r = dot y (H *ᵥ y))
    (u : ℝ) (hu : u = dot a (A⁻¹ *ᵥ a)) (ρ : ℝ) :
    Zᵀ * F * Z + ρ • outer a a =
        A - (Matrix.of ![a, b])ᵀ * !![-(r / κ ^ 2 + ρ), 1 / κ; 1 / κ, 0] *
          Matrix.of ![a, b] ∧
      (Zᵀ * F * Z + ρ • outer a a).det = (Zᵀ * F * Z).det + ρ * A.det * u

theorem compression_determinant {n j : ℕ} (H Hplus : Mat n) (g y s : Vec n) (α q β : ℝ)
    (hH : H.PosDef) (hs : s = -α • (H *ᵥ g)) (hα : 0 < α)
    (hq_def : q = dot g (H *ᵥ g)) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hβ_def : β = -dot y (H *ᵥ g) / q) (hβ : 0 < β)
    (hHplus : Hplus = inverseBFGS H s y)
    (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin j) ℝ) (hZ : Zᵀ * Z = 1) (_hj : 1 ≤ j) (_hjn : j ≤ n)
    (v : Vec n) (hv : v = H *ᵥ g) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ = dot g (H *ᵥ y))
    (P : Mat n) (hP : P = 1 - κ⁻¹ • outer v y) (F : Mat n) (hF : F = P * H * Pᵀ)
    (A : Mat j) (hA : A = Zᵀ * H * Z) (a b : Vec j) (ha : a = Zᵀ *ᵥ (H *ᵥ g))
    (hb : b = Zᵀ *ᵥ (H *ᵥ y)) (r : ℝ) (hr : r = dot y (H *ᵥ y))
    (u w z : ℝ) (hu : u = dot a (A⁻¹ *ᵥ a)) (hw : w = dot a (A⁻¹ *ᵥ b))
    (hz : z = dot b (A⁻¹ *ᵥ b)) :
    (Zᵀ * F * Z).det = A.det / κ ^ 2 * ((κ - w) ^ 2 + u * (r - z))

theorem compression_formula {n j : ℕ} (H Hplus : Mat n) (g y s : Vec n) (α q β : ℝ)
    (hH : H.PosDef) (_hs : s = -α • (H *ᵥ g)) (_hα : 0 < α)
    (_hq_def : q = dot g (H *ᵥ g)) (_hq : 0 < q)
    (_hβ_def : β = -dot y (H *ᵥ g) / q) (_hβ : 0 < β)
    (_hHplus : Hplus = inverseBFGS H s y)
    (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin j) ℝ) (_hZ : Zᵀ * Z = 1) (_hj : 1 ≤ j) (_hjn : j ≤ n)
    (v : Vec n) (hv : v = H *ᵥ g) (κ : ℝ) (_hκ : κ = dot g (H *ᵥ y))
    (P : Mat n) (hP : P = 1 - κ⁻¹ • outer v y) (F : Mat n) (hF : F = P * H * Pᵀ)
    (A : Mat j) (hA : A = Zᵀ * H * Z) (a b : Vec j) (ha : a = Zᵀ *ᵥ (H *ᵥ g))
    (hb : b = Zᵀ *ᵥ (H *ᵥ y)) (r : ℝ) (hr : r = dot y (H *ᵥ y)) :
    Zᵀ * F * Z =
      A - (Matrix.of ![a, b])ᵀ * !![-r / κ ^ 2, 1 / κ; 1 / κ, 0] * Matrix.of ![a, b]

theorem compression_gram_bound {n j : ℕ} (H Hplus : Mat n) (g y s : Vec n) (α q β : ℝ)
    (hH : H.PosDef) (hs : s = -α • (H *ᵥ g)) (hα : 0 < α)
    (hq_def : q = dot g (H *ᵥ g)) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hβ_def : β = -dot y (H *ᵥ g) / q) (hβ : 0 < β)
    (hHplus : Hplus = inverseBFGS H s y)
    (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin j) ℝ) (hZ : Zᵀ * Z = 1) (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hjn : j ≤ n)
    (v : Vec n) (hv : v = H *ᵥ g) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ = dot g (H *ᵥ y))
    (P : Mat n) (hP : P = 1 - κ⁻¹ • outer v y) (F : Mat n) (hF : F = P * H * Pᵀ) :
    (Zᵀ * F * Z).det =
        (q * (metricGram H (fromCols (replicateCol Unit y) Z)).det -
          (metricGram H (fromCols (Matrix.of ![g, y])ᵀ Z)).det) / (β ^ 2 * q ^ 2) ∧
      (q * (metricGram H (fromCols (replicateCol Unit y) Z)).det -
          (metricGram H (fromCols (Matrix.of ![g, y])ᵀ Z)).det) / (β ^ 2 * q ^ 2) ≤
        (metricGram H (fromCols (replicateCol Unit y) Z)).det / (β ^ 2 * q)

theorem compression_posDef {n j : ℕ} (H Hplus : Mat n) (g y s : Vec n) (α q β : ℝ)
    (hH : H.PosDef) (_hs : s = -α • (H *ᵥ g)) (_hα : 0 < α)
    (_hq_def : q = dot g (H *ᵥ g)) (_hq : 0 < q)
    (_hβ_def : β = -dot y (H *ᵥ g) / q) (_hβ : 0 < β)
    (_hHplus : Hplus = inverseBFGS H s y)
    (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin j) ℝ) (hZ : Zᵀ * Z = 1) (_hj : 1 ≤ j) (_hjn : j ≤ n)
    (A : Mat j) (hA : A = Zᵀ * H * Z) :
    A.PosDef

theorem compression_update {n j : ℕ} (H Hplus : Mat n) (g y s : Vec n) (α q β : ℝ)
    (hH : H.PosDef) (hs : s = -α • (H *ᵥ g)) (hα : 0 < α)
    (hq_def : q = dot g (H *ᵥ g)) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hβ_def : β = -dot y (H *ᵥ g) / q) (hβ : 0 < β)
    (hHplus : Hplus = inverseBFGS H s y)
    (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin j) ℝ) (_hZ : Zᵀ * Z = 1) (_hj : 1 ≤ j) (_hjn : j ≤ n)
    (v : Vec n) (hv : v = H *ᵥ g) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ = dot g (H *ᵥ y))
    (P : Mat n) (hP : P = 1 - κ⁻¹ • outer v y) (F : Mat n) (hF : F = P * H * Pᵀ)
    (a : Vec j) (ha : a = Zᵀ *ᵥ (H *ᵥ g)) :
    Zᵀ * Hplus * Z = Zᵀ * F * Z + (α / (β * q)) • outer a a

BfgsCoverage.Article.MatrixAlgebra.det_u.statement:
theorem det_update {n : ℕ} (H Hplus : Mat n) (g y s : Vec n) (α q β : ℝ)
    (hH : H.PosDef) (hs : s = -α • (H *ᵥ g)) (hα : 0 < α)
    (hq_def : q = dot g (H *ᵥ g)) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hβ_def : β = -dot y (H *ᵥ g) / q) (hβ : 0 < β)
    (hHplus : Hplus = inverseBFGS H s y) :
    Hplus.det = α / β * H.det

BfgsCoverage.Article.MatrixAlgebra.full_.statement:
theorem full_dimension_case {n j : ℕ} (H Hplus : Mat n) (g y s : Vec n) (α q β : ℝ)
    (hH : H.PosDef) (hs : s = -α • (H *ᵥ g)) (hα : 0 < α)
    (hq_def : q = dot g (H *ᵥ g)) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hβ_def : β = -dot y (H *ᵥ g) / q) (hβ : 0 < β)
    (hHplus : Hplus = inverseBFGS H s y)
    (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin j) ℝ) (hZ : Zᵀ * Z = 1) (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hjn : j ≤ n)
    (v : Vec n) (hv : v = H *ᵥ g) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ = dot g (H *ᵥ y))
    (P : Mat n) (hP : P = 1 - κ⁻¹ • outer v y) (F : Mat n) (hF : F = P * H * Pᵀ)
    (A : Mat j) (hA : A = Zᵀ * H * Z) (a b : Vec j) (ha : a = Zᵀ *ᵥ (H *ᵥ g))
    (hb : b = Zᵀ *ᵥ (H *ᵥ y)) (r : ℝ) (hr : r = dot y (H *ᵥ y))
    (u w z : ℝ) (hu : u = dot a (A⁻¹ *ᵥ a)) (hw : w = dot a (A⁻¹ *ᵥ b))
    (hz : z = dot b (A⁻¹ *ᵥ b)) (htop : j = n) :
    Z * Zᵀ = 1 ∧ (u = q ∧ w = κ ∧ z = r) ∧ (Zᵀ * F * Z).det = 0 ∧
      α / (β * q) * A.det * u = α / β * A.det ∧
      (Zᵀ * Hplus * Z).det = α / β * A.det ∧ Hplus.det = α / β * H.det

BfgsCoverage.Article.MatrixAlgebra.gram_.statement:
theorem gram_compression {n j : ℕ} (H Hplus : Mat n) (g y s : Vec n) (α q β : ℝ)
    (hH : H.PosDef) (hs : s = -α • (H *ᵥ g)) (hα : 0 < α)
    (hq_def : q = dot g (H *ᵥ g)) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hβ_def : β = -dot y (H *ᵥ g) / q) (hβ : 0 < β)
    (hHplus : Hplus = inverseBFGS H s y)
    (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin j) ℝ) (hZ : Zᵀ * Z = 1) (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hjn : j ≤ n) :
    (Zᵀ * Hplus * Z).det ≤
        (metricGram H (fromCols (replicateCol Unit y) Z)).det / (β ^ 2 * q) +
          α / β * (Zᵀ * H * Z).det ∧
      (j = n → Hplus.det = α / β * H.det)

theorem gram_dets_nonneg {n j : ℕ} (H Hplus : Mat n) (g y s : Vec n) (α q β : ℝ)
    (hH : H.PosDef) (_hs : s = -α • (H *ᵥ g)) (_hα : 0 < α)
    (_hq_def : q = dot g (H *ᵥ g)) (_hq : 0 < q)
    (_hβ_def : β = -dot y (H *ᵥ g) / q) (_hβ : 0 < β)
    (_hHplus : Hplus = inverseBFGS H s y)
    (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin j) ℝ) (_hZ : Zᵀ * Z = 1) (_hj : 1 ≤ j) (_hjn : j ≤ n) :
    0 ≤ (metricGram H (fromCols (replicateCol Unit y) Z)).det ∧
      0 ≤ (metricGram H (fromCols (Matrix.of ![g, y])ᵀ Z)).det

theorem gram_schur {n j : ℕ} (H Hplus : Mat n) (g y s : Vec n) (α q β : ℝ)
    (hH : H.PosDef) (_hs : s = -α • (H *ᵥ g)) (_hα : 0 < α)
    (hq_def : q = dot g (H *ᵥ g)) (_hq : 0 < q)
    (_hβ_def : β = -dot y (H *ᵥ g) / q) (_hβ : 0 < β)
    (_hHplus : Hplus = inverseBFGS H s y)
    (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin j) ℝ) (hZ : Zᵀ * Z = 1) (_hj : 1 ≤ j) (_hjn : j ≤ n)
    (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ = dot g (H *ᵥ y))
    (A : Mat j) (hA : A = Zᵀ * H * Z) (a b : Vec j) (ha : a = Zᵀ *ᵥ (H *ᵥ g))
    (hb : b = Zᵀ *ᵥ (H *ᵥ y)) (r : ℝ) (hr : r = dot y (H *ᵥ y))
    (u w z : ℝ) (hu : u = dot a (A⁻¹ *ᵥ a)) (hw : w = dot a (A⁻¹ *ᵥ b))
    (hz : z = dot b (A⁻¹ *ᵥ b)) :
    (metricGram H (fromCols (replicateCol Unit y) Z)).det = A.det * (r - z) ∧
      (metricGram H (fromCols (Matrix.of ![g, y])ᵀ Z)).det =
        A.det * ((q - u) * (r - z) - (κ - w) ^ 2)

BfgsCoverage.Article.MatrixAlgebra.kappa.statement:
theorem kappa_eq_and_curvature {n : ℕ} (H Hplus : Mat n) (g y s : Vec n) (α q β : ℝ)
    (hH : H.PosDef) (hs : s = -α • (H *ᵥ g)) (_hα : 0 < α)
    (_hq_def : q = dot g (H *ᵥ g)) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hβ_def : β = -dot y (H *ᵥ g) / q) (_hβ : 0 < β)
    (_hHplus : Hplus = inverseBFGS H s y) :
    dot g (H *ᵥ y) = -β * q ∧ dot y s = α * β * q

BfgsCoverage.Article.MatrixAlgebra.u_bou.statement:
theorem u_bounds {n j : ℕ} (H Hplus : Mat n) (g y s : Vec n) (α q β : ℝ)
    (hH : H.PosDef) (_hs : s = -α • (H *ᵥ g)) (hα : 0 < α)
    (hq_def : q = dot g (H *ᵥ g)) (hq : 0 < q)
    (_hβ_def : β = -dot y (H *ᵥ g) / q) (hβ : 0 < β)
    (_hHplus : Hplus = inverseBFGS H s y)
    (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin j) ℝ) (hZ : Zᵀ * Z = 1) (_hj : 1 ≤ j) (_hjn : j ≤ n)
    (A : Mat j) (hA : A = Zᵀ * H * Z) (a : Vec j) (ha : a = Zᵀ *ᵥ (H *ᵥ g))
    (u : ℝ) (hu : u = dot a (A⁻¹ *ᵥ a)) :
    (metricGram H (fromCols (replicateCol Unit g) Z)).det = A.det * (q - u) ∧
      0 ≤ u ∧ u ≤ q ∧ α / (β * q) * A.det * u ≤ α / β * A.det

BfgsCoverage.Article.MatrixAlgebra.updat.statement:
theorem update_split {n : ℕ} (H Hplus : Mat n) (g y s : Vec n) (α q β : ℝ)
    (hH : H.PosDef) (hs : s = -α • (H *ᵥ g)) (hα : 0 < α)
    (hq_def : q = dot g (H *ᵥ g)) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hβ_def : β = -dot y (H *ᵥ g) / q) (hβ : 0 < β)
    (hHplus : Hplus = inverseBFGS H s y)
    (v : Vec n) (hv : v = H *ᵥ g) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ = dot g (H *ᵥ y))
    (P : Mat n) (hP : P = 1 - κ⁻¹ • outer v y) (F : Mat n) (hF : F = P * H * Pᵀ) :
    Hplus = F + (α / (β * q)) • outer v v

BfgsCoverage.Article.NegativeLower.local.statement:
theorem local_failure_lower :
    ∃ F : Vec 2 → ℝ,
      -- a finite strongly convex function with compact sublevels
      (∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ FixedNormal.EuclideanStrongConvexOn univ κ F) ∧
      (∀ a : ℝ, IsCompact {x | F x ≤ a}) ∧
      -- and a unique nonsmooth minimizer at zero
      (∀ x, F 0 ≤ F x) ∧ (∀ x, F x = F 0 → x = 0) ∧ ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ F (0 : Vec 2) ∧
      -- fixed starting points `x₀ ℓ → 0`, all with `H₀ = I`, and the runs they produce
      (∃ (x₀ : ℕ → Vec 2) (x : ℕ → ℕ → Vec 2) (H : ℕ → ℕ → Mat 2) (xbar : ℕ → Vec 2),
        Tendsto x₀ atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ (∀ ℓ, x ℓ 0 = x₀ ℓ ∧ H ℓ 0 = 1) ∧
        -- the runs converge to nonstationary points `x̄ ℓ ≠ 0`, `x̄ ℓ → 0`
        (∀ ℓ, Tendsto (x ℓ) atTop (𝓝 (xbar ℓ))) ∧ (∀ ℓ, xbar ℓ ≠ 0) ∧
        (∀ ℓ, (0 : Vec 2) ∉ ConvexSubdifferential.subdifferential F (xbar ℓ)) ∧
        Tendsto xbar atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
        -- `F(x_k^{(ℓ)}) ↓ F(x̄_ℓ) > F(0)`
        (∀ ℓ, StrictAnti (fun k => F (x ℓ k)) ∧
          Tendsto (fun k => F (x ℓ k)) atTop (𝓝 (F (xbar ℓ))) ∧ F 0 < F (xbar ℓ)) ∧
        -- every accepted and rejected query is differentiable
        (∀ ℓ k, ∀ a ∈ trialHistory (phase k),
          DifferentiableAt ℝ F (x ℓ k + a • bfgsStep (H ℓ k) (coordinateGradient F (x ℓ k)) 1)) ∧
        -- the supremum of all query norms in the `ℓ`th run tends to zero
        (∀ ℓ, BddAbove {r : ℝ | ∃ k, ∃ a ∈ trialHistory (phase k), r =
          ‖euclideanVector (x ℓ k + a • bfgsStep (H ℓ k) (coordinateGradient F (x ℓ k)) 1)‖}) ∧
        Tendsto (fun ℓ => sSup {r : ℝ | ∃ k, ∃ a ∈ trialHistory (phase k), r =
          ‖euclideanVector (x ℓ k + a • bfgsStep (H ℓ k) (coordinateGradient F (x ℓ k)) 1)‖})
          atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
        -- for every fixed admissible pair the implementation produces these same runs
        ∀ c₁ c₂ : ℝ, 0 < c₁ → c₁ ≤ 1/3 → c₁ < c₂ → c₂ < 1 →
          ∃ R : ℕ → AdmissibleBFGSRun 2 F, ∀ ℓ,
            (R ℓ).c₁ = c₁ ∧ (R ℓ).c₂ = c₂ ∧ (R ℓ).x = x ℓ ∧ (R ℓ).H = H ℓ ∧
            (∀ k N, 5 ≤ N → NonStrictLineSearch.fromMetric F ((R ℓ).x k) ((R ℓ).H k) c₁ c₂ N =
              (some ((R ℓ).α k), trialHistory (phase k))) ∧
            -- the accepted lengths repeat `1, 1/4, 1/16`
            (∀ m, (R ℓ).α (3 * m) = 1 ∧ (R ℓ).α (3 * m + 1) = 1/4 ∧ (R ℓ).α (3 * m + 2) = 1/16)) ∧
      -- a maximum of four globally `C^{1,1}`, uniformly strongly convex branches with globally
      -- Lipschitz gradients, the first three not twice differentiable at zero
      (∃ f : Fin 4 → Vec 2 → ℝ,
        (∀ x, F x = Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i => f i x)) ∧
        (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (f i)) ∧
        (∃ L : ℝ, ∀ i y z, ‖euclideanVector (coordinateGradient (f i) y - coordinateGradient (f i) z)‖ ≤
          L * ‖euclideanVector (y - z)‖) ∧
        (∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ ∀ i, FixedNormal.EuclideanStrongConvexOn univ κ (f i)) ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 3, ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ (f i.castSucc)) (0 : Vec 2)) ∧
      -- fixed `0 < μ ≤ L < ∞` with `μ I ⪯ ∇²F(x) ⪯ L I` at every twice-differentiable point
      ∃ μl Lu : ℝ, 0 < μl ∧ μl ≤ Lu ∧ ∀ x : Vec 2,
        (∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, DifferentiableAt ℝ F z) → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) x →
        (RadialHessian.matrix F x).IsSymm ∧ ∀ v,
          μl * sqNorm v ≤ dot v ((RadialHessian.matrix F x).mulVec v) ∧
          dot v ((RadialHessian.matrix F x).mulVec v) ≤ Lu * sqNorm v

BfgsCoverage.Article.NegativeUpper.imple.statement:
theorem implemented_run_unique {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} {c₁ c₂ : ℝ}
    (R R' : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) (hx : R.x 0 = R'.x 0) (hH : R.H 0 = R'.H 0)
    (hs : ∀ k, ∃ N L, NonStrictLineSearch.fromMetric F (R.x k) (R.H k) c₁ c₂ N = (some (R.α k), L))
    (hs' : ∀ k, ∃ N L, NonStrictLineSearch.fromMetric F (R'.x k) (R'.H k) c₁ c₂ N =
      (some (R'.α k), L)) :
    R.x = R'.x ∧ R.H = R'.H ∧ R.g = R'.g ∧ R.α = R'.α

BfgsCoverage.Article.NegativeUpper.local.statement:
theorem local_failure :
    ∃ f : Fin 4 → Vec 2 → ℝ,
      (∀ i, ConvexOn ℝ univ (f i) ∧ ContDiff ℝ 2 (f i) ∧
        ∃ L : ℝ, ∀ x y : Vec 2, FrameNorms.euclideanOpNorm
          (RadialHessian.matrix (f i) x - RadialHessian.matrix (f i) y) ≤
            L * ‖euclideanVector (x - y)‖) ∧
      (∀ i x, (RadialHessian.matrix (f i) x).PosSemidef ∧
        ((64 : ℝ) • (1 : Mat 2) - RadialHessian.matrix (f i) x).PosSemidef) ∧
      ∀ F : Vec 2 → ℝ, (∀ x, F x = Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i => f i x)) →
        (∀ a : ℝ, IsCompact {x | F x ≤ a}) ∧
        (∀ x, F 0 ≤ F x) ∧ (∀ x, F x = F 0 → x = 0) ∧ ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ F (0 : Vec 2) ∧
        ∃ (x : ℕ → ℕ → Vec 2) (H : ℕ → ℕ → Mat 2) (g : ℕ → ℕ → Vec 2) (α : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
          (hist : ℕ → ℕ → List ℝ) (xbar : ℕ → Vec 2),
          Tendsto (fun ℓ => x ℓ 0) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ (∀ ℓ, H ℓ 0 = 1) ∧
          (∀ c₁ c₂ : ℝ, 0 < c₁ → c₁ ≤ 1/3 → c₁ < c₂ → c₂ < 1 → ∀ ℓ, 1 ≤ ℓ →
            ∃ R : AdmissibleBFGSRun 2 F, R.c₁ = c₁ ∧ R.c₂ = c₂ ∧
              R.x = x ℓ ∧ R.H = H ℓ ∧ R.g = g ℓ ∧ R.α = α ℓ ∧
              ∀ k N, 5 ≤ N → NonStrictLineSearch.fromMetric F (x ℓ k) (H ℓ k) c₁ c₂ N =
                (some (α ℓ k), hist ℓ k)) ∧
          (∀ ℓ, 1 ≤ ℓ →
            Tendsto (x ℓ) atTop (𝓝 (xbar ℓ)) ∧ xbar ℓ ≠ 0 ∧
            (∀ k, F (x ℓ (k + 1)) < F (x ℓ k)) ∧
            Tendsto (fun k => F (x ℓ k)) atTop (𝓝 (F (xbar ℓ))) ∧
            F 0 < F (xbar ℓ) ∧ F 0 = 0 ∧
            (0 : Vec 2) ∉ ConvexSubdifferential.subdifferential F (xbar ℓ) ∧
            (∀ k, ∀ a ∈ hist ℓ k, DifferentiableAt ℝ F (x ℓ k + a • bfgsStep (H ℓ k) (g ℓ k) 1)) ∧
            (∀ k, (hist ℓ k).length ≤ 5) ∧
            (∀ m, α ℓ (3 * m) = 1 ∧ α ℓ (3 * m + 1) = 1/4 ∧ α ℓ (3 * m + 2) = 1/16)) ∧
          (∀ ℓ, BddAbove {r : ℝ | ∃ k, ∃ a ∈ hist ℓ k,
            r = ‖euclideanVector (x ℓ k + a • bfgsStep (H ℓ k) (g ℓ k) 1)‖}) ∧
          Tendsto (fun ℓ => sSup {r : ℝ | ∃ k, ∃ a ∈ hist ℓ k,
            r = ‖euclideanVector (x ℓ k + a • bfgsStep (H ℓ k) (g ℓ k) 1)‖}) atTop (𝓝 0)

def fieldFormula {m : ℕ} (χ : Fin m → ℝ → ℝ) (v : Fin m → ℝ → Vec 2) (t θ : ℝ) : Vec 2 :=
  height χ v t θ • normal θ + deriv (height χ v t) θ • tangent θ

    (t θ : ℝ) :

      fieldFormula (fun j φ => χ j (normal φ)) v t θ

def enclose (box : ι → ℝ × ℝ) : RatExpr ι → Option (ℝ × ℝ)
  | const q => some (q, q)
  | var i => some (box i)
  | add a b => match a.enclose box, b.enclose box with
    | some (p, q), some (r, s) => some (p + r, q + s)
    | _, _ => none
  | neg a => match a.enclose box with
    | some (p, q) => some (-q, -p)
    | none => none
  | mul a b => match a.enclose box, b.enclose box with
    | some (p, q), some (r, s) =>
      some (min (min (p * r) (p * s)) (min (q * r) (q * s)),
        max (max (p * r) (p * s)) (max (q * r) (q * s)))
    | _, _ => none
  | inv a => match a.enclose box with
    | some (p, q) => if (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc p q then none else some (1 / q, 1 / p)
    | none => none

def eval (v : ι → ℝ) : RatExpr ι → ℝ
  | const q => q
  | var i => v i
  | add a b => a.eval v + b.eval v
  | neg a => -a.eval v
  | mul a b => a.eval v * b.eval v

    (hmin : ∀ x, F xstar ≤ F x) (b : ℝ) (hK : IsCompact {x | F x ≤ b}) (c₁ c₂ : ℝ)
    (hcert : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → {x | F x ≤ b ∧ F x ≥ F xstar + η}.Nonempty →
      ∃ (W : Vec n → Mat n) (m C δ : ℝ), 0 < m ∧ 0 < δ ∧
        (∀ x ∈ {x | F x ≤ b ∧ F x ≥ F xstar + η}, (W x).PosSemidef) ∧
        ∀ x ∈ {x | F x ≤ b ∧ F x ≥ F xstar + η}, ∀ z ∈ {x | F x ≤ b ∧ F x ≥ F xstar + η},
          ∀ g h : Vec n, TransportedCertificate.EligiblePair F c₁ c₂ x z g h →
            -dot g (z - x) ≤ δ →
            dot g (W x *ᵥ g) ≥ m ∧
            dot (h - g) (W z *ᵥ (h - g)) ≤ C * dot (h - g) (z - x) ∧
            (TransportedCertificate.stepProjector (z - x) * W x *
                TransportedCertificate.stepProjector (z - x) -
              TransportedCertificate.stepProjector (z - x) * W z *
                TransportedCertificate.stepProjector (z - x)).PosSemidef) :
    ∀ R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F, R.c₁ = c₁ → R.c₂ = c₂ → F (R.x 0) ≤ b →
      Tendsto (fun k => F (R.x k)) atTop (𝓝 (F xstar)) ∧
        Tendsto (fun k => euclideanSolutionDistance F (R.x k)) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
        ((∀ y, F y = F xstar → y = xstar) → Tendsto R.x atTop (𝓝 xstar))

BfgsCoverage.Companion.Ch01I.pairwise_vi.statement:
theorem pairwise_visibility_values {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F)
    (K : Set (Vec n)) (hK : IsCompact K) (hxK : ∀ k, R.x k ∈ K) (xstar : Vec n)
    (hmin : ∀ x, F xstar ≤ F x)
    (hcert : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → (positiveBand F K (F xstar) η).Nonempty →
      ∃ (W : Vec n → Mat n) (m C L δ : ℝ), 0 < m ∧ 0 ≤ L ∧ 0 < δ ∧
        (∀ x ∈ positiveBand F K (F xstar) η, DifferentiableAt ℝ F x → (W x).PosSemidef) ∧
        ∀ x z g h, x ∈ positiveBand F K (F xstar) η → z ∈ positiveBand F K (F xstar) η →
          EligiblePair F R.c₁ R.c₂ x z g h → pairDecrease x z g ≤ δ →
          m ≤ metricEnergy (W x) g ∧
          metricEnergy (W z) (h - g) ≤ C * pairCurvature x z g h ∧
          ((1 + L * pairDecrease x z g) •
            (stepProjector (pairStep x z) * W x * stepProjector (pairStep x z)) -
            stepProjector (pairStep x z) * W z * stepProjector (pairStep x z)).PosSemidef) :
    Tendsto (fun k => F (R.x k)) atTop (𝓝 (F xstar))

theorem ridge_tie_determinant (a b : ℝ → ℝ) (p q : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q)
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ 2 a) (hb : ContDiff ℝ 2 b) (hca : ConvexOn ℝ univ a) (hcb : ConvexOn ℝ univ b)
    (ustar : ℝ) (hmin : ∀ u, RidgeSupersession.profile a b p q ustar ≤ RidgeSupersession.profile a b p q u)
    (huniq : ∀ u, RidgeSupersession.profile a b p q u = RidgeSupersession.profile a b p q ustar →
      u = ustar) :
    (∀ u, deriv a u * (-q) - p * deriv b u = -q * deriv a u - p * deriv b u ∧
      -q * deriv a u - p * deriv b u = -(p + q) * deriv (RidgeSupersession.profile a b p q) u) ∧
    (∀ u, deriv (RidgeSupersession.profile a b p q) u = 0 ↔ u = ustar) ∧
    ∀ v : ℝ, a ustar + p * v = b ustar - q * v → (![ustar, v] : Vec 2) =
      ![ustar, (b ustar - a ustar) / (p + q)]

BfgsCoverage.Companion.Ch01I.run_definit.statement:
theorem run_definition {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) :
    ConvexOn ℝ univ F ∧ (R.H 0).PosDef ∧ (0 < R.c₁ ∧ R.c₁ < R.c₂ ∧ R.c₂ < 1) ∧
    ∀ k, HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional (R.g k)) (R.x k) ∧ R.g k ≠ 0 ∧ 0 < R.α k ∧
      R.displacement k = -R.α k • (R.H k *ᵥ R.g k) ∧ R.x (k + 1) = R.x k + R.displacement k ∧
      R.gradientChange k = R.g (k + 1) - R.g k ∧
      R.H (k + 1) =
        (1 - (dot (R.gradientChange k) (R.displacement k))⁻¹ •
            outer (R.displacement k) (R.gradientChange k)) * R.H k *
          (1 - (dot (R.gradientChange k) (R.displacement k))⁻¹ •
            outer (R.gradientChange k) (R.displacement k)) +
        (dot (R.gradientChange k) (R.displacement k))⁻¹ •
          outer (R.displacement k) (R.displacement k) ∧
      0 < dot (R.gradientChange k) (R.displacement k) ∧
      F (R.x (k + 1)) ≤ F (R.x k) + R.c₁ * dot (R.g k) (R.displacement k) ∧
      dot (R.g (k + 1)) (R.displacement k) ≥ R.c₂ * dot (R.g k) (R.displacement k)

    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ k, a k = dot (R.g k) (r k))
    (E : ℕ → ℝ) (hE : ∀ k, E k = dot (r k) (R.hessian k *ᵥ r k))
    (Rk : ℕ → ℝ) (hRk : ∀ k, Rk k = dot (R.gradientChange k) (r (k + 1)) ^ 2 / R.curvature k)
    (k : ℕ) :
    r (k + 1) = r k - R.α k • (R.H k *ᵥ R.g k) ∧ E (k + 1) = E k - a k ^ 2 / R.q k + Rk k

theorem frame_criterion {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) {r : ℕ}
    (V : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ) (T : ℕ → Mat r) (b : ℕ → Vec r)
    (hV : ∀ k, V (k + 1) = V k * T k + EnergyIdentities.rectOuter (R.displacement k) (b k))
    (a : ℕ → Vec r) (ha : ∀ k, a k = (V k)ᵀ *ᵥ R.g k)
    (c : ℕ → Vec r) (hc : ∀ k, c k = (V (k + 1))ᵀ *ᵥ R.gradientChange k)
    (J : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hvis : ∀ k, J ≤ k → ‖euclideanVector (a k)‖ ≥ ε)
    (C : ℝ) (hcor : ∀ k, J ≤ k → sqNorm (c k) / R.curvature k ≤ C)
    (P : ℕ → Mat r) (_hPJ : P J = 1) (hprod : ∀ k, J ≤ k → P (k + 1) = P k * T k)
    (hPbdd : ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ k, J ≤ k → FrameNorms.euclideanOpNorm (P k) ≤ K)
    (hPinv : ∀ k, J ≤ k → (P k).det ≠ 0)
    (hPinvbdd : ∃ L : ℝ, ∀ k, J ≤ k → FrameNorms.euclideanOpNorm (P k)⁻¹ ≤ L) :
    ((fun N : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico J N, (R.q k)⁻¹) =O[atTop] (fun N : ℕ => (N : ℝ))) ∧
      ((∃ Λ : ℝ, ∀ k, ‖euclideanVector (R.g k)‖ ≤ Λ) → Tendsto R.d atTop (𝓝 0) → False)

theorem frame_energy {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F)
    (_hbdd : ∃ Λ : ℝ, ∀ k, ‖euclideanVector (R.g k)‖ ≤ Λ) (_hsum : Summable R.d)
    (S : Submodule ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (LS : ℝ)
    (_hsmooth : ∀ k, ‖(S.orthogonalProjection (euclideanVector (R.gradientChange k)) :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))‖ ^ 2 ≤ LS * R.curvature k)
    (J p : ℕ) (V : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) ℝ) (T : ℕ → Mat p) (b : ℕ → Vec p)
    (Rres : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) ℝ) (m C0 CT CR : ℝ) (_hm : 0 < m)
    (hfr : ∀ k, J ≤ k →
      ‖euclideanVector ((V k)ᵀ *ᵥ R.g k)‖ ^ 2 ≥ m ∧
      ‖euclideanVector ((V (k + 1))ᵀ *ᵥ R.gradientChange k)‖ ^ 2 ≤ C0 * R.curvature k ∧
      V (k + 1) = V k * T k + EnergyIdentities.rectOuter (R.displacement k) (b k) + Rres k ∧
      FrameNorms.euclideanOpNorm (T k) ^ 2 ≤ 1 + CT * R.d k ∧
      (∀ v : Vec p, euclideanVector (Rres k *ᵥ v) ∈ S) ∧
      SmoothSubspace.frobSq (Rres k) ≤ CR * R.d k)
    (PS : Mat n) (_hPS : ∀ v : Vec n, euclideanVector (PS *ᵥ v) =
      (S.orthogonalProjection (euclideanVector v) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
    (E : ℕ → ℝ) (hE : ∀ k, E k = ((V k)ᵀ * R.hessian k * V k).trace)
    (M : ℕ → Mat n) (hM : ∀ k, M k = R.hessian k - (R.q k)⁻¹ • outer (R.g k) (R.g k))
    (k : ℕ) (hk : J ≤ k) :
    E (k + 1) = ((V k * T k + Rres k)ᵀ * M k * (V k * T k + Rres k)).trace +
      ‖euclideanVector ((V (k + 1))ᵀ *ᵥ R.gradientChange k)‖ ^ 2 / R.curvature k

theorem frame_energy_step {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) {p : ℕ}
    (V : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) ℝ) (T : ℕ → Mat p) (b : ℕ → Vec p)
    (Rres : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) ℝ)
    (E : ℕ → ℝ) (hE : ∀ k, E k = ((V k)ᵀ * R.hessian k * V k).trace)
    (M : ℕ → Mat n) (hM : ∀ k, M k = R.hessian k - (R.q k)⁻¹ • outer (R.g k) (R.g k)) (k : ℕ)
    (hVk : V (k + 1) = V k * T k + EnergyIdentities.rectOuter (R.displacement k) (b k) + Rres k) :
    E (k + 1) = ((V k * T k + Rres k)ᵀ * M k * (V k * T k + Rres k)).trace +
      ‖euclideanVector ((V (k + 1))ᵀ *ᵥ R.gradientChange k)‖ ^ 2 / R.curvature k

theorem frame_identity {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) {r : ℕ}
    (V : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ) (T : ℕ → Mat r) (b : ℕ → Vec r)
    (hV : ∀ k, V (k + 1) = V k * T k + EnergyIdentities.rectOuter (R.displacement k) (b k))
    (A : ℕ → Mat r) (hA : ∀ k, A k = (V k)ᵀ * R.hessian k * V k)
    (a : ℕ → Vec r) (ha : ∀ k, a k = (V k)ᵀ *ᵥ R.g k)

theorem frame_young {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F)

    (S : Submodule ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (LS : ℝ)
    (_hsmooth : ∀ k, ‖(S.orthogonalProjection (euclideanVector (R.gradientChange k)) :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))‖ ^ 2 ≤ LS * R.curvature k)
    (J p : ℕ) (V : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) ℝ) (T : ℕ → Mat p) (b : ℕ → Vec p)
    (Rres : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) ℝ) (m C0 CT CR : ℝ) (_hm : 0 < m)
    (hfr : ∀ k, J ≤ k →
      ‖euclideanVector ((V k)ᵀ *ᵥ R.g k)‖ ^ 2 ≥ m ∧
      ‖euclideanVector ((V (k + 1))ᵀ *ᵥ R.gradientChange k)‖ ^ 2 ≤ C0 * R.curvature k ∧
      V (k + 1) = V k * T k + EnergyIdentities.rectOuter (R.displacement k) (b k) + Rres k ∧
      FrameNorms.euclideanOpNorm (T k) ^ 2 ≤ 1 + CT * R.d k ∧
      (∀ v : Vec p, euclideanVector (Rres k *ᵥ v) ∈ S) ∧
      SmoothSubspace.frobSq (Rres k) ≤ CR * R.d k)
    (PS : Mat n) (_hPS : ∀ v : Vec n, euclideanVector (PS *ᵥ v) =
      (S.orthogonalProjection (euclideanVector v) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
    (E : ℕ → ℝ) (hE : ∀ k, E k = ((V k)ᵀ * R.hessian k * V k).trace)
    (M : ℕ → Mat n) (hM : ∀ k, M k = R.hessian k - (R.q k)⁻¹ • outer (R.g k) (R.g k))
    (k : ℕ) (hk : J ≤ k) :
    E (k + 1) ≤ (1 + R.d k) * FrameNorms.euclideanOpNorm (T k) ^ 2 *
        (E k - ‖euclideanVector ((V k)ᵀ *ᵥ R.g k)‖ ^ 2 / R.q k) +
      (1 + (R.d k)⁻¹) * ((Rres k)ᵀ * M k * Rres k).trace + C0

theorem frame_young_step {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) {p : ℕ}
    (V : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) ℝ) (T : ℕ → Mat p) (b : ℕ → Vec p)

    (hC0 : ‖euclideanVector ((V (k + 1))ᵀ *ᵥ R.gradientChange k)‖ ^ 2 ≤ C0 * R.curvature k) :

theorem hierarchy {n : ℕ} (H Hplus : Mat n) (g y s : Vec n) (α q β : ℝ)
    (hH : H.PosDef) (hs : s = -α • (H *ᵥ g)) (hα : 0 < α)
    (hq_def : q = dot g (H *ᵥ g)) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hβ_def : β = -dot y (H *ᵥ g) / q) (hβ : 0 < β)
    (hHplus : Hplus = inverseBFGS H s y) :
    ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ n →
      principalSum Hplus j ≤
        sqNorm y / (β ^ 2 * q) * principalSum H (j + 1) + α / β * principalSum H j

theorem hierarchy_needs_positive_length :
    ∃ (H Hplus : Mat 2) (g y s : Vec 2) (α q β : ℝ),
      H.PosDef ∧ s = -α • (H *ᵥ g) ∧ q = dot g (H *ᵥ g) ∧ 0 < q ∧
        β = -dot y (H *ᵥ g) / q ∧ 0 < β ∧ Hplus = inverseBFGS H s y ∧ α < 0 ∧
        ¬ principalSum Hplus 1 ≤
          sqNorm y / (β ^ 2 * q) * principalSum H (1 + 1) + α / β * principalSum H 1

BfgsCoverage.Companion.Ch02M.hierarchy_s.statement:
theorem hierarchy_step {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F)
    (_hbdd : ∃ Λ : ℝ, ∀ k, ‖euclideanVector (R.g k)‖ ≤ Λ) (_hd : Tendsto R.d atTop (𝓝 0))
    (G : ℝ) (hG : 0 < G) (hgG : ∀ k, ‖euclideanVector (R.g k)‖ ≤ G)
    (K0 : ℝ) (hK0 : K0 = 4 * G ^ 2 / (1 - R.c₂) ^ 2) (k j : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hjn : j ≤ n) :
    principalSum (R.H (k + 1)) j ≤
      (R.q k)⁻¹ * (K0 * principalSum (R.H k) (j + 1) +
        R.d k / (1 - R.c₂) * principalSum (R.H k) j)

theorem liminf_bound {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F)
    (G : ℝ) (hG : 0 < G) (hgG : ∀ k, ‖euclideanVector (R.g k)‖ ≤ G) (hsum : Summable R.d)
    (J : ℕ) (DJ : ℝ) (hDJ : DJ = ∑' i, R.d (J + i))
    (K0 : ℝ) (_hK0 : K0 = 4 * G ^ 2 / (1 - R.c₂) ^ 2)
    (V : ℝ → Mat n → ℝ)
    (_hV : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∀ H : Mat n, H.PosDef →
      V η H = ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (K0 / η) ^ (j - 1) * principalSum H j) :
    (∀ a : ℝ, a < (1 - R.c₂) / (2 * DJ) →
      ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, a ≤ 1 / (N : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, (R.q k)⁻¹) ∧
      (((1 - R.c₂) / (2 * DJ) : ℝ) : EReal) ≤
        liminf (fun N : ℕ => ((1 / (N : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, (R.q k)⁻¹ : ℝ) : EReal))
          atTop

theorem localization {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (F : Vec n → ℝ) (hF : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F)
    (xstar : Vec n) (hmin : ∀ x, F xstar ≤ F x) (huniq : ∀ x, F x = F xstar → x = xstar)
    (U : Set (Vec n)) (hU : U ∈ 𝓝 xstar) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hrU : {x | ‖euclideanVector (x - xstar)‖ ≤ r} ⊆ U) (ω : ℝ)
    (hω : ω = sInf ((fun z => F (xstar + z) - F xstar) '' {z | ‖euclideanVector z‖ = r})) :
    {z : Vec n | ‖euclideanVector z‖ = r}.Nonempty ∧
      IsLeast ((fun z => F (xstar + z) - F xstar) '' {z | ‖euclideanVector z‖ = r}) ω ∧
      0 < ω ∧
      (∀ x0 : Vec n, F x0 - F xstar < ω →
        {x | F x ≤ F x0} ⊆ {x | ‖euclideanVector (x - xstar)‖ < r}) ∧
      ∀ R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F, F (R.x 0) - F xstar < ω →
        ∀ k, ‖euclideanVector (R.x k - xstar)‖ < r ∧ R.x k ∈ U

theorem localization_radial {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (F : Vec n → ℝ) (hF : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F)
    (xstar : Vec n) (hmin : ∀ x, F xstar ≤ F x) (huniq : ∀ x, F x = F xstar → x = xstar)
    (U : Set (Vec n)) (_hU : U ∈ 𝓝 xstar) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (_hrU : {x | ‖euclideanVector (x - xstar)‖ ≤ r} ⊆ U) (ω : ℝ)
    (hω : ω = sInf ((fun z => F (xstar + z) - F xstar) '' {z | ‖euclideanVector z‖ = r}))
    (x : Vec n) (hx : ‖euclideanVector (x - xstar)‖ ≥ r) :
    F x - F xstar ≥ ‖euclideanVector (x - xstar)‖ / r * ω ∧
      ‖euclideanVector (x - xstar)‖ / r * ω ≥ ω

theorem localization_remarks {n : ℕ} (F : Vec n → ℝ) (hF : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F)
    (xstar : Vec n) (hmin : ∀ x, F xstar ≤ F x) (huniq : ∀ x, F x = F xstar → x = xstar) :
    (∀ a : ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded {x | F x ≤ a} ∧ IsCompact {x | F x ≤ a}) ∧

theorem normalized_budget {e q u c : ℕ → ℝ} {m B : ℝ} (M : ℕ)

theorem normalized_trace {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) {r : ℕ}
    (V : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ) (T : ℕ → Mat r) (b : ℕ → Vec r)
    (hV : ∀ k, V (k + 1) = V k * T k + EnergyIdentities.rectOuter (R.displacement k) (b k))
    (A : ℕ → Mat r) (hA : ∀ k, A k = (V k)ᵀ * R.hessian k * V k)
    (a : ℕ → Vec r) (ha : ∀ k, a k = (V k)ᵀ *ᵥ R.g k)
    (c : ℕ → Vec r) (hc : ∀ k, c k = (V (k + 1))ᵀ *ᵥ R.gradientChange k)
    (J : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (_hε : 0 < ε) (_hvis : ∀ k, J ≤ k → ‖euclideanVector (a k)‖ ≥ ε)
    (C : ℝ) (_hcor : ∀ k, J ≤ k → sqNorm (c k) / R.curvature k ≤ C)
    (P : ℕ → Mat r) (_hPJ : P J = 1) (hprod : ∀ k, J ≤ k → P (k + 1) = P k * T k)
    (_hPbdd : ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ k, J ≤ k → FrameNorms.euclideanOpNorm (P k) ≤ K)
    (hPinv : ∀ k, J ≤ k → (P k).det ≠ 0)
    (_hPinvbdd : ∃ L : ℝ, ∀ k, J ≤ k → FrameNorms.euclideanOpNorm (P k)⁻¹ ≤ L)
    (At : ℕ → Mat r) (hAt : ∀ k, At k = ((P k)⁻¹)ᵀ * A k * (P k)⁻¹) :
    ∀ k, J ≤ k → (At (k + 1)).trace = (At k).trace - sqNorm (((P k)⁻¹)ᵀ *ᵥ a k) / R.q k +
      sqNorm (((P (k + 1))⁻¹)ᵀ *ᵥ c k) / R.curvature k

theorem normalized_trace_step {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) {r : ℕ}
    (V : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ) (T : ℕ → Mat r) (b : ℕ → Vec r) (P : ℕ → Mat r)
    (A : ℕ → Mat r) (hA : ∀ k, A k = (V k)ᵀ * R.hessian k * V k)
    (a : ℕ → Vec r) (ha : ∀ k, a k = (V k)ᵀ *ᵥ R.g k)
    (c : ℕ → Vec r) (hc : ∀ k, c k = (V (k + 1))ᵀ *ᵥ R.gradientChange k)
    (At : ℕ → Mat r) (hAt : ∀ k, At k = ((P k)⁻¹)ᵀ * A k * (P k)⁻¹) (k : ℕ)
    (hVk : V (k + 1) = V k * T k + EnergyIdentities.rectOuter (R.displacement k) (b k))
    (hPk : (P k).det ≠ 0) (hPk1 : (P (k + 1)).det ≠ 0) (hprod : P (k + 1) = P k * T k) :
    (At (k + 1)).trace = (At k).trace - sqNorm (((P k)⁻¹)ᵀ *ᵥ a k) / R.q k +

BfgsCoverage.Companion.Ch02M.notation_di.statement:
theorem notation_display {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) (k : ℕ) :
    R.hessian k = (R.H k)⁻¹ ∧ R.q k = dot (R.g k) (R.H k *ᵥ R.g k) ∧ 0 < R.q k ∧

    (J p : ℕ) (V : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) ℝ) (T : ℕ → Mat p) (b : ℕ → Vec p)
    (Rres : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) ℝ) (m C0 CT CR : ℝ) (_hm : 0 < m)

      ‖euclideanVector ((V k)ᵀ *ᵥ R.g k)‖ ^ 2 ≥ m ∧

      V (k + 1) = V k * T k + EnergyIdentities.rectOuter (R.displacement k) (b k) + Rres k ∧
      FrameNorms.euclideanOpNorm (T k) ^ 2 ≤ 1 + CT * R.d k ∧

    (_hFstar : IsLeast (Set.range F) Fstar) (b : ℝ) (K : Set (Vec n))
    (hK_def : K = {x | F x ≤ b}) (_hb : b > Fstar) (_hK : IsCompact K)
    (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F)
    (_hcert : TransportedCertificate.HasBandCertificates F K Fstar R.c₁ R.c₂)
    (hx0 : R.x 0 ∈ K) (ℓ : ℝ) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ)
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun k => F (R.x k) - Fstar) atTop (𝓝 ℓ))
    (Cert : TransportedCertificate.BandCertificate F K Fstar R.c₁ R.c₂ (ℓ / 2))
    (k₀ : ℕ) (hk₀ : ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k → R.d k ≤ Cert.δ)
    (E : ℕ → ℝ) (hE : ∀ k, E k = (R.hessian k * Cert.W (R.x k)).trace)
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ k, a k = 1 + Cert.L * R.d k)
    (M : ℕ → Mat n) (hM : ∀ k, M k = R.hessian k - (R.q k)⁻¹ • outer (R.g k) (R.g k)) :
    ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k →
      E (k + 1) = (M k * Cert.W (R.x (k + 1))).trace +
          dot (R.gradientChange k) (Cert.W (R.x (k + 1)) *ᵥ R.gradientChange k) /
            R.curvature k ∧
        (M k * Cert.W (R.x (k + 1))).trace +
            dot (R.gradientChange k) (Cert.W (R.x (k + 1)) *ᵥ R.gradientChange k) /
              R.curvature k ≤
          a k * (M k * Cert.W (R.x k)).trace + Cert.C ∧
        a k * (M k * Cert.W (R.x k)).trace + Cert.C =
          a k * (E k - dot (R.g k) (Cert.W (R.x k) *ᵥ R.g k) / R.q k) + Cert.C ∧
        a k * (E k - dot (R.g k) (Cert.W (R.x k) *ᵥ R.g k) / R.q k) + Cert.C ≤
          a k * (E k - Cert.m / R.q k) + Cert.C

      (0 < FiniteMaxRadial.activeRadialJump hne f w (w - xstar) →
        ¬ (fun t : ℝ => F (w + t • (w - xstar)) + F (w - t • (w - xstar)) - 2 * F w) =O[𝓝 0]
          fun t => t ^ 2) ∧
      (ConvexOn ℝ univ F → (∀ i, ConvexOn ℝ U (f i)) → (∀ x, F xstar ≤ F x) →
        ∀ i j, f i w = F w → f j w = F w →
          dot (coordinateGradient (f j) w) (w - xstar) <
              dot (coordinateGradient (f i) w) (w - xstar) →
          F xstar < F w → ∀ b : ℝ, F w < b → ¬ RS F xstar {x | F x ≤ b})

theorem finite_max_quadratic_iff {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

    {F : Vec n → ℝ} (xstar : Vec n) (U : Set (Vec n)) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (f : ι → Vec n → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (f i) U)
    (hrep : ∀ w ∈ U, F w = Finset.univ.sup' hne fun i => f i w) (w : Vec n) (hw : w ∈ U) :
    ((fun t : ℝ => F (w + t • (w - xstar)) + F (w - t • (w - xstar)) - 2 * F w) =O[𝓝 0]
        fun t => t ^ 2) ↔
      ∀ i j, f i w = F w → f j w = F w →

    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (B : Set (Vec n)) (hB : B = {x | ‖euclideanVector (x - xstar)‖ < R})

          (deriv (FiniteMaxRadial.maximum Finset.univ hne (fun j t => f j (x - t • (x - xstar)))))
          (Ioo (-1 / 2 : ℝ) (3 / 4)) ∧

def leftCert (K : Set (Vec 1)) (hK : K ⊆ {x | x 0 < 0}) (c₁ c₂ η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    BandCertificate shiftedObjective K (shiftedObjective (embed (-1))) c₁ c₂ η where
  W := fun _ => 1
  m := 2 * η
  C := 1
  L := 0
  δ := 1
  m_pos := by linarith
  L_nonneg := le_rfl
  delta_pos := one_pos
  positive_semidefinite := fun _ _ _ => Matrix.PosSemidef.one
  visibility := fun x hx g hg => by
    have hx0 : x 0 < 0 := hK hx.1
    have hgx := ShiftedAbsAccessibility.actual_gradient_neg hg hx0
    have hb := hx.2
    simp only [shiftedObjective, shiftedAbs, embed_apply, abs_of_neg hx0] at hb
    rw [scalar_energy, hgx]
    norm_num at hb ⊢
    nlinarith
  secant := fun x z g h hx hz hp _ => by
    have hx0 : x 0 < 0 := hK hx.1
    have hz0 : z 0 < 0 := hK hz.1
    have hgx := ShiftedAbsAccessibility.actual_gradient_neg hp.gradient_x hx0
    have hhz := ShiftedAbsAccessibility.actual_gradient_neg hp.gradient_z hz0
    rw [scalar_energy]
    simp only [pairCurvature, pairStep, dot, Fin.sum_univ_one, Pi.sub_apply, hgx, hhz,
      Matrix.one_apply_eq]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (z 0 - x 0)]
  transport := fun x z g h _ _ hp _ => by
    have hs : pairStep x z ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have := hp.decrease_pos
      simp [pairDecrease, h0, dot] at this
    rw [BfgsCoverage.Article.Energy.stepProjector_one_dim hs]
    simpa using Matrix.PosSemidef.zero

    (hdiff : ∀ ε, HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional (h ε)) (z ε))

    (y : ι → Fin r → Vec n) (hy : ∀ ε j, y ε j = h ε - g ε j)
    (t : ι → Fin r → ℝ) (ht : ∀ ε j, t ε j = dot (y ε j) (z ε - x ε j))

    (hg : HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional g) x) (c₁ c₂ : ℝ) (hc₁ : 0 < c₁) (hc : c₁ < c₂)
    (hc₂ : c₂ < 1) (L : ℝ) (hL : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → L ≤ F (x + bfgsStep H g t)) :

      ∃ α h : _, 0 < α ∧ HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional h) (x + bfgsStep H g α) ∧

    ((∀ z, F z = ψ z + ∑ i, max 0 (dot (a i) z - b i)) →
      ∃ α h : _, 0 < α ∧ HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional h) (x + bfgsStep H g α) ∧

    (xstar : Vec n) (hmin : ∀ x, F xstar ≤ F x)
    (S : ℕ → ℝ) (hS : ∀ N, S N = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, (R.q k)⁻¹)

theorem centered_secant_bound {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (xstar : Vec n) (ψ γ : Vec n → ℝ)
    (hrep : ∀ x, F x = ψ x + γ (x - xstar))
    (U : Set (Vec n)) (hU : IsOpen U) (hUc : Convex ℝ U)
    (hψ : ConvexOn ℝ U ψ) (hψ11 : CenteredSmoothSublinear.LocallyC11On U ψ)
    (hγ : ConvexOn ℝ univ γ) (hγh : Homogeneous.PositiveDegreeOne γ)
    (hmin : ∀ x, F xstar ≤ F x)
    (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) (hK : IsCompact {x | F x ≤ F (R.x 0)})
    (hKU : {x | F x ≤ F (R.x 0)} ⊆ U)
    (Rad : ℝ) (hRad : ∀ x ∈ {x | F x ≤ F (R.x 0)}, ‖euclideanVector (x - xstar)‖ ≤ Rad)
    (L : ℝ) (hL0 : 0 < L)
    (hL : ∀ x ∈ {x | F x ≤ F (R.x 0)}, ∀ y ∈ {x | F x ≤ F (R.x 0)},
      ‖euclideanVector (coordinateGradient ψ y - coordinateGradient ψ x)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        L * dot (coordinateGradient ψ y - coordinateGradient ψ x) (y - x))
    (Gγ : ℝ) (hG : ∀ x h, Homogeneous.Supports γ x h → ‖euclideanVector h‖ ≤ Gγ) (k : ℕ)
    (yψ yγ : Vec n)
    (hyψ : yψ = coordinateGradient ψ (R.x (k + 1)) - coordinateGradient ψ (R.x k))
    (hyγ : yγ = (R.g (k + 1) - coordinateGradient ψ (R.x (k + 1))) -
      (R.g k - coordinateGradient ψ (R.x k)))
    (a b ξ ζ : ℝ) (ha : a = dot yψ (R.displacement k)) (hb : b = dot yγ (R.displacement k))
    (hξ : ξ = dot yψ (R.x (k + 1) - xstar)) (hζ : ζ = dot yγ (R.x (k + 1) - xstar)) :
    dot (R.gradientChange k) (R.x (k + 1) - xstar) ^ 2 / R.curvature k ≤
        ξ ^ 2 / a + ζ ^ 2 / b ∧
      ξ ^ 2 / a + ζ ^ 2 / b ≤ L * Rad ^ 2 + 2 * Gγ * Rad

    (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) (_hK : IsCompact {x | F x ≤ F (R.x 0)})
    (hKU : {x | F x ≤ F (R.x 0)} ⊆ U)
    (Rad : ℝ) (hRad : ∀ x ∈ {x | F x ≤ F (R.x 0)}, ‖euclideanVector (x - xstar)‖ ≤ Rad)
    (L : ℝ) (hL0 : 0 < L)
    (hL : ∀ x ∈ {x | F x ≤ F (R.x 0)}, ∀ y ∈ {x | F x ≤ F (R.x 0)},
      ‖euclideanVector (coordinateGradient ψ y - coordinateGradient ψ x)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        L * dot (coordinateGradient ψ y - coordinateGradient ψ x) (y - x))
    (Gγ : ℝ) (hG : ∀ x h, Homogeneous.Supports γ x h → ‖euclideanVector h‖ ≤ Gγ) (k : ℕ)
    (yψ yγ : Vec n)
    (hyψ : yψ = coordinateGradient ψ (R.x (k + 1)) - coordinateGradient ψ (R.x k))
    (hyγ : yγ = (R.g (k + 1) - coordinateGradient ψ (R.x (k + 1))) -
      (R.g k - coordinateGradient ψ (R.x k)))

theorem centered_split_notation {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (xstar : Vec n) (ψ γ : Vec n → ℝ)
    (hrep : ∀ x, F x = ψ x + γ (x - xstar))
    (U : Set (Vec n)) (hU : IsOpen U) (_hUc : Convex ℝ U)
    (_hψ : ConvexOn ℝ U ψ) (hψ11 : CenteredSmoothSublinear.LocallyC11On U ψ)
    (_hγ : ConvexOn ℝ univ γ) (_hγh : Homogeneous.PositiveDegreeOne γ)
    (_hmin : ∀ x, F xstar ≤ F x)

    (hKU : {x | F x ≤ F (R.x 0)} ⊆ U) (k : ℕ)
    (yψ yγ : Vec n)
    (hyψ : yψ = coordinateGradient ψ (R.x (k + 1)) - coordinateGradient ψ (R.x k))
    (hyγ : yγ = (R.g (k + 1) - coordinateGradient ψ (R.x (k + 1))) -
      (R.g k - coordinateGradient ψ (R.x k)))
    (a b ξ ζ : ℝ) (ha : a = dot yψ (R.displacement k)) (hb : b = dot yγ (R.displacement k))
    (hξ : ξ = dot yψ (R.x (k + 1) - xstar)) (hζ : ζ = dot yγ (R.x (k + 1) - xstar)) :
    HasFDerivAt γ (gradientFunctional (R.g k - coordinateGradient ψ (R.x k))) (R.x k - xstar) ∧
      HasFDerivAt γ (gradientFunctional (R.g (k + 1) - coordinateGradient ψ (R.x (k + 1))))
        (R.x (k + 1) - xstar) ∧
      R.gradientChange k = yψ + yγ ∧ R.curvature k = a + b ∧
      dot (R.gradientChange k) (R.x (k + 1) - xstar) = ξ + ζ

theorem five_piece_branches (w : Vec 3) :

      (FivePieceObstruction.family.branch 2 w = -w 1 + w 2) ∧

      FivePieceObstruction.initialMetric 1 = 1 ∧
      bfgsStep (1 : Mat 3) ![-1, 0, 0] α = α • ![1, 0, 0] ∧
      FivePieceObstruction.initialGradient = ![-1, 0, 0]

theorem five_piece_def (w : Vec 3) :
    FivePieceObstruction.objective w =
      max (max (max (max (-w 0) (w 1 + w 2)) (-w 1 + w 2)) (w 0 / 4)) (-w 2)

theorem five_piece_every_neighborhood (K : Set (Vec 3)) (hK : K ∈ 𝓝 0) :
    ∃ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ ∧ FivePieceObstruction.ray τ 0 ∈ K ∧
      (FivePieceObstruction.initialMetric τ).PosDef ∧
      HasFDerivAt FivePieceObstruction.objective
        (gradientFunctional FivePieceObstruction.initialGradient) (FivePieceObstruction.ray τ 0) ∧
      ∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → ∀ g : Vec 3,
        HasFDerivAt FivePieceObstruction.objective (gradientFunctional g)
          (FivePieceObstruction.ray τ α) →
        ¬ (FivePieceObstruction.objective (FivePieceObstruction.ray τ α) ≤
            FivePieceObstruction.objective (FivePieceObstruction.ray τ 0) +
              1 / 4 * dot FivePieceObstruction.initialGradient
                (bfgsStep (FivePieceObstruction.initialMetric τ)
                  FivePieceObstruction.initialGradient α) ∧
          1 / 2 * dot FivePieceObstruction.initialGradient
              (bfgsStep (FivePieceObstruction.initialMetric τ)
                FivePieceObstruction.initialGradient α) ≤
            dot g (bfgsStep (FivePieceObstruction.initialMetric τ)
              FivePieceObstruction.initialGradient α))

theorem five_piece_minimizer :

      (∀ w, FivePieceObstruction.objective w = FivePieceObstruction.objective 0 → w = 0) ∧
      Tendsto FivePieceObstruction.objective (cocompact (Vec 3)) atTop ∧
      ConvexOn ℝ univ FivePieceObstruction.objective

theorem five_piece_obstruction :

      γ (QuadraticGauge.right x))
    (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun (m + p) F) (k : ℕ)
    (δu : Vec m) (hδu : δu = QuadraticGauge.left (R.x (k + 1)) - QuadraticGauge.left (R.x k))
    (δv : Vec p) (hδv : δv = QuadraticGauge.right (R.x (k + 1)) - QuadraticGauge.right (R.x k))
    (h h' : Vec p) (hh : h = QuadraticGauge.right (R.g k))

    (a b ξ ζ : ℝ) (ha : a = dot δu (Q *ᵥ δu)) (hb : b = dot (h' - h) δv)
    (hξ : ξ = dot (Q *ᵥ δu) (QuadraticGauge.left (R.x (k + 1))))
    (hζ : ζ = dot (h' - h) (QuadraticGauge.right (R.x (k + 1)))) :

      Homogeneous.Supports γ (QuadraticGauge.right (R.x (k + 1))) h' ∧
      R.curvature k = a + b ∧ dot (R.gradientChange k) (R.x (k + 1)) = ξ + ζ

theorem alpha_terms_cancel {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (_hF : ConvexOn ℝ univ F)
    (hhom : Homogeneous.PositiveDegreeOne F) (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) (k : ℕ) :
    dot (R.g k) (R.x k) = F (R.x k) ∧
      dot (R.x (k + 1)) (R.hessian k *ᵥ R.x (k + 1)) =
        dot (R.x k) (R.hessian k *ᵥ R.x k) - 2 * R.α k * F (R.x k) + R.α k ^ 2 * R.q k ∧
      dot (R.g k) (R.x (k + 1)) = F (R.x k) - R.α k * R.q k ∧
      -2 * R.α k * F (R.x k) + R.α k ^ 2 * R.q k - (F (R.x k) - R.α k * R.q k) ^ 2 / R.q k =
        -(F (R.x k) ^ 2 / R.q k)

        dot (R.gradientChange k) (R.x (k + 1)) ^ 2 / R.curvature k ≤ R.d k) ∧
      Summable (fun k => dot (R.gradientChange k) (R.x (k + 1)) ^ 2 / R.curvature k) ∧
      Tendsto (fun N => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, (R.q k)⁻¹) atTop atTop ∧
      (L ≠ 0 → ∃ J : ℕ, ∀ k, J ≤ k → |L| / 2 ≤ |F (R.x k)|) ∧
      (∀ J : ℕ, (∀ k, J ≤ k → |L| / 2 ≤ |F (R.x k)|) → ∀ N : ℕ,
        (|L| / 2) ^ 2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, (R.q (J + k))⁻¹ ≤
          dot (R.x J) (R.hessian J *ᵥ R.x J) +
            ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N,

theorem block_general {m : ℕ} (slopes : Fin m → Vec 2) (F : Vec 2 → ℝ)
    (hF_def : ∀ x, IsGreatest (Set.range fun i => dot (slopes i) x) (F x))

    (hopp : R.g (a + 1) = -κ • g) :
    R.d a = F (R.x a) + F (R.x (a + 1)) / κ ∧
      (F (R.x (a + 1)) ≤ (1 - R.c₁) / (1 + R.c₁ / κ) * F (R.x a) ∧
        (1 - R.c₁) / (1 + R.c₁ / κ) * F (R.x a) ≤ (1 - R.c₁) * F (R.x a)) ∧
      F (R.x b) ≤ (1 - R.c₁) * F (R.x a) ∧

theorem common_vector_energy_step {n : ℕ} (F : Vec n → ℝ) (x : ℕ → Vec n) (H : ℕ → Mat n)
    (g : ℕ → Vec n) (α : ℕ → ℝ) (c₁ c₂ : ℝ) (_hc₁ : 0 < c₁) (_hc₁₂ : c₁ < c₂) (hc₂ : c₂ < 1)
    (hH0 : (H 0).PosDef) (hα : ∀ k, 0 < α k) (hg : ∀ k, g k ≠ 0)
    (_hgrad : ∀ k, HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional (g k)) (x k))
    (_hstep : ∀ k, x (k + 1) = x k + bfgsStep (H k) (g k) (α k))
    (hupd : ∀ k, H (k + 1) = inverseBFGS (H k) (bfgsStep (H k) (g k) (α k)) (g (k + 1) - g k))
    (_harmijo : ∀ k, F (x (k + 1)) ≤ F (x k) + c₁ * dot (g k) (bfgsStep (H k) (g k) (α k)))
    (hwolfe : ∀ k, dot (g (k + 1)) (bfgsStep (H k) (g k) (α k)) ≥

    (_hfinite : (Set.range g).Finite) (_hbdd : ∃ L : ℝ, ∀ k, L ≤ F (x k))
    (G : Set (Vec n)) (_hG : G = {v | ∃ᶠ k in atTop, g k = v})
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : ∀ k, J ≤ k → g k ∈ G) (_h0 : (0 : Vec n) ∉ affineSpan ℝ G)

    (∃ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ ∧ ∀ (z : Vec r) (M : ℝ), IsGreatest ((fun v => dot v (U *ᵥ z)) '' G) M →
        μ * ‖euclideanVector z‖ ≤ M) ∧
      ∃ K : ℕ, Tendsto R.x atTop (𝓝 (R.x K - (R.H K * U * (Uᵀ * R.H K * U)⁻¹ * Uᵀ) *ᵥ R.x K))

    (hF_def : ∀ x, IsGreatest (Set.range fun i => dot (a i) x) (F x))

    (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) (xstar : Vec n)
    (hxstar : xstar = R.x 0 - (R.H 0 * U * (Uᵀ * R.H 0 * U)⁻¹ * Uᵀ) *ᵥ R.x 0) :

    (∀ x, F xstar ≤ F x) → (∀ x, F x = F xstar → x = xstar) →

    AffineIndependent ℝ

    i₁ ∈ activeIndices F f xstar →
    (∀ i ∈ activeIndices F f xstar, 0 < lam i) → (∀ i, i ∉ activeIndices F f xstar → lam i = 0) →
    ∑ i, lam i = 1 → ∑ i, lam i • coordinateGradient (f i) xstar = 0 →
    (∀ v ∈ activeTangentSpace F f xstar i₁, v ≠ 0 →
      0 < ∑ i, lam i * dot v (RadialHessian.matrix (f i) xstar *ᵥ v)) →
    ∀ c₁ c₂ : ℝ, 0 < c₁ → c₁ < c₂ → c₂ < 1 →
      ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F, R.c₁ = c₁ → R.c₂ = c₂ →

      (∀ x, 18 * x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 + x 1 = 2 * x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 - x 1 ↔ ψ x 1 = 0) ∧

theorem barrier_comparison (F : Vec 2 → ℝ) (hF : ConvexOn ℝ univ F) (Fstar : ℝ)
    (_hFstar : IsLeast (range F) Fstar) (C : Set (Vec 2)) (ℓ : ℝ)
    (_hCcpt : IsCompact C) (_hCℓ : C ⊆ {x | F x = ℓ}) (_hℓ : Fstar < ℓ)
    (_hstrict : ∀ x y : Vec 2, segment ℝ x y ⊆ frontier {u | F u ≤ ℓ} → x = y)
    (_hnoncrit : ∀ p ∈ C, ¬IsAffineCritical F p)
    (_hregular : ∀ p ∈ C,
      (∃ V : Set (Vec 2), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 F V) ∨
      (∃ V : Set (Vec 2), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧ ∃ f₁ f₂ : Vec 2 → ℝ,
        ConvexOn ℝ V f₁ ∧ ConvexOn ℝ V f₂ ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f₁ V ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f₂ V ∧
        (∀ z ∈ V, F z = max (f₁ z) (f₂ z)) ∧ f₁ p = F p ∧ f₂ p = F p ∧
        LinearIndependent ℝ ![coordinateGradient f₁ p, coordinateGradient f₂ p]))
    (c₁ c₂ : ℝ) (hc₁ : 0 < c₁) (_hc₁₂ : c₁ < c₂) (_hc₂ : c₂ < 1)
    (w : Vec 2 → Vec 2) (x z g gz : Vec 2) (hp : EligiblePair F c₁ c₂ x z g gz)
    (s : Vec 2) (hs : s = z - x) (d : ℝ) (_hd : d = -dot g s) (q : ℝ → Vec 2)
    (hq : q = fun θ => x + θ • s) (φ D hl : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : φ = fun θ => F (q θ))
    (_hD : D = fun θ => pairDet s (w (q θ))) (hhl : hl = fun θ => Real.log |D θ|)
    (hDcont : ContinuousOn D (Icc 0 1)) (hD0 : ∀ θ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, D θ ≠ 0)
    (Cq : ℝ) (hCq : 0 ≤ Cq)
    (hbound : ∀ θ ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivWithinAt hl (derivWithin hl (Ioi θ) θ) (Ici θ) θ ∧
      |derivWithin hl (Ioi θ) θ| ≤ Cq * |derivWithin φ (Ioi θ) θ| ∧
      Cq * |derivWithin φ (Ioi θ) θ| ≤ Cq * (derivWithin φ (Ioi θ) θ + 2 * d)) :
    barrier Cq d φ 0 = 0 ∧
      (∀ θ ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivWithinAt (barrier Cq d φ)
          (Cq * (derivWithin φ (Ioi θ) θ + 2 * d)) (Ici θ) θ ∧
        |derivWithin hl (Ioi θ) θ| ≤ Cq * (derivWithin φ (Ioi θ) θ + 2 * d)) ∧
      |hl 1 - hl 0| ≤ barrier Cq d φ 1 ∧ barrier Cq d φ 1 ≤ 2 * Cq * d

    (hV : IsOpen V) (hp : p ∈ V) (f₁ f₂ : Vec 2 → ℝ) (_hc₁ : ConvexOn ℝ V f₁)
    (_hc₂ : ConvexOn ℝ V f₂) (hf₁ : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f₁ V) (hf₂ : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f₂ V)
    (hmax : ∀ z ∈ V, F z = max (f₁ z) (f₂ z)) (h₁ : f₁ p = F p) (h₂ : f₂ p = F p)
    (hind : LinearIndependent ℝ ![coordinateGradient f₁ p, coordinateGradient f₂ p]) :
    HomogeneousPlanar.pairDet (coordinateGradient f₁ p) (coordinateGradient f₂ p) ≠ 0 ∧
      coordinateGradient f₁ p ≠ coordinateGradient f₂ p ∧
      ∃ c : ℝ → Vec 2, c (F p) = p ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ 2 c (F p) ∧
        ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (F p), f₁ (c t) = t ∧ f₂ (c t) = t ∧ F (c t) = t ∧

theorem critical_components {n : ℕ} (F : Vec n → ℝ) (hF : ConvexOn ℝ univ F)
    (hSA : RealAlgebraicGeometry.IsSemialgebraicObjective F) :
    (connectedComponentIn {x | AffineCriticalObjective.IsAffineCritical F x} ''
        {x | AffineCriticalObjective.IsAffineCritical F x}).Finite ∧
      (∀ p : Fin n → ℝ, RealAlgebraicGeometry.IsSemialgebraic
        (connectedComponentIn {x | AffineCriticalObjective.IsAffineCritical F x} p)) ∧
      ∀ x p q : Vec n,
        p ∈ connectedComponentIn {z | AffineCriticalObjective.IsAffineCritical F z} x →
        q ∈ connectedComponentIn {z | AffineCriticalObjective.IsAffineCritical F z} x → F p = F q

theorem critical_composition_derivative_zero {n : ℕ} (F : Vec n → ℝ) (p : ℝ → Vec n) (t a : ℝ)
    (v : Vec n) (hp : HasDerivAt p v t) (hFp : HasDerivAt (F ∘ p) a t) :
    (∀ g ∈ subdifferential F (p t), dot g v = a) ∧ (IsAffineCritical F (p t) → a = 0)

        {z | AffineCriticalObjective.IsAffineCritical F z} ''
      {z | AffineCriticalObjective.IsAffineCritical F z}).Finite ∧
    ∀ x : Fin n → ℝ, RealAlgebraicGeometry.IsSemialgebraic
        (RealAlgebraicGeometry.piecewiseSmoothComponent
          {z | AffineCriticalObjective.IsAffineCritical F z} x) ∧
      RealAlgebraicGeometry.PiecewiseSmoothConnected
        (RealAlgebraicGeometry.piecewiseSmoothComponent
          {z | AffineCriticalObjective.IsAffineCritical F z} x)

theorem critical_path_values {n : ℕ} (F : Vec n → ℝ) (hF : ConvexOn ℝ univ F)
    (hSA : RealAlgebraicGeometry.IsSemialgebraicObjective F) :
    (∀ (x y : Vec n)
      (p : RealAlgebraicGeometry.PiecewiseSmoothPath {z | AffineCriticalObjective.IsAffineCritical F z}
        x y), (∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt (fun u => F (p.curve u)) 0 t) ∧
        ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, F (p.curve t) = F x) ∧
      ∀ x : Fin n → ℝ, ∀ q ∈ RealAlgebraicGeometry.piecewiseSmoothComponent
          {z | AffineCriticalObjective.IsAffineCritical F z} x,
        ∀ q' ∈ RealAlgebraicGeometry.piecewiseSmoothComponent
          {z | AffineCriticalObjective.IsAffineCritical F z} x, F q = F q'

    (x z g h : Vec 2) (hx : x ∈ V) (hz : z ∈ V) (hp : EligiblePair F c₁ c₂ x z g h)

    (hr : r = coordinateGradient (f j) z - coordinateGradient (f j) x) :

theorem determinant_quotient_bound (F : Vec 2 → ℝ) (hF : ConvexOn ℝ univ F) (Fstar : ℝ)

        (∀ z ∈ V, F z = max (f₁ z) (f₂ z)) ∧ f₁ p = F p ∧ f₂ p = F p ∧
        LinearIndependent ℝ ![coordinateGradient f₁ p, coordinateGradient f₂ p]))
    (c₁ c₂ : ℝ) (_hc₁ : 0 < c₁) (_hc₁₂ : c₁ < c₂) (_hc₂ : c₂ < 1)
    {m : ℕ} (χ : Fin m → Vec 2 → ℝ) (hχ : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (χ j)) (v : Fin m → ℝ → Vec 2)
    (w : Vec 2 → Vec 2) (hw : w = PlanarObjectiveField.field hF χ v)

    (hLip : ∀ p ∈ N, ∃ K : ℝ≥0, ∃ V ∈ 𝓝 p, LipschitzOnWith K w V)

    (κ δ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (_hδ : 0 < δ)

        D = (fun θ => pairDet s (w (q θ))) →
        ∀ θ ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) 1,
          HasDerivWithinAt D (derivWithin D (Ioi θ) θ) (Ici θ) θ ∧
          |derivWithin D (Ioi θ) θ / D θ| ≤ Cq * |derivWithin φ (Ioi θ) θ|

theorem absorption_inequality {m : ℕ} (P : Parabolic.Family m) (η B : ℝ) (c₁ c₂ : ℝ)
    (hc₁ : 0 ≤ c₁) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x z g g' : Vec 2,
      η ≤ P.objective x ∧ P.objective x ≤ B → η ≤ P.objective z ∧ P.objective z ≤ B →
      EligiblePair P.objective c₁ c₂ x z g g' →
      (2 * P.objective x - 2 * pairDecrease x z g) * pairCurvature x z g g' ≤
        C * |stepDeterminant x z| +
          C * pairDecrease x z g * (|horizontalStep x z| + pairDecrease x z g)

theorem arc_graph {m : ℕ} (P : Parabolic.Family m) (S : Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hS : S = {p | 0 ≤ p.1 ∧
      Finset.univ.sup' P.indices_nonempty (fun i => P.a i * p.1 + P.b i * p.2) = 1})
    (τ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hτ : ∀ v, τ v = Finset.univ.inf' P.indices_nonempty (fun i => (1 - P.b i * v) / P.a i)) :
    S = {p | p.2 ∈ Icc (Finset.univ.inf' P.indices_nonempty P.b)⁻¹
        (Finset.univ.sup' P.indices_nonempty P.b)⁻¹ ∧ p.1 = τ p.2} ∧
      Continuous τ ∧
      S = ⋃ i, {p | p ∈ S ∧ P.a i * p.1 + P.b i * p.2 = 1} ∧
      ∀ i, Convex ℝ {p : ℝ × ℝ | p ∈ S ∧ P.a i * p.1 + P.b i * p.2 = 1}

theorem branch_change {m : ℕ} (P : Parabolic.Family m) (L : Fin m → Vec 2 → ℝ)
    (hL : ∀ i y, L i y = P.a i * (y 0) ^ 2 / (2 * P.objective y) + P.calibration i) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      (∀ (i j : Fin m) (z : Vec 2), P.Active j z → 0 < P.objective z →
        |L j z - L i z| ≤ C * (P.objective z - (P.a i * (z 0) ^ 2 + P.b i * z 1)) / P.objective z) ∧
      ∀ (η B c₁ c₂ : ℝ), 0 < η → 0 ≤ c₁ → ∀ (x z g g' : Vec 2) (i j : Fin m),
        η ≤ P.objective x ∧ P.objective x ≤ B → η ≤ P.objective z ∧ P.objective z ≤ B →
        EligiblePair P.objective c₁ c₂ x z g g' → P.Active i x → P.Active j z →
        C * (P.objective z - (P.a i * (z 0) ^ 2 + P.b i * z 1)) / P.objective z ≤
          C / η * pairDecrease x z g

theorem breakpoint_value {m : ℕ} (P : Parabolic.Family m) (O : P.PrunedOrder)

    (hA : A = P.a (O.index i) + P.b (O.index i) * P.breakpoint (O.index i) (O.index j)) :

BfgsCoverage.Companion.Ch10Q.cancellatio.statement:
theorem cancellation {m : ℕ} (P : Parabolic.Family m) (x z g : Vec 2) (i : Fin m)
    (hi : P.Active i x) (hg : HasFDerivAt P.objective (gradientFunctional g) x)
    (hF : P.objective x ≠ 0) (hD : stepDeterminant x z ≠ 0) :
    pairDecrease x z g = -2 * P.a i * x 0 * horizontalStep x z - P.b i * normalStep x z ∧
      quotientMultiplier x z - 1 + P.a i * x 0 / P.objective x * horizontalStep x z =
        -(x 1 * horizontalStep x z * pairDecrease x z g) /
          (P.objective x * stepDeterminant x z)

theorem compensated_log {m : ℕ} (P : Parabolic.Family m) (η B : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (c₁ c₂ : ℝ) (hc₁ : 0 ≤ c₁) (hc₂ : c₂ < 1) :

      η ≤ P.objective x ∧ P.objective x ≤ B → η ≤ P.objective z ∧ P.objective z ≤ B →
      EligiblePair P.objective c₁ c₂ x z g g' → pairDecrease x z g ≤ δ →
      stepDeterminant x z ≠ 0 ∧ 0 < P.compensatedMultiplier x z ∧

theorem deficits_nonneg {m : ℕ} (P : Parabolic.Family m) (η B : ℝ) (_hη : 0 < η) (x z : Vec 2)
    (_hx : η ≤ P.objective x ∧ P.objective x ≤ B) (_hz : η ≤ P.objective z ∧ P.objective z ≤ B)
    (i j : Fin m) (_hi : P.Active i x) (_hj : P.Active j z)

BfgsCoverage.Companion.Ch10Q.denominator.statement:
theorem denominator_bounds {m : ℕ} (P : Parabolic.Family m) (η B : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (c₁ c₂ : ℝ) (hc₁ : 0 ≤ c₁) (hc₂ : c₂ < 1) :
    ∃ C δ : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x z g g' : Vec 2,
      η ≤ P.objective x ∧ P.objective x ≤ B → η ≤ P.objective z ∧ P.objective z ≤ B →
      EligiblePair P.objective c₁ c₂ x z g g' → pairDecrease x z g ≤ δ →
      pairDecrease x z g ≤ C * |stepDeterminant x z| ∧
        |horizontalStep x z| ≤ C * |stepDeterminant x z| ∧ stepDeterminant x z ≠ 0

BfgsCoverage.Companion.Ch10Q.determinant.statement:
theorem determinant_identity' {m : ℕ} (P : Parabolic.Family m) (x z g g' : Vec 2)
    (hg : HasFDerivAt P.objective (gradientFunctional g) x) :
    determinant g (g' - g) * stepDeterminant x z =
        dot g (pairStep x z) * dot (g' - g) (radialDirection x) -
          dot g (radialDirection x) * dot (g' - g) (pairStep x z) ∧
      dot g (pairStep x z) * dot (g' - g) (radialDirection x) -
          dot g (radialDirection x) * dot (g' - g) (pairStep x z) =
        -pairDecrease x z g * dot (g' - g) (radialDirection x) -
          2 * P.objective x * pairCurvature x z g g'

BfgsCoverage.Companion.Ch10Q.eligible_st.statement:
theorem eligible_step_bounds {m : ℕ} (P : Parabolic.Family m) (x z : Vec 2) (g g' : Vec 2)

    (z 0 - x 0) ^ 2 ≤ pairDecrease x z g / P.minQuadratic ∧

theorem example_scale (θ : Vec 2 → ℝ)
    (hθ₁ : ∀ x : Vec 2, x 1 < -(x 0) ^ 2 →
      θ x = Real.exp ((x 0) ^ 2 / Example.objective x - 1 / 3))
    (hθ₂ : ∀ x : Vec 2, -(x 0) ^ 2 < x 1 → x 1 < 2 * (x 0) ^ 2 → θ x = 1)
    (hθ₃ : ∀ x : Vec 2, 2 * (x 0) ^ 2 < x 1 →
      θ x = Real.exp ((x 0) ^ 2 / (2 * Example.objective x) - 1 / 6))
    (k : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hk : k = ![-1 / 6, -1 / 2, -1 / 3]) :
    (∀ x : Vec 2, x 1 ≠ -(x 0) ^ 2 → x 1 ≠ 2 * (x 0) ^ 2 → θ x = Example.sourceScale x) ∧
      (∀ x : Vec 2, x 1 ≠ -(x 0) ^ 2 → x 1 ≠ 2 * (x 0) ^ 2 → ∀ i, Example.family.Active i x →

theorem segment_affine {m : ℕ} (P : Parabolic.Family m) (L : Fin m → Vec 2 → ℝ)
    (hL : ∀ i y, L i y = P.a i * (y 0) ^ 2 / (2 * P.objective y) + P.calibration i)
    (z : Vec 2) (hz : 0 < P.objective z) (i j : Fin m) (hj : P.Active j z)
    (t0 v0 : ℝ) (ht0 : t0 = (z 0) ^ 2 / P.objective z) (hv0 : v0 = z 1 / P.objective z) :
    (P.objective z - (P.a i * (z 0) ^ 2 + P.b i * z 1)) / P.objective z =
        1 - P.a i * t0 - P.b i * v0 ∧
      L j z - L i z = (P.a j - P.a i) * t0 / 2 + P.calibration j - P.calibration i ∧
      t0 = (1 - P.b j * v0) / P.a j ∧
      1 - P.a i * t0 - P.b i * v0 = (1 - P.a i / P.a j) + (P.a i * P.b j / P.a j - P.b i) * v0 ∧
      (P.a j - P.a i) * t0 / 2 + P.calibration j - P.calibration i =
        ((P.a j - P.a i) / 2 / P.a j + P.calibration j - P.calibration i) +
          (-(P.a j - P.a i) / 2 * (P.b j / P.a j)) * v0

def cutoffBeta {n : ℕ} (τ : ℝ → ℝ) (a : Vec n) (b : ℝ) (x z : Vec n) : ℝ :=
  if dot a (z - x) ≠ 0 then (τ (dot a z - b) - τ (dot a x - b)) / dot a (z - x) else 0

BfgsCoverage.Companion.Ch11U.cutoffBeta_.statement:
theorem cutoffBeta_eq_cutoffSlope {n : ℕ} (τ : ℝ → ℝ) (a : Vec n) (b : ℝ) (x z : Vec n) :
    cutoffBeta τ a b x z = cutoffSlope τ (dot a x - b) (dot a z - b)

BfgsCoverage.Companion.Ch11U.cutoff_exis.statement:
theorem cutoff_exists (E : Set ℝ) (_hE : IsClosed E) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ τ : ℝ → ℝ, ∃ Lτ : ℝ≥0, LipschitzWith Lτ τ ∧ (∀ t, 0 ≤ τ t ∧ τ t ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ t e, e ∈ E → |t - e| ≤ δ / 4 → τ t = 0) ∧
      (∀ t, (∀ e ∈ E, δ / 2 ≤ |t - e|) → τ t = 1)

theorem frame_columns {n m : ℕ} (a : Vec n) (_ha : sqNorm a = 1) (b : ℝ)
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℝ) (_hU : Uᵀ * U = 1)
    (_hUS : ∀ v, (U * Uᵀ) *ᵥ v = tangentProjection a v) (τ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (V : Vec n → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ) (hV : ∀ x, V x = frame U a (τ (dot a x - b)))
    (x : Vec n) :
    (∀ i j, V x i (Fin.castSucc j) = U i j) ∧ (∀ i, V x i (Fin.last m) = τ (dot a x - b) * a i)

theorem frame_pairing {n : ℕ} (F : Vec n → ℝ) (hF : ConvexOn ℝ univ F)
    (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F)
    (c : ℝ) (K : Set (Vec n)) (_hK_def : K = {x | F x ≤ c}) (_hK : IsCompact K)
    (_hrun : ∀ k, R.x k ∈ K)
    (Ω : Set (Vec n)) (_hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (_hΩc : Convex ℝ Ω) (_hKΩ : K ⊆ Ω)
    (μ : ℝ) (_hμ : 0 < μ) (_hstrong : EuclideanStrongConvexOn Ω μ F)
    (a : Vec n) (_ha : sqNorm a = 1) (b : ℝ) (A : Vec n → Vec n)
    (hA : ∀ x ∈ Ω, ∀ g ∈ ConvexSubdifferential.subdifferential F x,
      tangentProjection a g = A x)
    (L : ℝ≥0) (_hLip : LipschitzOnWith L A Ω) (E : Set ℝ) (_hE : IsClosed E)
    (_hsmooth : CenteredSmoothSublinear.LocallyC11On (Ω \ {x | dot a x - b ∈ E}) F)
    {m : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℝ) (hU : Uᵀ * U = 1)
    (hUS : ∀ v, (U * Uᵀ) *ᵥ v = tangentProjection a v)
    (δ : ℝ) (_hδ : 0 < δ) (τ : ℝ → ℝ) (Lτ : ℝ≥0) (_hτ : LipschitzWith Lτ τ)
    (_hτ01 : ∀ t, 0 ≤ τ t ∧ τ t ≤ 1)
    (_hτ0 : ∀ t e, e ∈ E → |t - e| ≤ δ / 4 → τ t = 0)
    (_hτ1 : ∀ t, (∀ e ∈ E, δ / 2 ≤ |t - e|) → τ t = 1)
    (x g : Vec n) (hxΩ : x ∈ Ω) (hg : HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional g) x) :
    sqNorm ((frame U a (τ (dot a x - b)))ᵀ *ᵥ g) =
      sqNorm (A x) + τ (dot a x - b) ^ 2 * |dot a g| ^ 2

theorem frame_pairing_eq_cutoffFrame {n m : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℝ) (a : Vec n)
    (t : ℝ) (y : Vec n) :
    sqNorm ((frame U a t)ᵀ *ᵥ y) = sqNorm ((cutoffFrame U a t)ᵀ.mulVec y)

theorem frame_pairing_sq {n m : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℝ) (a : Vec n) (t : ℝ)
    (y : Vec n) :
    sqNorm ((frame U a t)ᵀ *ᵥ y) = sqNorm (Uᵀ *ᵥ y) + t ^ 2 * (dot a y) ^ 2

theorem frame_transport {n : ℕ} (F : Vec n → ℝ) (_hF : ConvexOn ℝ univ F)
    (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F)
    (c : ℝ) (K : Set (Vec n)) (_hK_def : K = {x | F x ≤ c}) (_hK : IsCompact K)
    (_hrun : ∀ k, R.x k ∈ K)
    (Ω : Set (Vec n)) (_hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (_hΩc : Convex ℝ Ω) (_hKΩ : K ⊆ Ω)
    (μ : ℝ) (_hμ : 0 < μ) (_hstrong : EuclideanStrongConvexOn Ω μ F)
    (a : Vec n) (_ha : sqNorm a = 1) (b : ℝ) (A : Vec n → Vec n)
    (_hA : ∀ x ∈ Ω, ∀ g ∈ ConvexSubdifferential.subdifferential F x,
      tangentProjection a g = A x)
    (L : ℝ≥0) (_hLip : LipschitzOnWith L A Ω) (E : Set ℝ) (_hE : IsClosed E)
    (_hsmooth : CenteredSmoothSublinear.LocallyC11On (Ω \ {x | dot a x - b ∈ E}) F)
    {m : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℝ) (_hU : Uᵀ * U = 1)
    (_hUS : ∀ v, (U * Uᵀ) *ᵥ v = tangentProjection a v)
    (δ : ℝ) (_hδ : 0 < δ) (τ : ℝ → ℝ) (Lτ : ℝ≥0) (_hτ : LipschitzWith Lτ τ)
    (_hτ01 : ∀ t, 0 ≤ τ t ∧ τ t ≤ 1)
    (_hτ0 : ∀ t e, e ∈ E → |t - e| ≤ δ / 4 → τ t = 0)
    (_hτ1 : ∀ t, (∀ e ∈ E, δ / 2 ≤ |t - e|) → τ t = 1)
    (V : Vec n → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ) (hV : ∀ x, V x = frame U a (τ (dot a x - b)))
    (x z s : Vec n) (hs : s = z - x) (β : ℝ) (hβ : β = cutoffBeta τ a b x z) :
    V z = V x + β • vecMulVec s (lastBasis m) - β • vecMulVec (tangentProjection a s) (lastBasis m)

theorem frame_transport_identity {n m : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℝ) (a : Vec n) (b : ℝ)
    (τ : ℝ → ℝ) (x z : Vec n) :
    frame U a (τ (dot a z - b)) =
      frame U a (τ (dot a x - b)) + cutoffBeta τ a b x z • vecMulVec (z - x) (lastBasis m) -
        cutoffBeta τ a b x z • vecMulVec (tangentProjection a (z - x)) (lastBasis m)

theorem immediate_family_tangent {m : ℕ} (F ψ : Vec (m + 1) → ℝ) (h : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hrep : ∀ (u : Vec m) (v : ℝ), F (Fin.cons v u) = ψ (Fin.cons v u) + h v)
    (_hψ : ConvexOn ℝ univ ψ) (hψs : CenteredSmoothSublinear.LocallyC11On univ ψ)

    (x g : Vec (m + 1)) (hg : g ∈ ConvexSubdifferential.subdifferential F x) :

theorem zero_set_parallel_general {n : ℕ} {F : Vec n → ℝ} (hF : ConvexOn ℝ univ F)

theorem bfgs_update {n : ℕ} (H : Mat n) (g gplus : Vec n) (α : ℝ) (p s y : Vec n) (t : ℝ)

BfgsCoverage.Companion.Ch12D.coercive_fa.statement:
theorem coercive_failure (Gbar : Vec 2 → ℝ)
    (hGbar : ∀ x : Vec 2, Gbar x =
      max (max (x 0) (-x 0 - x 1 / 8)) (max (seedC * x 0 + seedD * x 1) (x 1 - 17))) :
    Tendsto Gbar (cocompact (Vec 2)) atTop ∧ Gbar ![-1, 16] = -1 ∧ (∀ x, Gbar ![-1, 16] ≤ Gbar x) ∧
    Gbar 0 = 0 ∧ (0 : Vec 2) ∉ ConvexSubdifferential.subdifferential Gbar 0 ∧
    ∀ c₁ c₂ : ℝ, 0 < c₁ → c₁ ≤ 1/3 → c₁ < c₂ → c₂ < 1 →
      ∃ R : AdmissibleBFGSRun 2 Gbar,
        R.c₁ = c₁ ∧ R.c₂ = c₂ ∧ R.x 0 = Failure.seedPoint 0 ∧ R.H 0 = 1 ∧
        R.x = orbitPoint ∧ R.H = orbitMetric ∧
        (∀ k N, 5 ≤ N → DeterministicLineSearch.fromMetric Gbar (R.x k) (R.H k) c₁ c₂ N =
          (some (R.α k), trialHistory (phase k))) ∧
        (∀ R' : AdmissibleBFGSRun 2 Gbar, R'.x 0 = Failure.seedPoint 0 → R'.H 0 = 1 →
          (∀ k, ∃ N L, DeterministicLineSearch.fromMetric Gbar (R'.x k) (R'.H k) c₁ c₂ N =
            (some (R'.α k), L)) → R'.x = R.x ∧ R'.H = R.H) ∧
        Tendsto R.x atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ Tendsto (fun k => Gbar (R.x k)) atTop (𝓝 (Gbar 0))

BfgsCoverage.Companion.Ch12D.cone_orbit.statement:
theorem cone_orbit (c₁ c₂ : ℝ) (hc₁ : 0 < c₁) (hc₁' : c₁ ≤ 1/3) (hc : c₁ < c₂) (hc₂ : c₂ < 1) :
    ∃ R : AdmissibleBFGSRun 2 (objective seedC seedD),
      R.c₁ = c₁ ∧ R.c₂ = c₂ ∧ R.x 0 = Failure.seedPoint 0 ∧ R.H 0 = 1 ∧
      R.x = orbitPoint ∧ R.H = orbitMetric ∧ R.g = orbitGradient ∧
      (∀ k N, 5 ≤ N → DeterministicLineSearch.fromMetric (objective seedC seedD) (R.x k) (R.H k) c₁ c₂ N =
        (some (R.α k), trialHistory (phase k))) ∧
      (∀ R' : AdmissibleBFGSRun 2 (objective seedC seedD), R'.x 0 = Failure.seedPoint 0 → R'.H 0 = 1 →
        (∀ k, ∃ N L, DeterministicLineSearch.fromMetric (objective seedC seedD) (R'.x k) (R'.H k) c₁ c₂ N =
          (some (R'.α k), L)) → R'.x = R.x ∧ R'.H = R.H) ∧
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (j : Fin 3), R.x (3 * m + j) = seedRatio ^ m • Failure.seedPoint j.castSucc ∧
        R.H (3 * m + j) = seedRatio ^ m • metric seedC seedD j

BfgsCoverage.Companion.Ch12D.cone_scalin.statement:
theorem cone_scaling (m : ℕ) (j : Fin 3) (q : Fin 9) (hq : trialPhase q = j) (c₁ c₂ : ℝ) :
    orbitPoint (3 * m + j) + trialLength q • bfgsStep (orbitMetric (3 * m + j)) (orbitGradient (3 * m + j)) 1 =
      seedRatio ^ m • (Failure.seedPoint j.castSucc + trialLength q • Failure.seedDir j) ∧
    bfgsStep (orbitMetric (3 * m + j)) (orbitGradient (3 * m + j)) 1 = seedRatio ^ m • Failure.seedDir j ∧
    objective seedC seedD (seedRatio ^ m • (Failure.seedPoint j.castSucc + trialLength q • Failure.seedDir j)) -
        objective seedC seedD (seedRatio ^ m • Failure.seedPoint j.castSucc) =
      seedRatio ^ m * (objective seedC seedD (Failure.seedPoint j.castSucc + trialLength q • Failure.seedDir j) -
        objective seedC seedD (Failure.seedPoint j.castSucc)) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin 3, dot (SeedOrbit.gradient seedC seedD i) (seedRatio ^ m • Failure.seedDir j) =
      seedRatio ^ m * dot (SeedOrbit.gradient seedC seedD i) (Failure.seedDir j)) ∧
    (DeterministicLineSearch.Armijo (objective seedC seedD) (seedRatio ^ m • Failure.seedPoint j.castSucc)
        (seedRatio ^ m • Failure.seedDir j) (SeedOrbit.gradient seedC seedD j) c₁ (trialLength q) ↔
      DeterministicLineSearch.Armijo (objective seedC seedD) (Failure.seedPoint j.castSucc) (Failure.seedDir j)
        (SeedOrbit.gradient seedC seedD j) c₁ (trialLength q)) ∧
    (DeterministicLineSearch.Wolfe (objective seedC seedD) (seedRatio ^ m • Failure.seedPoint j.castSucc)
        (seedRatio ^ m • Failure.seedDir j) (SeedOrbit.gradient seedC seedD j) c₂ (trialLength q) ↔
      DeterministicLineSearch.Wolfe (objective seedC seedD) (Failure.seedPoint j.castSucc) (Failure.seedDir j)
        (SeedOrbit.gradient seedC seedD j) c₂ (trialLength q))

BfgsCoverage.Companion.Ch12D.contraction.statement:

      {z | ‖z - AlgebraicSeed.center‖ ≤ 1 / 10 ^ 30} {z | ‖z - AlgebraicSeed.center‖ ≤ 1 / 10 ^ 30} ∧
    ∃ κ : ℝ, κ < 1 ∧ ∀ z w : Vec 2, ‖z - AlgebraicSeed.center‖ ≤ 1 / 10 ^ 30 →
      ‖w - AlgebraicSeed.center‖ ≤ 1 / 10 ^ 30 →
      ‖(z - AlgebraicSeed.M *ᵥ AlgebraicSeed.P z) - (w - AlgebraicSeed.M *ᵥ AlgebraicSeed.P w)‖ ≤

BfgsCoverage.Companion.Ch12D.embedded_de.statement:
theorem embedded_decisions (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (c₁ c₂ : ℝ) (hc₁ : 0 < c₁) (hc₁' : c₁ ≤ 1/3)
    (hc : c₁ < c₂) (hc₂ : c₂ < 1) (m : ℕ) (j : Fin 3) (q : Fin 9) (hq : trialPhase q = j)
    (x : Vec 2) (H : Mat 2) (g p : Vec 2)
    (hx : x = (DEmbedding.run hn c₁ c₂ hc₁ hc₁' hc hc₂).x (3 * m + j))
    (hH : H = (DEmbedding.run hn c₁ c₂ hc₁ hc₁' hc hc₂).H (3 * m + j))
    (hg : g = (DEmbedding.run hn c₁ c₂ hc₁ hc₁' hc hc₂).g (3 * m + j)) (hp : p = bfgsStep H g 1) :
    DEmbedding.objective (x + trialLength q • p) - DEmbedding.objective x =
      (scale n) ^ 4 * seedRatio ^ m *
        (objective seedC seedD (query q) - objective seedC seedD (Failure.seedPoint j.castSucc)) ∧
    dot g (trialLength q • p) =
      (scale n) ^ 4 * seedRatio ^ m * dot (SeedOrbit.gradient seedC seedD j) (trialLength q • Failure.seedDir j) ∧
    (DeterministicLineSearch.Armijo DEmbedding.objective x p g c₁ (trialLength q) ↔
      DeterministicLineSearch.Armijo (objective seedC seedD) (Failure.seedPoint j.castSucc) (Failure.seedDir j)
        (SeedOrbit.gradient seedC seedD j) c₁ (trialLength q)) ∧
    (DeterministicLineSearch.Wolfe DEmbedding.objective x p g c₂ (trialLength q) ↔
      DeterministicLineSearch.Wolfe (objective seedC seedD) (Failure.seedPoint j.castSucc) (Failure.seedDir j)
        (SeedOrbit.gradient seedC seedD j) c₂ (trialLength q)) ∧
    DeterministicLineSearch.fromMetric DEmbedding.objective x H c₁ c₂ 5 = (some (length j), trialHistory j)

BfgsCoverage.Companion.Ch12D.final_limit.statement:

      DEmbedding.objective ((DEmbedding.run hn c₁ c₂ hc₁ hc₁' hc hc₂).x k)) ∧
    Tendsto (fun k => DEmbedding.objective ((DEmbedding.run hn c₁ c₂ hc₁ hc₁' hc hc₂).x k)) atTop
      (𝓝 ((scale n) ^ 3)) ∧

    (∀ x : Vec 2, DEmbedding.objective x = 0 → dot g0 x = 0 ∧ dot g1 x = 0) ∧
    LinearIndependent ℝ ![g0, g1] ∧
    (∀ x : Vec 2, DEmbedding.objective x = 0 → x = 0) ∧
    (∀ (a : ℝ) (x : Vec 2), DEmbedding.objective x ≤ a →
      min (-1) (-a) ≤ dot g0 x ∧ dot g0 x ≤ max 2 (a + 2) ∧
      min (-1) (-a) ≤ dot g1 x ∧ dot g1 x ≤ max 2 (a + 2)) ∧
    (∀ a : ℝ, IsCompact {x | DEmbedding.objective x ≤ a}) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin 3, HasFDerivAt (DEmbedding.branch i.castSucc) (gradientFunctional 0) 0) ∧
    (∀ h : Vec 2, Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (DEmbedding.objective (t • h) - DEmbedding.objective 0) / t)
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (max 0 (h 1)))) ∧
    (∀ x, DEmbedding.objective 0 ≤ DEmbedding.objective x) ∧
    (∀ x, DEmbedding.objective x = DEmbedding.objective 0 → x = 0) ∧
    ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ DEmbedding.objective (0 : Vec 2)

theorem phi_def {b : ℝ} (hb : b = 2 ∨ b = DEmbedding.bStar) :
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ), b * theta * scale n ≤ x → x ≤ b * scale n →
      coordinate b (scale n) x = (x / (b * scale n) - theta) / (1 - theta) ∧
      coordinate b (scale n) x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
      DScalar.phi b x = (theta * scale n) ^ 3 + b * (scale n) ^ 3 * (1 - theta) *
        (theta ^ 2 * coordinate b (scale n) x +
          (1 - theta ^ 2) * DScalarRamp.primitive b (coordinate b (scale n) x))) ∧
    (∀ x : ℝ, x < -1 → DScalar.phi b x = 1 - 3 * (x + 1) + 3 * (x + 1) ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ x : ℝ, -1 ≤ x → x ≤ 0 → DScalar.phi b x = -x ^ 3) ∧
    (∀ x : ℝ, b ≤ x → DScalar.phi b x = 1 + x - b)

theorem scaled_update {n : ℕ} (H : Mat n) (g gplus : Vec n) (α lam r : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hr : 0 < r)
    (s y s' y' : Vec n) (hs : s = bfgsStep H g α) (hy : y = gplus - g)
    (hs' : s' = bfgsStep (r • H) (lam • g) α) (hy' : y' = lam • gplus - lam • g) :
    s' = (lam * r) • s ∧ y' = lam • y ∧
    (dot y' s')⁻¹ • outer s' y' = (dot y s)⁻¹ • outer s y ∧
    (dot y' s')⁻¹ • outer y' s' = (dot y s)⁻¹ • outer y s ∧
    (dot y' s')⁻¹ • outer s' s' = r • ((dot y s)⁻¹ • outer s s) ∧
    Failure.fullUpdate (r • H) (lam • g) (lam • gplus) α = r • Failure.fullUpdate H g gplus α

BfgsCoverage.Companion.Ch12D.specified_s.statement:
theorem specified_search {n : ℕ} (F : Vec n → ℝ) (x : Vec n) (H : Mat n) (c₁ c₂ : ℝ)
    (g : Vec n) (hg : HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional g) x) (p : Vec n) (hp : p = -(H *ᵥ g)) :
    (∀ N, DeterministicLineSearch.fromMetric F x H c₁ c₂ N =
      DeterministicLineSearch.search F x p g c₁ c₂ N 0 none 1) ∧
    (∀ (lo : ℝ) (hi : Option ℝ) (α : ℝ),
      DeterministicLineSearch.search F x p g c₁ c₂ 0 lo hi α = (none, [])) ∧
    ∀ (N : ℕ) (lo : ℝ) (hi : Option ℝ) (α : ℝ),
      DeterministicLineSearch.search F x p g c₁ c₂ (N + 1) lo hi α =
        if DeterministicLineSearch.Armijo F x p g c₁ α then
          if DeterministicLineSearch.Wolfe F x p g c₂ α then (some α, [α])

        LScalarGeometric.scale n • SeedOrbit.gradient seedC seedD i) ∧
      LEmbedding.branch 3 (LEmbedding.copyCenter n) < LEmbedding.objective (LEmbedding.copyCenter n) ∧
      (0 : Vec 2) ∉ ConvexSubdifferential.subdifferential LEmbedding.objective (LEmbedding.copyCenter n)) ∧

BfgsCoverage.Companion.Ch13L.global_fail.statement:
theorem global_failure :
    ∃ g : Fin 3 → Vec 2, ∀ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ → ∀ Q : Vec 2 → ℝ,
      (∀ x, Q x = μ / 2 * sqNorm x + max (max (dot (g 0) x) (dot (g 1) x)) (dot (g 2) x)) →
      -- `μ`-strongly convex and coercive
      FixedNormal.EuclideanStrongConvexOn univ μ Q ∧ Tendsto Q (cocompact (Vec 2)) atTop ∧
      -- a unique nonsmooth minimizer `x_* ≠ 0`
      (∃ xs : Vec 2, xs ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ x, Q xs ≤ Q x) ∧ (∀ x, Q x = Q xs → x = xs) ∧
        ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ Q xs) ∧
      -- the origin is nonstationary
      (0 : Vec 2) ∉ ConvexSubdifferential.subdifferential Q 0 ∧
      -- every branch has Hessian exactly `μ I` globally
      (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun x => μ / 2 * sqNorm x + dot (g i) x) ∧
        ∀ x, RadialHessian.matrix (fun y => μ / 2 * sqNorm y + dot (g i) y) x = μ • (1 : Mat 2)) ∧
      -- initial states, arbitrarily close to the origin, and their runs
      ∀ W ∈ 𝓝 LNormalizedReturn.seed, ∀ V ∈ 𝓝 (0 : Vec 2),
        ∃ (w₀ : LNormalizedReturn.State) (x : ℕ → Vec 2) (H : ℕ → Mat 2),
          w₀ ∈ W ∧ 0 < LNormalizedReturn.scale w₀ ∧
          x 0 = LNormalizedReturn.scale w₀ • LNormalizedReturn.point w₀ ∧
          H 0 = LNormalizedReturn.scale w₀ • LNormalizedReturn.shape w₀ ∧ (H 0).PosDef ∧
          -- converging to the (nonstationary) origin
          Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ (∀ k, x k ∈ V) ∧
          -- every trial is differentiable and lies in `V`
          (∀ k, ∀ a ∈ trialHistory (phase k),
            DifferentiableAt ℝ Q (x k + a • bfgsStep (H k) (coordinateGradient Q (x k)) 1) ∧
            x k + a • bfgsStep (H k) (coordinateGradient Q (x k)) 1 ∈ V) ∧
          -- the same deterministic full-BFGS iterates for every pair
          ∀ c₁ c₂ : ℝ, 0 < c₁ → c₁ ≤ 1/3 → c₁ < c₂ → c₂ < 1 →
            ∃ R : AdmissibleBFGSRun 2 Q, R.c₁ = c₁ ∧ R.c₂ = c₂ ∧ R.x = x ∧ R.H = H ∧
              (∀ k N, 5 ≤ N → NonStrictLineSearch.fromMetric Q (R.x k) (R.H k) c₁ c₂ N =
                (some (R.α k), trialHistory (phase k))) ∧
              -- the accepted lengths repeat `1, 1/4, 1/16`
              ∀ m, R.α (3 * m) = 1 ∧ R.α (3 * m + 1) = 1/4 ∧ R.α (3 * m + 2) = 1/16

theorem hyperbolic_spectrum (μ : ℝ) :
    ∃ ls lu : ℝ, ((0.038 : ℝ) < ls ∧ ls < 0.039) ∧ ((1.564 : ℝ) < lu ∧ lu < 1.565) ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (LNormalizedReturn.returnMap μ) LNormalizedReturn.seed).toLinearMap.charpoly.roots =
        {seedRatio⁻¹, seedRatio⁻¹, ls, lu, seedRatio} ∧
      Multiset.filter (fun t => |t| < 1) {seedRatio⁻¹, seedRatio⁻¹, ls, lu, seedRatio} = {ls, seedRatio} ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ = 1 → Polynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap ℝ ℂ) z
        (fderiv ℝ (LNormalizedReturn.returnMap μ) LNormalizedReturn.seed).toLinearMap.charpoly ≠ 0) ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (LNormalizedReturn.returnMap μ) LNormalizedReturn.seed).toLinearMap.charpoly.eval 0 ≠ 0 ∧
      (∃ E : LNormalizedReturn.State ≃L[ℝ] LNormalizedReturn.State,
        E.toContinuousLinearMap = fderiv ℝ (LNormalizedReturn.returnMap μ) LNormalizedReturn.seed) ∧
      ContDiffAt ℝ ⊤ (LNormalizedReturn.returnMap μ) LNormalizedReturn.seed ∧
      ∃ S : LNormalizedReturn.State → LNormalizedReturn.State, ContDiffAt ℝ ⊤ S LNormalizedReturn.seed ∧
        S LNormalizedReturn.seed = LNormalizedReturn.seed ∧
        (∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 LNormalizedReturn.seed, S (LNormalizedReturn.returnMap μ x) = x) ∧
        (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 LNormalizedReturn.seed, LNormalizedReturn.returnMap μ (S y) = y)
