BfgsCoverage.Companion.Ch13L.local_failu.statement:
theorem local_failure :
    ∃ F₁ F₂ : Vec 2 → ℝ,
      (∀ F ∈ ({F₁, F₂} : Set (Vec 2 → ℝ)),
        -- a finite strongly convex objective with compact sublevels
        (∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ FixedNormal.EuclideanStrongConvexOn univ κ F) ∧
        (∀ a : ℝ, IsCompact {x | F x ≤ a}) ∧
        -- and a unique nonsmooth minimizer at zero
        (∀ x, F 0 ≤ F x) ∧ (∀ x, F x = F 0 → x = 0) ∧ ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ F (0 : Vec 2) ∧
        -- constants `0 < μ̲ ≤ L̄ < ∞` with the Hessian bounds at every twice-differentiable point
        (∃ μl Lu : ℝ, 0 < μl ∧ μl ≤ Lu ∧ ∀ x : Vec 2,
          (∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, DifferentiableAt ℝ F z) → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) x →
          (RadialHessian.matrix F x).IsSymm ∧ ∀ v,
            μl * sqNorm v ≤ dot v ((RadialHessian.matrix F x).mulVec v) ∧
            dot v ((RadialHessian.matrix F x).mulVec v) ≤ Lu * sqNorm v) ∧
        -- bad initial points `x₀⁽ⁿ⁾ → 0` with `H₀ = I`, converging to nonstationary `p_n → 0`
        ∃ (x : ℕ → ℕ → Vec 2) (H : ℕ → ℕ → Mat 2) (p : ℕ → Vec 2),
          Tendsto (fun n => x n 0) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ (∀ n, H n 0 = 1) ∧
          (∀ n, Tendsto (x n) atTop (𝓝 (p n))) ∧
          (∀ n, (0 : Vec 2) ∉ ConvexSubdifferential.subdifferential F (p n)) ∧
          Tendsto p atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
          (∀ n k, ∀ a ∈ trialHistory (phase k),
            DifferentiableAt ℝ F (x n k + a • bfgsStep (H n k) (coordinateGradient F (x n k)) 1)) ∧
          -- all trial points of the `n`th run remain uniformly near zero
          (∀ U ∈ 𝓝 (0 : Vec 2), ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, ∀ k, ∀ a ∈ trialHistory (phase k),
            x n k + a • bfgsStep (H n k) (coordinateGradient F (x n k)) 1 ∈ U) ∧
          -- the runs of the implementation, the same for every pair
          ∀ c₁ c₂ : ℝ, 0 < c₁ → c₁ ≤ 1/3 → c₁ < c₂ → c₂ < 1 →
            ∃ R : ℕ → AdmissibleBFGSRun 2 F, ∀ n,
              (R n).c₁ = c₁ ∧ (R n).c₂ = c₂ ∧ (R n).x = x n ∧ (R n).H = H n ∧
              ∀ k N, 5 ≤ N → NonStrictLineSearch.fromMetric F ((R n).x k) ((R n).H k) c₁ c₂ N =
                (some ((R n).α k), trialHistory (phase k))) ∧
      -- `F₁` is a maximum of four globally `C^{1,1}`, uniformly strongly convex, globally
      -- gradient-Lipschitz branches
      (∃ f : Fin 4 → Vec 2 → ℝ,
        (∀ x, F₁ x = Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i => f i x)) ∧
        (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (f i)) ∧
        (∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ ∀ i, FixedNormal.EuclideanStrongConvexOn univ κ (f i)) ∧
        ∃ L : ℝ, ∀ i y z, ‖euclideanVector (coordinateGradient (f i) y - coordinateGradient (f i) z)‖ ≤
          L * ‖euclideanVector (y - z)‖) ∧
      -- `F₂` has one fixed positive-definite Hessian and a countable polyhedral nonsmooth part
      ∃ B : Mat 2, B.PosDef ∧
        (∀ x : Vec 2, (∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, DifferentiableAt ℝ F₂ z) → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ F₂) x →
          RadialHessian.matrix F₂ x = B) ∧
        ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Countable ι) (ℓ : ι → Vec 2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (c : ι → ℝ), ∀ x,
          IsGreatest (Set.range fun j => ℓ j x + c j) (F₂ x - metricEnergy B x / 2)

BfgsCoverage.Companion.Ch13L.scalar_lemm.statement:
theorem scalar_lemma (i : Fin 3) {b : ℝ} (hb : b = LEmbedding.parameter i) :
    ConvexOn ℝ univ (LScalar.phi b) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ LScalar.phi b x) ∧
      Tendsto (LScalar.phi b) (cocompact ℝ) atTop ∧
      (∀ x, LScalar.phi b 0 ≤ LScalar.phi b x) ∧ (∀ x, LScalar.phi b x = LScalar.phi b 0 → x = 0) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ 1 (LScalar.phi b) ∧ (∃ K, LipschitzWith K (deriv (LScalar.phi b))) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (LScalar.phi b) (Ioi 0) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (LScalar.phi b) (Iio 0) ∧
      ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv (LScalar.phi b)) 0 ∧
      (∀ n, LScalar.phi b (b * LScalarGeometric.scale n) = LScalarGeometric.scale n ^ 2 ∧
        HasDerivAt (LScalar.phi b) (LScalarGeometric.scale n) (b * LScalarGeometric.scale n)) ∧

theorem step_scalar_def (i : Fin 3) {b : ℝ} (hb : b = LEmbedding.parameter i) :
    (∀ ξ, LScalarStep.ramp b ξ = if LScalarRamp.center b < ξ then 1 else 0) ∧
      (∀ ξ, LScalarStep.primitive b ξ = max 0 (ξ - LScalarRamp.center b)) ∧
      (∀ ξ, LScalarStep.primitive b ξ = ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..ξ, LScalarStep.ramp b v) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (x ξ : ℝ), b * LScalarGeometric.scale (n + 1) ≤ x → x ≤ b * LScalarGeometric.scale n →
        ξ = (x / (b * LScalarGeometric.scale n) - LScalarGeometric.theta) / (1 - LScalarGeometric.theta) →
        LScalarStep.phi b x = (LScalarGeometric.theta * LScalarGeometric.scale n) ^ 2 +
          b * LScalarGeometric.scale n ^ 2 * (1 - LScalarGeometric.theta) *
            (LScalarGeometric.theta * ξ + (1 - LScalarGeometric.theta) * LScalarStep.primitive b ξ)) ∧
      LScalarStep.phi b 0 = 0 ∧ (∀ x, x < 0 → LScalarStep.phi b x = -x) ∧
      ∀ x, b ≤ x → LScalarStep.phi b x = 1 + x - b

      (∀ x, IsGreatest (range (fun j => LScalarStep.affineFamily b j x)) (LScalarStep.phi b x)) ∧
      (∀ x, x ≠ 0 → LScalarStep.BinaryAffineGerm (LScalarStep.phi b) x) ∧
      ∀ n, LScalarStep.phi b (b * LScalarGeometric.scale n) = LScalarGeometric.scale n ^ 2 ∧
        HasDerivAt (LScalarStep.phi b) (LScalarGeometric.scale n) (b * LScalarGeometric.scale n) ∧
        ∀ h, |h| ≤ LScalarGeometric.scale n / 2 →

BfgsVerification.FixedNormal.cutoffFrame.signature: {n r : ℕ} → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ → BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (r + 1)) ℝ

                                            BfgsVerification.dot

def certificate (K : Set (Vec n)) (c₁ c₂ η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :

  W := fun _ => 1

    have hb := hx.2
    change 0 + η ≤ sqNorm x / 2 at hb
    linarith
  secant := fun x z g h _ _ hp _ => by
    rw [gradient_eq hp.gradient_x, gradient_eq hp.gradient_z, identity_energy]
    simp only [TransportedCertificate.pairCurvature, TransportedCertificate.pairStep,
      one_mul, dot_self, le_refl]

    simpa using (Matrix.PosSemidef.zero : (0 : Mat n).PosSemidef)

      (∀ x : Vec n, objective x = 0 ↔ x = 0) ∧

        R.x 0 = x₀ ∧ R.H = (fun _ => 1) ∧ R.c₁ = 1 / 4 ∧ R.c₂ = 1 / 2 ∧
        (∀ k, R.x k = ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) • x₀ ∧ R.g k = R.x k ∧ R.α k = 1 / 2) ∧
        b = objective x₀ ∧ 0 < b ∧ IsCompact {x : Vec n | objective x ≤ b} ∧
        IsLeast (Set.range (@objective n)) 0 ∧ objective (R.x 0) ≤ b ∧
        (∀ k, objective (R.x k) ≤ b) ∧
        (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η →
          ∃ B : TransportedCertificate.BandCertificate (@objective n) {x | objective x ≤ b}
              0 R.c₁ R.c₂ η,
            B.W = (fun _ => 1) ∧ B.m = 2 * η ∧ B.C = 1 ∧ B.L = 0 ∧ B.δ = 1 ∧
              0 ≤ B.C ∧ ∀ x, (B.W x).PosDef ∧ (B.W x).rank = n) ∧
        Tendsto (fun k => objective (R.x k)) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
        Tendsto R.x atTop (𝓝 0)

  convex := objective_convex
  x := point x₀
  H := fun _ => 1
  g := point x₀
  α := fun _ => 1 / 2
  c₁ := 1 / 4
  c₂ := 1 / 2

  c₂_lt_one := by norm_num

    (∀ z, HasFDerivAt (smoothBranch i) (gradientFunctional (smoothGradient i z)) z) ∧

      FiniteMaxHypotheses (objective a b c) (branch a b c) (fun _ => 1 / 2) ∧
      (∀ R : AdmissibleBFGSRun 2 (objective a b c),
        Tendsto (fun k => objective a b c (R.x k)) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
        Tendsto (fun k => euclideanSolutionDistance (objective a b c) (R.x k)) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
        Tendsto R.x atTop (𝓝 0)) ∧
      ∃ R : AdmissibleBFGSRun 2 (objective a b c),
        R.x 0 = x₀ ∧ R.g 0 = coordinateGradient (objective a b c) x₀ ∧

    ConvexOn ℝ univ (objective a b c) ∧ IsLeast (range (objective a b c)) 0 ∧ 0 < B ∧
      IsCompact {x | objective a b c x ≤ B} ∧
      (∀ t, 0 < t → t ≤ B → ∀ x y : Vec 2,
        segment ℝ x y ⊆ frontier {z | objective a b c z ≤ t} → x = y) ∧
      (∀ p, objective a b c p ≤ B → ¬ IsAffineCritical (objective a b c) p →
        PaperRegularAt (objective a b c) p) ∧
      {p | IsAffineCritical (objective a b c) p} ∩ {x | objective a b c x ≤ B} ⊆
        argmin (objective a b c)

BfgsVerification.finiteHorizon.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} (R : BfgsVerification.FullBFGSRun n) (G c : ℝ),
  0 < G →
    0 < c →
      (∀ (k : ℕ), BfgsVerification.sqNorm (R.g k) ≤ G ^ 2) →
        (∀ (k : ℕ), c ≤ R.beta k) →
          Summable R.d →
            ∀ (J m : ℕ),
              0 < m →
                ∀ (η : ℝ),
                  0 < η →
                    let D := ∑' (i : ℕ), R.d (J + i);
                    let V :=
                      BfgsVerification.ScalarHierarchy.weightedPotential n (4 * G ^ 2 / c ^ 2 / η)
                        (BfgsVerification.principalSum (R.H J));
                    ↑(m + 1) * (G ^ 2 * V) ^ (-1 / ↑(m + 1)) * (η + D / (c * ↑m)) ^ (-↑m / ↑(m + 1)) ≤
                      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (R.q (J + i))⁻¹

  Matrix.PosDef (H 0) →
    (∀ (k : ℕ), g k ≠ 0) →
      (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 < α k) →
        c₂ < 1 →

                  0 < BfgsVerification.metricEnergy (H k) (g k) ∧

BfgsVerification.hessianUpdate.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} {H : BfgsVerification.Mat n},
  Matrix.PosDef H →
    ∀ {g : BfgsVerification.Vec n},
      g ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (y : BfgsVerification.Vec n) {α : ℝ},
          0 < α →
            0 < BfgsVerification.dot y (BfgsVerification.bfgsStep H g α) →
              (BfgsVerification.inverseBFGS H (BfgsVerification.bfgsStep H g α) y)⁻¹ =
                H⁻¹ - (BfgsVerification.metricEnergy H g)⁻¹ • BfgsVerification.outer g g +
                  (BfgsVerification.dot y (BfgsVerification.bfgsStep H g α))⁻¹ • BfgsVerification.outer y y

BfgsVerification.inverseBFGS_det.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} {H : BfgsVerification.Mat n},
  Matrix.PosDef H →
    ∀ (s y : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
      BfgsVerification.dot y s ≠ 0 →
        Matrix.det (BfgsVerification.inverseBFGS H s y) =
          BfgsVerification.dot s (Matrix.mulVec H⁻¹ s) / BfgsVerification.dot y s * Matrix.det H

BfgsVerification.inverseBFGS_step_det_be.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} {H : BfgsVerification.Mat n},
  Matrix.PosDef H →
    ∀ {g : BfgsVerification.Vec n},
      g ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (y : BfgsVerification.Vec n) {α : ℝ},
          0 < α →
            0 < BfgsVerification.dot y (BfgsVerification.bfgsStep H g α) →
              Matrix.det (BfgsVerification.inverseBFGS H (BfgsVerification.bfgsStep H g α) y) =

BfgsVerification.metricGram.signature: {n : ℕ} → {ι : Type u_1} → BfgsVerification.Mat n → Matrix (Fin n) ι ℝ → Matrix ι ι ℝ

BfgsVerification.metricGram_det_append_o.signature:
∀ {n j : ℕ} {H : BfgsVerification.Mat n},
  Matrix.PosDef H →
    ∀ (y : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin j) ℝ),
      Function.Injective Z.mulVec →
        (BfgsVerification.metricGram H ((Matrix.replicateCol Unit y).fromCols Z)).det =
          (BfgsVerification.metricGram H Z).det *
            (BfgsVerification.metricEnergy H y -
              BfgsVerification.dot (Z.transpose.mulVec (Matrix.mulVec H y))
                ((BfgsVerification.metricGram H Z)⁻¹.mulVec (Z.transpose.mulVec (Matrix.mulVec H y))))

BfgsVerification.metricGram_det_append_t.signature:
∀ {n j : ℕ} {H : BfgsVerification.Mat n},
  Matrix.PosDef H →
    ∀ (g y : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin j) ℝ),
      Function.Injective Z.mulVec →
        let a := Z.transpose.mulVec (Matrix.mulVec H g);
        let b := Z.transpose.mulVec (Matrix.mulVec H y);
        let A := BfgsVerification.metricGram H Z;
        (BfgsVerification.metricGram H (Matrix.fromCols (fun i k => ![g i, y i] k) Z)).det =
          A.det *
            ((BfgsVerification.metricEnergy H g - BfgsVerification.dot a (A⁻¹.mulVec a)) *
                (BfgsVerification.metricEnergy H y - BfgsVerification.dot b (A⁻¹.mulVec b)) -
              (BfgsVerification.dot g (Matrix.mulVec H y) - BfgsVerification.dot a (A⁻¹.mulVec b)) ^ 2)

  0 < G →
    (∀ (k : ℕ), BfgsVerification.sqNorm (R.g k) ≤ G ^ 2) →

BfgsVerification.orthogonal_coordinate_g.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} (H U : BfgsVerification.Mat n) (lam : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
  U * Matrix.transpose U = 1 →
    Matrix.transpose U * H * U = Matrix.diagonal lam →
      (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < lam i) →
        ∀ (y : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (j : ℕ),
          ∑ I ∈ Finset.powersetCard j Finset.univ,
              (BfgsVerification.metricGram H
                  ((Matrix.replicateCol Unit y).fromCols (U * BfgsVerification.coordinateMatrix I))).det =
            ∑ J ∈ Finset.powersetCard (j + 1) Finset.univ,
              (∏ i ∈ J, lam i) * ∑ k ∈ J, (Matrix.transpose U).mulVec y k ^ 2
